New Student Programs and Family Engagement designs, plans, implements, and assesses mandatory online and in-person orientation events, as well as the ongoing engagement of family members and supporters throughout the academic year. jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Surgical Republic | On-site — Southern California**

**About the role:**

Surgical Republic supplies surgical instruments, disposables and implants to hospitals and surgery centers. We are seeking an organized, reliable Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to manage supplier orders and move products accurately from receiving through customer delivery.

You will order from approved U.S. and international suppliers, maintain inventory records, pack and ship orders, and follow up on delays. Our customer-service team handles instrument cross-referencing and provides the approved product specifications and part numbers.

**Responsibilities:**

Purchasing and supplier follow-up

* Place purchase orders using approved suppliers, part numbers, quantities and spending limits.
* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

Inventory and receiving

* Receive deliveries and verify products, quantities and condition against purchase orders.
* Record receipts, stock movements and storage locations accurately.
* Maintain an organized, clearly labeled inventory area.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor approved stock levels and submit replenishment needs.
* Track trial/demo instruments, returns and outstanding loaned inventory.

Order fulfillment

* Pick, check and pack the correct products and quantities.
* Prepare packing slips, shipping labels and required documents.
* Schedule carrier pickups and record tracking information.
* Coordinate partial shipments and backorders with customer service.
* Process approved returns and report damaged or incorrect items.

Order tracking and communication

* Keep the shared order tracker current, including supplier confirmations, delivery dates, blockers and shipment status.
* Notify customer service promptly when an order’s promised date is at risk.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

**How you will work with the team:**

* Hassan, Customer Service: Provides cross-referenced products and approved part numbers; handles customer communication.
* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

**What success looks like:**

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Experienced Clinical Research Coordinator

**Pasadena, CA | Full-Time**

About Us

We are a busy, independent clinical research site specializing in **hepatology and liver disease clinical trials**, located in Pasadena, California. Our team conducts complex clinical trials across a range of liver diseases and works closely with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors and CROs.

We are looking for an **experienced Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** who will thrive in a fast-paced, highly organized research environment and take ownership of their studies from startup through closeout.

This is an excellent opportunity for a CRC who enjoys being part of a close-knit team, wants meaningful responsibility, and is comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, research staff, sponsors, CROs, laboratories, and vendors.

The Opportunity

The ideal candidate is an experienced CRC who can **hit the ground running**. You should be comfortable managing multiple protocols simultaneously, coordinating patient visits, maintaining regulatory documentation, communicating with monitors and sponsors, and keeping studies on track.

Because our research is focused on liver disease, experience with **hepatology, gastroenterology, metabolic disease, obesity, MASLD/MASH, NASH, viral hepatitis, PBC, PSC, or related clinical research** is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate clinical research studies from **site initiation through study closeout**
* Manage multiple clinical trials and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Screen and recruit potential study participants
* Coordinate and conduct study visits according to protocol requirements
* Review inclusion/exclusion criteria and assist investigators with determining participant eligibility
* Maintain accurate and timely source documentation and study records
* Enter and maintain clinical data in **EDC/CTMS systems**
* Complete and resolve data queries promptly
* Coordinate laboratory testing, imaging, procedures, specialty testing, and other protocol-required assessments
* Track protocol-required procedures, visits, labs, and other study activities

Provide dependable, hands-on operational support across the following so Ravanty leadership can stay focused on clients, delivery, sales, and strategic growth:

This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who is comfortable moving between QuickBooks-related tasks, invoice and expense administration, employee onboarding records, vendor coordination, compliance calendars, and executive follow-up.

The successful candidate will bring structure to recurring operational work, maintain accurate records, identify missing information before it becomes a problem, and follow tasks through to completion. This role is not intended to replace Ravanty’s CPA, payroll provider, legal counsel, benefits broker, or executive decision-makers. **2. People and HR Administration**

* Help maintain current versions of employee-facing policies, templates, onboarding materials, and internal administrative procedures.

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in our local office. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**SUMMARY**

The Research Coordinator supports the daily research and administrative operations of the laboratory. The position coordinates purchasing, vendor orders, supply inventory, specimen receipt and shipping, laboratory database records, scheduling, communications, and general laboratory maintenance. The Research Coordinator provides administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager and facilitates research-related interactions with collaborators within the Institute and outside centers.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support general research laboratory activities and routine administrative functions.
* Order laboratory supplies and materials; monitor order status; receive vendor items; verify deliveries; and follow up with vendors regarding delays, discrepancies, returns, or other order issues.
* Maintain laboratory supply inventory, monitor stock levels, organize storage areas, and coordinate replenishment to support daily operations.
* Monitor and coordinate the receipt, documentation, routing, storage, and shipment of specimens and research materials received from or sent to outside centers.
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate laboratory item, specimen, inventory, and research data in Microsoft databases and other approved systems.
* Provide administrative support to the Director and Program Project Manager, including maintaining records, preparing routine documents, monitoring follow-up items, and assisting with program activities.
* Answer telephone calls, route inquiries, and deliver accurate and timely messages to laboratory members.
* Coordinate the Director’s calendar and meetings, including scheduling, invitations, room or virtual-meeting arrangements, materials, and related communications.
* Organize general laboratory maintenance activities, service requests, shared-space needs, and communications with internal service departments and external vendors.
* Maintain organized administrative, purchasing, inventory, shipping, specimen, and laboratory records in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate research-related communications and interactions with collaborators within the Institute and at external research centers.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of laboratory and research program needs.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in one of the biological sciences or a closely related field required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* More than three (3) years of experience supporting general research laboratory activities and related administrative tasks.
* More than two (2) years of experience in a laboratory administration position.
* Experience ordering, monitoring, and receiving vendor items and communicating with vendors regarding laboratory orders.
* Experience maintaining laboratory supply inventories and supporting general laboratory operations and maintenance activities.
* Experience monitoring and documenting the receipt and shipment of outside specimens or research materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft applications and databases used to manage laboratory items, specimens, inventory, and research data.
* Demonstrated ability to provide administrative support, coordinate calendars and meetings, handle telephone calls and messages, and maintain accurate records.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow tasks through completion.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work professionally with laboratory personnel, leadership, vendors, and internal and external research collaborators.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with laboratory purchasing, inventory, specimen-tracking, shipping, or research-administration systems.
* Experience supporting a research director, principal investigator, program manager, or multidisciplinary research team.
* Experience coordinating with institutional departments, vendors, and external research centers.

**About The Miles Lawrence Company**

The Miles Lawrence Company is a growing hospitality, events, media, and lifestyle company built around creating memorable experiences and community-centered brands.

Our portfolio includes Tipsy Toucan Private Bartending, Shoreline Food Catering, The Cotton Candy Co., Streetlights Play, Lucky Lizard Landscaping, La Mirada Blog, and other developing concepts.

From private parties and corporate events to community gatherings and our own in-house experiences, our team believes the smallest details can make the biggest difference.

As we continue to grow, we're building a team of energetic, dependable people who enjoy events, hospitality, creativity, and working behind the scenes to bring experiences to life.

**The Role**

We're looking for **Event Operations Assistants** to join our growing event team.

This is a flexible, part-time, and event-based position that is especially well suited for college students, young professionals, or anyone looking for supplemental weekend work and hands-on experience in events, hospitality, and small business operations.

You'll essentially be an extra set of capable hands wherever they're needed.

No two events will look exactly the same. One weekend you may help transform a backyard for a private event. Another weekend you might assist our bartending, catering, children's entertainment, or activation teams at a client event.

We're looking for people who can take direction, move quickly, stay positive, and aren't afraid to jump in and help.

**What You'll Do**

Responsibilities may include:

* Assisting with event setup and breakdown
* Loading and unloading event equipment and supplies
* Setting up tables, chairs, décor, bars, signage, lighting, and event activations
* Helping prepare Miles Lawrence Company events and client events
* Restocking supplies throughout events
* Keeping event spaces organized and guest-ready
* Supporting bartending, catering, entertainment, and activation teams as needed
* Assisting with cleanup and packing equipment after events
* Running supplies or completing small event-related errands
* Helping solve unexpected problems during an event
* Working alongside event leads to ensure events run smoothly
* Representing the Miles Lawrence Company professionally around clients and guests

This is a **hands-on position**. You should be comfortable moving equipment, being on your feet, working both indoors and outdoors, and helping wherever the team needs you.

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Dependable and punctual
* Friendly and professional
* Comfortable taking direction
* Able to work independently after receiving instructions
* Detail-oriented
* Flexible when plans change
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment
* Willing to do both the fun and not-so-glamorous parts of event production
* Comfortable interacting with clients, vendors, guests, and other team members
* Interested in hospitality, events, entrepreneurship, marketing, production, or small business

**Previous event experience is not required.**

We're more interested in finding people with a strong work ethic, good attitude, and willingness to learn.

**Schedule**

There are **no guaranteed weekly hours**. Team members will be offered available event shifts and may accept shifts based on their availability.

This makes the position particularly suitable for students and people looking for flexible supplemental work.

Event shifts may range from approximately 4–10 hours depending on the event.

**Physical Requirements**

Because this is an event operations role, applicants should be able to:

* Remain on their feet for extended periods
* Frequently bend, lift, carry, and move event equipment
* Safely lift approximately 40–50 lbs
* Work outdoors when necessary
* Work occasional late nights and weekends

**Compensation**

**$20–$25/hour**, depending on experience and level of responsibility.

There will also be opportunities for team members who consistently perform well to take on greater responsibility within our growing group of companies.

**Why Join Us?**

This isn't a traditional desk job.

You'll get exposure to multiple growing businesses and learn firsthand what goes into producing events, running hospitality companies, developing brands, and creating memorable experiences.

For someone interested in entrepreneurship, events, hospitality, marketing, or business, you'll have the opportunity to see a growing company from the inside.

As our companies grow, we want our best people to grow with us.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction telling us:

* A little about yourself
* Your current school, job, or primary commitment
* Why this position interests you
* Your availability
* Any relevant event, hospitality, customer service, leadership, or team experience

We value **attitude, reliability, and initiative** just as much as previous experience.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Inside Account Management team is part of DoorDash's SMB account management engine.

We are dedicated to the retention, satisfaction, and growth of 8,500+ high-impact restaurant partners. From our hubs in Tempe and Chicago, our team ensures that our merchants understand how to maximize their visibility, optimize their operations, and thrive on DoorDash. We pride ourselves on being data-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to championing small business success.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Success Manager (MSM), you will play a critical role in supporting and growing DoorDash's SMB restaurant partners. You will manage a focused book of approximately 75 merchants, building long‑term relationships and helping restaurant owners improve their performance on the platform. Through consistent outbound calls, email outreach, and data‑driven conversations, you will guide merchants on how to increase visibility, optimize their listings, adopt DoorDash products, and ultimately grow their revenue.

You'll be accountable for hitting weekly and quarterly KPIs — including high‑volume outbound activity (dials, talk time), strategic merchant calls, QBR delivery, and results tied to revenue, operational metrics, ads/promo adoption, and fair pricing conversations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys fast‑paced, high‑volume merchant engagement, uses data to drive decisions, and feels energized by work that blends sales, account management, and portfolio‑level strategy.

We expect this role to be flexible in terms of time spent remote and in-office with the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through training, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Make high‑volume outbound dials to existing merchants in your book of business (approximately 75 SMB restaurants), using a clear prioritization framework to decide where to focus your time and energy
* Establish goals and key performance indicators for your restaurant partners, and regularly review performance against those targets.
* Advise business owners on pricing, promotions, and product adoption (e.g., DashPass, Ads, promos) to achieve their revenue and margin goals, clearly explaining trade‑offs.
* Communicate with merchants by phone and email on an ongoing basis to monitor performance, surface risks, and proactively support progress toward their goals.
* Deliver and present quarterly business reviews ("QBR") that review a brand's partnership with DoorDash, pinpointing success, highlighting areas for revenue optimizations, and planning for areas of opportunity and growth
* Reduce churn, while identifying and supporting new store expansions
* Collaborate with internal growth teams to identify the best products to pitch to merchants
* Persist through slower periods or skeptical merchants — testing new approaches, refining talk tracks, and maintaining consistent activity even when results lag
* Ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team-building events, and other business-related necessities

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 2+ years of experience in client-facing sales roles, increasing customer satisfaction, retention, and product adoption
* You are comfortable being measured on both activity (dials, talk time, meetings) and outcomes (revenue, retention, product adoption) and can point to how you performed against your targets
* You have 2+ years of experience in Outbound Sales being held to DTT minimums
* You have 2+ years of experience in business operations or related setting
* You have experience in outbound sales and/or account management where you directly owned a book of accounts, managed prioritization, and were accountable for retention and growth
* You have experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools
* You are versed in using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), on an intermediate to proficient level
* You demonstrate empathy with customer needs and adapt to meet their unique goals
* You are goal‑oriented and competitive in a healthy way — you treat targets as a floor, not a ceiling, and enjoy going after stretch goals when you see an opportunity
* You bring strong AI fluency, or a clear eagerness to build it, and use new tools to improve efficiency, output, and impact—while knowing when human judgment and connection matter most.

We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

  

**Title:** Account Manager - Consumer

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA

  

**The Opportunity**

The **Account Manager** plays a critical role in driving revenue for the Consumer Care business unit. The Account Manager is responsible for promoting Galderma’s consumer skincare portfolio products (including Cetaphil), services to Health Care Providers (HCPs) and other offer key office staff members in order to create increased product demand within assigned territory.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, organize and execute field-based product promotion activities in accordance with all applicable company and regulatory standards to increase patient demand of consumer skincare portfolio through targeted strategies at the HCP office level
* Participate in face-to-face sales calls with HCPs (healthcare professionals), distribution of product samples, and attendance at company/company sponsored meetings; some meetings may occur during evening or weekend hours; travel may be necessary
* Meet or exceed goals and objectives for designated product portfolio and other KPIs (key performance indicators) such as HCP satisfaction surveys, coupon redemption, POS, etc. within assigned territory
    
  Utilize sales tools, resources, and supporting analysis to identify trends and to effectively identify and execute action plans
* Record sales call notes, tracking samples, and other territory management activities through company data reporting system; other administrative duties may be assigned
* Manage appropriate utilization of resources such as budget, samples, and peer to peer programs to engage and create impact with healthcare professionals.
* Work within given geography to develop relationships with providers and their staff
* Attend medical meetings/conferences as needed based on organization and regional needs
Other duties may be assigned  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from four-year College or university is required
* Two (2) years of outside business to business sales experience preferred
* Demonstrate strong track record of consistent documented success (such as sales performance)
* Possess valid driver’s license with clean driving record
* Ability to travel overnight as needed is required
* Strong business acumen including excellent communication (verbal/written), interpersonal, and persuasive skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships, service the total office, and add value with every interaction
Proficient with MS Office in a Windows environment, virtual interaction technology, and familiar with CRM software  

  

**Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is determined based on several factors. These include but are not limited to job accountabilities; skill sets; experience and training; certifications; work location; competitive market rates and other business needs. At Galderma, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on a unique combination of factors for each role. A reasonable estimate of the hiring range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000.

  

In addition to base salary, we provide an opportunity to participate in a competitive commission plan. We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program including health insurance, 401(k) plan with employer match, a generous paid time off policy, hybrid work schedules and more.

  

**Benefits**

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

  

**Work Authorization**

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

  

**What We Offer**  
At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

  

**Next Steps**

* If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
* The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, SLED
jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the SLED (State, Local Government and Education) segment. RAM is a field sales position. This role will be responsible for working with CA State Agencies. RAM will execute a Go-To Market Strategy derived from prospecting and collaborating with SLED Focused Partners to build and maintain a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to continue your selling career. You will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall field sales career path at Fortinet and State experience would be a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory.
* Meet or exceed the required number of face-to-face meetings each month with customers and partners in the territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
* Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts, and recognition.
* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations, and quotes in Salesforce.com).
* Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner.
* Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects & customers.
* Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the Mid-Market segment.
* Follow up on inbound, web, and corporate event leads.
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentations and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING).
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported.
* Act as a liaison between partners, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members.
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth of our business.
Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Coachable and flexible.
* 1+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space, with a preference for experience selling to SLED accounts.
* Working knowledge of the businesses, procurement processes, and partners in the local territory, especially within the SLED sector.
* Ability to run productive customer-facing and partner-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow-up.
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets.
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally.
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota.
* Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high-volume workload.
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
* Be computer savvy.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills.
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner.
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction.
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience selling cybersecurity or technology solutions to State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts.
* Familiarity with government procurement processes, cooperative purchasing agreements, and budget cycles in the SLED sector.
* Public/private cloud experience is a plus.
* Experience with multi-tier distribution is a plus.
Experience in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud is a plus.  

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $130,000 - $160,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

jobs.title: Mission Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

The Mission Operations Specialist serves as the frontline technical representative supporting internal R&D, deployed systems and customer operations. This role is responsible for fielding and troubleshooting CHAOS Industries' software and hardware capabilities in operational environments. This role requires strong initiative: build trust, learn, drive, and deliver outcomes and flawless execution.

A Mission Operations Specialist works directly with front-line military, government, and commercial customers to ensure mission success. Successful candidates thrive in ambiguous environments, possess strong technical aptitude, and are comfortable operating independently in the field. The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional planning and coordination skills, an aptitude for flawless execution and an eagerness to apply them to the tactical deployment of CHAOS Industries systems. This role sits within the Operations & Training group on the Mission team.

**Responsibilities:**

* **System Deployment & Fielding**
  + You're excited to be where the customer needs us.
  + You are detail-oriented to ensure everything for a given deployment is at maximum readiness and gets where it needs to be, on time.
  + You will coordinate, plan, and setup for internal R&D testing, customer demonstrations, exercises and deliveries.
  + Support installation, configuration, integration, and fielding of company systems.
  + Cross-functionally coordinate with logistics, engineering, and program teams to ensure successful deployments.
  + Success in this role means you're the customer's most trusted tactical partner.
* **Know our products – know the mission**
  + This role requires you to have intimate product knowledge and willingness to be hands-on with hardware in the field with customers. Success requires a thorough understanding of our technology, capabilities, and resources squared with the mission and user requirements.
  + You will lead basic system troubleshooting with confidence and support CHAOS engineering teams in the diagnosis and resolution of hardware, software, networking, and system integration issues.
  + Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams while providing detailed reproduction steps and operational context.
  + Work full-time onsite at our Headquarters in Hawthorne, CA.
  + Regular CONUS/OCONUS travel required for product testing, customer demonstrations and customer delivery (50%).
  

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 3+ years of experience supporting military, government, or enterprise technology systems.
* A solution-oriented mentality; you know to go to obtain missing information, use creativity to problem solve, and relish the opportunity to take on a difficult problem. Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking environments.
* Experience with tactical communications, networking, sensors, UAS, C2 systems, or AI-enabled platforms.
* You enjoy getting your hands dirty, literally: CHAOS is an engineering-first company with a hardware component.
* Ability to seamlessly organize and navigate overseas engagements, operating in remote areas and able to plan for and mitigate risk to reputation, mission and personnel. We intend to go with our customers to where they need us most to deliver.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and communication software like Slack, Teams and Zoom.
* Active U.S. security clearance **or** ability to obtain one.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree desired (but not required) in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Military Science, or related field.
* Previous FSR, FAE, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Operations Engineer experience with a hardware component.
* Knowledge of radar, RF, sensor, weapons systems, defense technology and communications preferred.
* Military background or extensive experience working with militaries.

  

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***Hourly Rate: $35.00 - $58.00 per hour***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

  

### **Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.**

  

*#LI-onsite*

jobs.description:
Canine Operations Assistant / Owner's Right-Hand

**Pawsitive K9 Solutions**  
**Pay Range: $22–$27 per hour**

Position Overview

This is **not a traditional receptionist position**.

The Canine Operations Assistant is a hands-on position supporting the owner across **dogs, clients, transportation, scheduling, staff, technology, and facility operations**.

The ideal candidate is a **reliable, organized, proactive right-hand person** who can keep the daily operation moving without constant supervision.

This person needs to be comfortable moving from one responsibility to another throughout the day. One moment you may be transporting a dog, the next you may be updating a client's record, helping a trainer, answering a client call, adjusting the schedule, videotaping a training session, or addressing an unexpected issue with a dog.

THE BIGGEST REQUIREMENT

**This person needs to take things off the business owner's plate.**

The owner makes the important decisions. The assistant makes sure the **details are handled, communication happens, schedules stay organized, problems are identified, and things actually get done.**

We are looking for someone who can eventually be trusted to say:

“I saw the problem, I handled what I could, and I brought the owner in only when necessary.”

This position requires someone who is **proactive rather than reactive** and who does not require constant direction or micromanagement.

Key Responsibilities1. Transportation

* Safely drive company vehicles for dog pickups and drop-offs throughout Long Beach and Los Angeles.
* Be available to assist with transportation needs as required by the daily schedule.
* Manage routes and timing efficiently.
* Safely load, secure, transport, and unload dogs.
* Follow proper transportation and canine-safety procedures.
* Communicate professionally with clients during pickups and drop-offs.
* Keep company vehicles clean, organized, stocked, and ready for use.
* Identify vehicle maintenance or safety concerns and communicate them promptly.

2. Dog Handling & Canine Care

* Comfortably and confidently handle dogs of different sizes, breeds, temperaments, and behavioral needs.
* Understand basic canine body language and recognize signs of stress, fear, illness, or discomfort.
* Safely manage dogs during transitions, feeding, potty breaks, walks, enrichment, training, and play.
* Assist with **Puppy Day School, Board & Train, daycare, and boarding** dogs.
* Follow and reinforce training protocols established by Pawsitive K9 Solutions.
* Assist trainers during training sessions when needed.
* Reinforce appropriate commands and behavioral cues consistently.
* Follow established feeding, medication, safety, handling, and care instructions.
* Report behavioral, medical, or safety concerns promptly.
* Maintain a safe environment for dogs, staff, and clients.

3. Scheduling & Daily Operations

* Assist with scheduling dogs into the appropriate programs and activities.
* Coordinate trainer and staff schedules.
* Help organize the daily movement of dogs throughout the facility.
* Coordinate training, transportation, boarding, daycare, and Day School schedules.
* Adjust schedules when dogs, clients, staff, transportation, or unexpected issues require changes.
* Identify scheduling conflicts before they become problems.
* Communicate schedule changes to the appropriate team members.
* Keep the day moving without the owner having to manage every individual detail.

4. Client Communication & Customer Service

* Answer calls and texts professionally when needed.
* Communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally with clients.
* Follow up on client communication and outstanding requests.
* Coordinate pickups, drop-offs, appointments, payments, and client information.
* Provide clients with appropriate updates regarding their dogs.
* Help resolve routine client questions and issues.
* Recognize situations that require escalation to the business owner.
* Maintain a professional representation of Pawsitive K9 Solutions in every client interaction.

5. Technology & Administration

The successful candidate must be comfortable learning and using technology.

* Become proficient with **Time To Pet, Google Workspace, scheduling systems, payment systems, and other company software**.
* Maintain accurate dog and client records.
* Track vaccination records and required paperwork.
* Keep client and dog information organized and current.
* Update schedules, records, notes, and other operational information accurately.
* Assist with administrative tasks that support the daily operation.
* Learn new software and systems quickly.
* Use technology as a tool to make the operation more efficient.

6. Video Documentation of Training Sessions

**Video documentation is a regular part of this position.**

The assistant will occasionally videotape dog training sessions for client report cards, progress updates, training documentation, and marketing or educational purposes when authorized.

The candidate must be **confident and comfortable entering an active training environment and capturing useful footage without disrupting the trainer or dogs.**

Responsibilities include:

* Videotape dog training sessions using a phone or camera.
* Capture trainer demonstrations, training exercises, and meaningful dog progress.
* Understand when and where to position yourself to obtain useful footage.
* Communicate appropriately with trainers when necessary.
* Remain aware of dogs, equipment, staff, and safety considerations while filming.
* Stay out of the trainer's way while still capturing quality footage.
* Organize and upload videos to the appropriate client or dog record.
* Follow all Pawsitive K9 Solutions policies regarding **client consent, video recording, staff privacy, and dog safety**.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
jobs.description:
About Resolve

Resolve is a digital marketing agency with a background in search engine marketing. We’re expanding our own social media presence and developing our social marketing offering, and we’re looking for a practical, creative marketer to help build it.

Initially, you’ll focus on marketing Resolve itself: planning content, creating static graphics, writing posts and developing a consistent presence across our chosen channels. As the client base grows, there may be opportunities to take on client campaigns and increase your hours by mutual agreement.

What you’ll do

* Develop a clear social media and content plan for Resolve
* Build and maintain a content calendar, taking posts from idea through approval and publishing
* Create polished static graphics and ad creatives using Canva, Adobe or similar tools
* Write engaging captions and content that explain our services clearly
* Recommend which channels and content formats deserve our attention
* Review performance and use the results to improve future content
* Keep creative files, tasks and deadlines organised
* Help develop Meta advertising campaigns as needed
* Gradually take on client communication and campaign responsibilities as the role develops

What we’re looking for

* Hands-on experience creating content and managing social media for a business or agency
* A portfolio showing strong static design and clear written communication
* Practical experience with Meta Ads Manager; Google Ads experience is an advantage
* Experience communicating directly with clients and explaining marketing work clearly
* Strong organisation, reliable follow-through and attention to detail
* The ability to turn a brief into finished work and ask useful questions when something needs clarification
* Confidence working independently in the office, with regular remote check-ins with the founder

The arrangement

This role starts at two days per week, approximately 16 hours, with the working days agreed together. The planned office is at the Pacific Design Center in West Hollywood, subject to the space being confirmed. You should be comfortable working on site while the founder is overseas.

As the business and workload grow, there may be scope to increase hours, potentially to full-time. This would depend on business needs and mutual agreement.

How to apply

Please send your résumé, a brief introduction and examples of social posts or static ad creatives you’ve personally produced. Tell us what you were responsible for and include any results you can share. Please remove confidential client information from your examples.

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Social Media Manager**

**Shape the Social Voice of Waterless Beauty with Oliveda**

Waterless Beauty is the fastest-growing sector in the beauty industry, and we are one of the fastest-growing waterless beauty brands disrupting the industry.

**About the Role**

As our **Social Media Manager,** you will be responsible for shaping and growing Oliveda's organic social presence across key platforms. You will bring the brand story to life through relevant, engaging content while building an active community around waterless beauty.

This role combines social strategy, content planning, community engagement, and performance analysis. You will have a strong understanding of platform culture and trends and know how to translate brand priorities into social-first content that builds awareness, engagement, and organic growth.

You will work closely with Creative, Graphic Design, Influencer Marketing, E-commerce, and Performance Marketing to ensure Oliveda's social presence is consistent, timely, and aligned with broader brand and campaign priorities.

**About Oliveda**

Oliveda is a global waterless beauty brand rooted in the power of the olive tree. Founded more than two decades ago, the company grew from a pioneering approach to holistic wellness into a global beauty movement centered around waterless skincare and beauty formulations.

Today, Oliveda is expanding rapidly in the U.S. and internationally, combining decades of olive tree expertise with an innovative approach to beauty that replaces conventional water-based formulations with antioxidant-rich olive tree elixirs.

**What You'll Do**

· Develop and execute Oliveda's organic social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, and emerging platforms

· Own and maintain the social content calendar in alignment with product launches, campaigns, promotions, and brand priorities

· Develop social-first content concepts, briefs, captions, and messaging that reflect Oliveda's brand voice

· Manage day-to-day community engagement and customer interaction across social channels

· Identify platform trends, cultural moments, and content opportunities relevant to beauty and wellness

· Partner with Creative and Graphic Design to develop compelling social assets and short-form content

· Support influencer and UGC initiatives by integrating appropriate content into Oliveda's owned social channels

· Track organic KPIs including reach, engagement, audience growth, content performance, and organic traffic

· Analyze platform and content performance and use insights to improve the social strategy

· Provide clear social-media reporting, insights, and recommendations

· Stay current on platform updates, emerging formats, trends, and social-media best practices

**What We're Looking For**

· 4+ years of social media management, social content, or related brand experience

· Demonstrated experience managing social channels for a consumer-facing brand

· Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms

· Excellent understanding of social-first storytelling, content development, and community engagement

· Strong copywriting skills and the ability to maintain a consistent brand voice

· Experience using social analytics to guide content and channel decisions

· Beauty, skincare, wellness, or lifestyle-brand experience is highly preferred

· Strong organizational and project-management skills

· Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

**Nice to Have**

· Experience with influencer or creator content

· Experience incorporating UGC into owned social channels

· Experience with social listening and community-management tools

· Basic short-form video editing or content-production skills

· Experience supporting product launches and integrated brand campaigns

· Familiarity with social commerce and TikTok Shop

· Experience working in founder-led or high-growth DTC brands

**Why Join Oliveda**

· Be part of the rapidly growing waterless beauty movement

· Help shape the social voice of a category-defining global beauty brand

· Have a direct impact on community growth, brand awareness, and customer engagement

· Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with meaningful ownership

· Collaborate closely with Creative, Influencer Marketing, E-commerce, and other key marketing functions

· Competitive compensation and opportunities for professional growth

**Benefits & Perks**

· Medical, dental and vision insurance

· 401(k) retirement plan

· Life and disability insurance

· Paid time off and company holidays

· $250 monthly employee perk allowance

· 50% employee discount on all products

· Additional voluntary benefits and employee perks

*Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan terms.*

**Job Details**

· Job Type: Full-Time

· Location: Culver City, CA - On-Site

· Compensation: $85,000-$105,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

Sweat Yoga is a hot yoga studio with three locations across Los Angeles. Our community is the heart of everything we do, and we're looking for a creative freelancer to help us show that online. If you love yoga, wellness, and making content people want to watch, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Project**

We're looking for an independent social media pro to run our content from idea to post. You'll come into our studios to film mock classes, teachers, and community moments, then turn that footage into content that feels like us. You'll also handle our DMs and comments and map out the plan for each month.

Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Remote Type:**

**Job Family Group:**

Sales

**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.

**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**

Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.

Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.

Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***

Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k - $50k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO & PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.





Breakthru Beverage Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information and other legally protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please call (708) 298-3536 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
