jobs.title: Freelance Print Specialist/Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Freelance Print Specialist/Production Coordinator**

We're looking to add a Freelance Print Specialist / Production Coordinator to our freelance roster. This is an on-site role in Burbank, CA supporting our Production team with everything from color-accurate print proofs and client boards to packaging, shipments, and day-to-day production needs.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of print production who enjoys being part of a creative team and wants to be part of our go-to freelance roster for future projects.

**Responsibilities**

* Output color-accurate, large-format Epson print proofs
* Handle all printed materials with care to keep them in pristine condition
* Size, cut, mount, and accurately label boards for clients
* Pack and organize shipments so they reach clients on time
* Coordinate runner and courier services for pickups and deliveries
* Notify the Production Manager or Director when printing or packaging supplies are needed
* Assist in preparing client-facing deliverables, including PDFs, Keynotes, Google Slides presentations, copy documents, record sets and contact sheets

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of the printing process
* Detail-oriented, with the ability to multitask and respond to requests promptly
* Flexible and adaptable to changing schedules and circumstances
* Positive, professional communicator who supports the team and clients
* Able to work on-site, as this is an in-office position
* Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, especially InDesign, Acrobat and Photoshop

**Requirements:**

* Reliable transportation to be on site in Burbank, CA

Rate: $20 - $30 / hour

jobs.title: Development Assistant
jobs.description:
**Harmony Project** is an award-winning research-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We promote positive youth development through year-round music lessons and ensemble participation. Our mission is to harness the transformative power of music to increase access to higher education for underserved students by removing systemic barriers to achievement through academic and social support.

**Job Overview:** As a Development Assistant at Harmony Project, you will play a crucial role in supporting the fundraising and development efforts that enable us to continue our important work in the community. Reporting directly to the Director of Development, you will contribute to building relationships with donors, managing donor information, and ensuring the efficient operation of our development activities. Harmony Project is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

**Key Roles (Essential Job Responsibilities)**

* Collaborate with the Director of Development to execute strategies for donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
* Maintain and manage donor databases, utilizing systems such as Salesforce, Razors Edge, Blackbaud, and others, to track donor interactions, contributions, and engagement history.
* Communicate with existing and prospective donors in person, on the phone, and by email.
* Generate and distribute acknowledgment letters, tax receipts, and other correspondence to donors in a timely and personalized manner.
* Assist in the planning and execution of fundraising events, including logistics coordination, guest communication, and post-event follow-up.
* Conduct research to identify potential individual, corporate, and foundation donors.
* Participate in the development of fundraising materials, grant proposals, and reports to effectively communicate the organization's impact and funding needs.
* Support the implementation of online fundraising campaigns and maintain accurate donation records.
* Provide support to the Director of Development during critical event time, such as preparing and mailing sponsorship letters, obtaining auction items, ordering awards, etc.
* Collaborate with the communications team to ensure consistent messaging across all donor-related materials.
* Generate and maintain reports, lists, data analysis for viable donor prospects, strategies, and track results.
* Liaison and support to event producers for special events as needed.
* Coordinate volunteer and staff assignments and needs for special events.
* Support Club Public Relations efforts as needed.
* Provide administrative support, including scheduling meetings, preparing materials, and assisting with other tasks as needed.
* Coordinate with program staff to gather compelling stories and data that demonstrate the impact of donor support.
* Conduct research on grant opportunities and fundraising trends.

**Required Skills/Abilities**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential for accurate donor data management and event coordination.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for donor correspondence and collaboration with team members.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, demonstrating a flexible and adaptable approach to tasks.
* Passion for the mission of Harmony Project and a genuine interest in contributing to the organization's growth.
* Experience or aptitude in coordinating and executing events, from small donor appreciation gatherings to large fundraising galas.
* Proficiency in using MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Publisher, and Canva.

**Education and Experience**

* An AA degree in communication, public relations, or a related field or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in fundraising.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in an office setting, preferably a nonprofit company.
* Previous experience with donor management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Razors Edge, Blackbaud) is required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, often while working at a computer or attending meetings.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret documents, including reports and donor correspondence.
* Ability to operate standard office equipment, including computers, calculators, telephones, and copiers.

**Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel for events, meetings, etc.
* Flexible work schedule to include some weekends, weeknights, and holidays.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Come join our family at In-N-Out Burger!**

The In-N-Out Burger IT Project Management Office team has an excellent opportunity for an **IT Project Coordinator**, located in the Irvine, CA office\*.

The IT Project Coordinator will report directly to the IT PMO Manager and help to coordinate and support smaller, internal IT projects, or assist on larger projects by managing tasks, facilitating communication, tracking progress, and working closely with technical teams to ensure projects meet timelines and customer needs.

*\*This role is based full-time in office\**

**General Responsibilities**

* Coordinate, support and manage smaller IT projects from initiation through closeout, supporting scope, timelines, resources, and deliverables in accordance with IT PMO standards.
* Support Agile and Waterfall project activities, including sprint planning, scrum meetings, project schedules, and task tracking.
* Lead and facilitate project meetings, document key decisions and action items, and follow up with project teams to support timely completion.
* Partner with technical leads and cross-functional teams to track project risks, issues, dependencies, and scope changes, escalating when appropriate.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including Project Charters, Change Orders, RFI/RFP materials, rollout documentation, and training guides.
* Maintain project information and team coordination through tools such as Jira, Asana, and Confluence.
* Identify opportunities to improve PMO processes, tools, and project delivery practices.

**Work Schedule and Benefits**

* Full-time position, Non-exempt, Hourly
* Office Hours in Irvine, CA: Monday-Friday, 8:00 am-5:00 pm
* Department needs will call for occasional overtime
* Excellent Benefits, to include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, FSA’s, 401(k)/Profit Sharing Plan, Adoption Assistance, Education Reimbursement, Supplemental Health Plans and Pet Insurance
* Pay Range: $32.00 - $35.50/hour
* *The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your experience and other job-related factors.*

**Qualifications for In-N-Out Associates**

* 2+ years of In-N-Out Burger Store or Support experience required.
* Store leadership experience preferred, including experience as a Shift Manager, Store Trainer, All Star, or similar role.

**Qualifications**

* Previous or Current employment with In-N-Out Burger highly preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 1+ year of experience in project coordination, project support, or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of project lifecycle concepts, including scope, timelines, resources, risks, and deliverables.
* Familiarity with Agile and/or Waterfall project management practices.
* Experience with or exposure to project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, and Microsoft Teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, time-management, communication, and customer service skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively across teams, and adapt to changing project needs.
* Comfortable learning and working with new technology, systems, and processes.

**Work Location Details**

In-N-Out Burger plans to bring its west coast headquarters team back together under one roof by the end of 2029. After maintaining two Southern California office locations for many years, the company will permanently close its Irvine office in 2029 and once again headquarter the company’s western territory solely in Baldwin Park, California, where the company was founded in 1948.

Newly hired Associates in Irvine will be eligible to participate in the group move to Tennessee with relocation assistance or work from our western headquarters in Baldwin Park, CA, upon its opening in 2029. We are sharing this information early so candidates can make informed decisions while considering a career with In-N-Out Burger.

**About In-N-Out Burger**

In-N-Out Burger was founded in 1948 by Harry and Esther Snyder in Baldwin Park, California, and remains privately owned and operated. Under the direction of the Snyder family, the company has opened restaurants throughout California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Washington, and Tennessee. In-N-Out Burger’s menu has remained the same since 1948, and we have maintained a simple philosophy – serve only the highest quality product, prepare it in a clean and sparkling environment, and serve it in a warm and friendly manner. We have built a reputation for fresh, made-to-order foods prepared and served by friendly, well trained Associates.

In-N-Out Burger offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer by choice. Should there be a need, In-N-Out Burger will provide a reasonable accommodation to complete the interview process upon request.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to support and enhance sales efforts at our Irvine hotel. This role is essential to day-to-day sales operations, smooth communication across departments, and revenue-generating activities.

The Sales Coordinator will help drive business through lead generation, client communication, and administrative support. The ideal candidate brings strong organizational skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a proactive approach to sales support and service excellence.

**Responsibilities**  
As Sales Coordinator, you will support the Sales team from an administrative, customer service, and lead development perspective to grow new and repeat business. Responsibilities include:

* Support the Director of Sales in executing hotel sales strategies to meet revenue goals
* Identify new contacts, generate and develop sales leads, and reach out to potential clients to build business relationships
* Coordinate group bookings, corporate reservations, and special events
* Respond promptly to client inquiries and prepare quotations, sales proposals, contracts, and written confirmations
* Maintain a thorough knowledge of hotel amenities, packages, and promotions
* Arrange and conduct hotel site tours for prospective clients
* Maintain accurate records of inquiries, bookings, and follow-ups in the sales database
* Prepare accurate, timely sales reports, including appointments, calls, and leads, and contribute to weekly and monthly sales performance reviews
* Monitor client satisfaction and resolve outstanding issues to secure future business
* Build and maintain relationships with clients, vendors, and partners to expand sales opportunities
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; degree in hospitality, business, or a related field preferred
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in hotel sales, front desk, or a related hospitality role
* Strong organizational and administrative skills with attention to detail
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a professional, customer-focused approach
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Proactive approach to problem-solving and achieving sales goals
* Proficiency in hotel management software
* Flexibility to work varied shifts, including weekends and holidays as needed.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $22.00 - $24.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the CEO & Executive Operations**

**Klēn Earth Products**

**About Klēn Earth Products**

Klēn Earth Products is a growing personal care manufacturing company committed to building a strong organization, delivering exceptional products, and creating an environment where our team can succeed.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an exceptional **Executive Assistant to the CEO & Executive Operations** who can serve as a trusted partner to our CEO and an important resource to our leadership team.

This is much more than a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership. The ideal candidate anticipates needs, manages projects, drives follow-through, protects the CEO’s time, and ensures important priorities move from discussion to completion.

**Position Overview**

The Executive Assistant to the CEO & Executive Operations will serve as the **right hand to the CEO**, providing high-level executive support while also helping manage projects, priorities, deadlines, and operational initiatives across the organization.

The successful candidate will be someone the CEO can rely on to understand what needs to happen, create a plan, coordinate the appropriate people, follow up consistently, and make sure projects and tasks are completed.

This person will often be responsible for taking a directive, conversation, or idea from the CEO and helping turn it into actionable next steps.

The role requires someone who is comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, holding others accountable for deliverables, and maintaining visibility into projects happening throughout the organization.

The right person will bring excellent judgment, strong project management skills, exceptional organization, a high level of discretion, and a willingness to step in wherever needed to support the CEO and broader leadership team.

**Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive Support**

* Serve as a trusted partner and primary administrative support to the CEO.
* Manage the CEO’s calendar, meetings, appointments, priorities, and scheduling.
* Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, deadlines, and upcoming priorities.
* Help protect and strategically manage the CEO’s time.
* Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and materials, and document appropriate follow-up.
* Draft and prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, meeting materials, and other executive communications.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, reservations, and related logistics.
* Serve as a professional point of contact between the CEO and employees, leadership, business partners, vendors, customers, and other stakeholders.
* Manage confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion.

**Project Management & Execution**

* Manage and coordinate projects assigned by the CEO from initial concept through completion.
* Translate executive direction into clear action items, timelines, owners, and deliverables.
* Maintain project trackers and provide the CEO with clear visibility into status, deadlines, outstanding items, and potential roadblocks.
* Establish timelines, milestones, and follow-up processes for company initiatives.
* Coordinate across departments to ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Regularly follow up with team members regarding assignments, deadlines, commitments, and outstanding deliverables.
* Identify stalled projects or missed deadlines and proactively work to get them back on track.
* Escalate risks, delays, or issues to the CEO when appropriate.
* Ensure that decisions made during meetings result in documented action items and completed work.
* Keep projects moving without requiring constant direction from the CEO.
* Help prioritize projects based on urgency, importance, and company objectives.
* Maintain organized records of project decisions, responsibilities, deadlines, and next steps.
* Assist with special projects, operational initiatives, company events, leadership initiatives, and other cross-functional assignments.
* Conduct research, gather information, and prepare recommendations to support projects and executive decision-making.
* Build and improve systems for tracking work, responsibilities, recurring tasks, and organizational priorities.

**Task Management & Follow-Through**

* Maintain an organized system for tracking the CEO’s commitments, requests, tasks, and delegated assignments.
* Ensure tasks assigned by the CEO are clearly communicated to the appropriate individuals.
* Follow up on delegated assignments until they are fully completed.
* Proactively remind team members of approaching deadlines and outstanding responsibilities.
* Verify completion of important assignments rather than assuming tasks have been completed.
* Identify when additional information, decisions, or resources are needed to move a task forward.
* Help the CEO distinguish between items requiring executive attention and items that can be handled independently.
* Take ownership of administrative and operational matters whenever possible so they do not unnecessarily return to the CEO.
* Close the loop on requests, projects, and outstanding issues.
* Develop processes that reduce the need for repeated follow-up and improve accountability across the organization.

**Executive Operations & Team Support**

* Support members of the leadership team and broader organization when appropriate.
* Assist in coordinating leadership meetings, management meetings, company-wide meetings, and special events.
* Help improve internal communication and ensure important information reaches the appropriate people.
* Support implementation of CEO and leadership decisions across the organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative and operational processes.
* Assist with preparation and organization for strategic planning sessions and executive meetings.

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
3 Day Blinds is a national retailer and manufacturer of quality, custom-made blinds, shades, draperies, and shutters. We are proud to be part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands. Over the last 40 years we've successfully helped transform our clients' homes and workplaces by offering a wide variety of products that add beauty and comfort to every space. It takes a talented group of individuals to do what we do, and we do it together as One Team. We strive to create a culture of learning and opportunity, and most importantly, an environment where you can feel passionate and connected to your work every day.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

As the Assistant Brand Manager, Product Innovation you will help shape Chipotle’s menu innovation and go-to-market strategy by identifying new opportunities grounded in consumer insights, emerging food trends, culture, and the competitive landscape. You will actively seek out innovation pathways, staying close to what’s happening across food, culture, social media, and emerging brands to identify ideas, ingredients, formats, and partners that could unlock what’s next for Chipotle. You will partner closely with Culinary and cross-functional teams to help bring new menu items and market launches from concept to execution, supporting strategic product briefs, test markets, pricing, merchandising, and integrated marketing activation. This role will help ensure new products and launches deliver a compelling, socially relevant and consistent consumer experience across restaurants and digital channels.

* Support the development of strategic product briefs that translate consumer and business insights into clear direction for Chipotle’s Culinary team.

* Partner with internal and external communications and marketing teams, including creative agencies, experiential, social media, and digital partners, to develop and execute integrated go-to-market launch campaigns.

* Excellent written and verbal business communication, including strong grammar, spelling, sentence structure, tone, and attention to detail; able to represent the company in a polished, courteous, and professional manner.
* Strong internet research, computer, and Microsoft Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, organizing, and working with customer or sales data.
* Familiarity with social media platforms and the ability to learn new software, online platforms, AI/research tools, and company systems.
* Organized, accurate, creative, curious, resourceful, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple prospects, projects, and follow-up activities while turning research into actionable ideas.
* Willing to provide occasional support to other departments during periods of high workload or staffing needs and assist with other reasonable business and operational needs as necessary.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation, customer service, marketing, prospect research, or outbound customer/prospect contact.
* Experience with Constant Contact or similar email marketing platforms, website content/e-commerce/content management systems, or coordinating projects with outside vendors, freelancers, developers, designers, or contractors.
* Experience using AI tools for research, productivity, or business purposes.
* Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, or similar graphic design experience is a plus, as is experience with catalogs, product marketing, or print marketing materials.

Previous experience is preferred, but we are also interested in candidates who demonstrate the right combination of confidence, communication skills, research ability, creativity, resourcefulness, and motivation.

This is not a high-pressure call-center position. We are looking for someone who researches first, understands who they are contacting, has intelligent and natural conversations, builds relationships, and follows through. The right person will actively look for opportunities instead of waiting for them to appear and will continually ask: “Where can we find our next customer, and what can we do to earn their business?”

**Schedule & Work Location**

* Full-time
* Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM
* In-house / on-site position in Long Beach, California
* Not remote or hybrid

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to our Long Beach location f

This may include maintaining club space, training fellow team members, and being the source of managerial support when the Manager is not present. * Discounts on Life Time products and services

Full-time Team Members are eligible for additional benefits, including:

* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage
* Short term and long term disability insurance
* Life insurance
* Pre-tax flexible spending and dependent care plans

* Paid time off, including 5 to 20 vacation days per calendar year (based on tenure) and paid sick leave

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**
=======================

**Date:** Oct 6, 2026

**Location:** San Jose, California, United States

**Company:** Super Micro Computer

**Job Req ID: 30216**
---------------------

**About Supermicro:**
---------------------

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

Supermicro is currently looking for a Project Coordinator to join our team.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------

* **Quality Management System Support:** Help maintain and improve the QMS so processes remain aligned with applicable ISO and quality standards, internal procedures, and customer or certification requirements.
* **Internal Auditing:** Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits to assess process effectiveness, measure performance, and identify gaps or nonconformities.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Track operational issues and nonconformities, support root-cause analysis, and work with process owners to implement and verify corrective and preventive actions.
* **External Audit Support:** Serve as a point of contact for certification bodies and other external auditors during compliance, surveillance, and recertification audits; help prepare evidence and follow up on findings.
* **Training and Awareness:** Support employee training and awareness on quality standards, documented processes, and continuous-improvement practices.
* **Document and Record Control:** Maintain controlled documents, records, and logs so quality documentation remains accurate, current, secure, and readily available for operations and audits.
* **Reporting and Follow-Up:** Prepare audit summaries, track open actions, and provide status updates to support management review and ongoing improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Quality Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 1+ years of experience in quality, compliance, auditing, document control, or ISO coordination preferred.
* Experience supporting ISO 9001 or another management system (e.g., ISO 13485) is a plus.
* Experience in technology, operations, logistics, or a service environment is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); familiarity with databases, document control systems, or audit/QMS software preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with people across departments.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work in a logical, systematic way and follow issues through to closure.
* Internal auditor training or certification is preferred but not required.

**Salary Range**
----------------

$28.00 - $30.00 /hr

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills,years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus andequity award programs.

**EEO Statement**
-----------------

Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Digital Delivery Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.
* Experience building reporting packages or KPI dashboards for an executive audience.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Youth Services RAICES)
jobs.description:
The **RAICES Program Coordinator** will provide gender-specific services to youth who are at risk. The RAICES Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination and management of school groups. Will provide supervision to the Youth Engagement Counselors by checking in and supporting group facilitation as needed.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Primary Functions**

* Plan, coordinate, and evaluate gender-specific workshops, recreation and enrichment activities of the on-site and off-site RAICES program in accordance with contract regulations.
* Contact schools to coordinate groups for each cohort (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer Internship)
* Prepare and submit accurate reports as required by program, including monthly program reports to funding sources (DCYF) and the collection of evaluation and demographic data (surveys).
* Develop curriculum on gender specific topics such as healthy relationships, self-advocacy, hygiene, bullying, and others related to the DCYF contact.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to Youth Engagement Counselors, Youth Interns, and volunteers involved in the RAICES program.
* Plan and implement project-based learning and experiential outings and activities to enhance youth learning and skill development.
* Plan outreach and resource events for the community, youth, schools, etc as part of the contract requirement.
* Ensure that all contact requirements are implemented, documented, and met.
* Support a program environment that is learner centered promotes a sense of physical and emotional safety.
* Support positive relationships between staff and youth, and between youth and their peers.
* Conduct case consultations and check-ins with the Youth Engagement counselors.
* Provide resources to youth, schools, families, community, and Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Communicate with school, community, public agencies and parents/guardians of youth.
* Supervise, evaluate and provide leadership development to youth interns and volunteers involved in the program.
* Ensure all youth completed the intake forms and communicate with youth families to complete.
* Utilize HUBB software to keep track of all youth’s profiles.
* Ensure Youth Engagement Counselors are completing incident reports on HUBB when youth disclose anything that would be reportable and is required to document.
* Provide individual follow-up services and information and referrals to youth as needed and to other MNC youth services and community services.
* Coordinates, schedules, and handles all logistical details of the weekly check ins and group coordination.
* Review CMS data and prepare monthly program reports.
* Develops and oversees outreach plan to recruit target population into case RAICES program.

* Monitors school advocacy efforts including school meetings such as parent conferences, IEP meetings, school disciplinary meetings, as necessary.
* Attending meetings with the Associate Director.
* Support the hiring process, selecting, interviewing, and filling out forms required to hire new employees in the department. Also, assist with the onboarding/offboarding of Youth Engagement Counselors.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

**Secondary Functions**

* Collaborate in the planning and production of community events including Dia de los Muertos, Holiday/Winter break, Black History month, Carnival SF, Spring break, family nights, program graduations and showcase, etc.
* Recruit in kind service providers to implement gender specific activities, cultural enrichment, health and wellness, youth leadership, and other enrichment activities within the program.
* Create partnerships with other organizations.
* Advocate for youth needs, providing referral information, when appropriate to internal and external services based on individual youth needs. Provide individual follow-up services to clients as needed.
* Collaborate with community to coordinate services.
* Represent MNC at appropriate community forums and funder meetings/trainings; maintain superior customer service with funders, staff, collaborating agencies, parents, and youth. Adequately inform, share information, and collaborate with anyone benefiting from the RAICES program.
* Maintain accurate program records and follow reporting procedures. Compile, analyze, verify, and submit data according to the funding schedule and guidelines.
* Participate in weekly staff meetings, 1:1 supervision, and as training courses are offered.
* Ensure team is completing all training, progress reports, and required documentation for program.
* Actively participate in the creation and implementation of a personal staff development plan striving for self-improvement.
* Must be available to participate in late afternoon, evening, and some weekend activities as needed (including Memorial Day Weekend, during school breaks, and MNC events).
* Ensuring that the curriculum, orders, and any required document is updated and completed.
* Collaborate with program staff to identify individual needs and create proactive strategies that foster social-emotional growth and success.
* Provide case consultations and support to staff, ensuring holistic and trauma-informed approaches.
* Maintain accurate program records and submit data in accordance with funding and reporting requirements.
* Attend required team meetings (weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly). Coordinate services with other MNC programs and community partners to ensure smooth referrals and continuity of care.
* Assist with planning and participating in MNC-sponsored community and cultural events.
* Supporting other MNC Programs as needed.

* Provide exceptional customer service.

* Always represent the organization in a professional manner.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
* We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.
* Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 10x so far in 2026.
* We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.
* We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.
* Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.
* We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

As the Recruiting Coordinator you’ll ensure that everyone interviewing at Blacksmith has the best possible interview experience.  
You’ll own the logistics of the interview experience. Coordinating interview schedules, managing onsites and supporting executive interviews across all functions within the business.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate with recruiters and hiring managers to schedule interview loops, feedback and next steps for each candidate interviewing.
* Ensure the highest quality of candidate experience.
* Manage the onsite interview logistics; the schedule for the day, who they’ll meet and when, lunches with the team, demos/presentations. You’ll ensure everything is running smoothly.
* Identify opportunities to improve the process. How can we be better?
* Communicate effectively with all of the stakeholders involved and make sure we maintain momentum and speed in each process.

**You’re a good fit if you have**

* 2+ year of recruiting or administrative/support experience, with a heavy emphasis on coordinating scheduling and managing logistics.
* The ability to manage multiple simultaneous interview processes with overlapping schedules and shifting priorities, whilst always maintaining the best candidate experience.
* Clear and professional communication skills
* Able to work with urgency. We move fast, so does our interview process, you’ll make sure we maintain this velocity.

**Compensation and benefits**

* Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.
* Competitive base + equity.
* 401K match.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Annual offsite.
* Early-exercise stock options.
* 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US).

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

jobs.description:

By nurturing a culture where everyone experiences a deep sense of belonging and equity of opportunity, we will uphold our vision to “unleash human and business potential.” We commit to being an anti-ism workplace and embedding diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our business.

**Job Summary**

The Account Manager manages accounts and project teams in support of all project and daily work activities, from scope development through task or project completion. With a highly consultative approach, they deliver tailored solutions and full client satisfaction throughout the entire project lifecycle, and build strong, sustainable customer relationships. They are responsible for meeting agreed upon revenue and margin goals.

* Develop and nurture client relationships in support of building trust, aligning business requirements, and increasing revenue opportunities and profitability.
* Maintain comprehensive understanding of client needs, goals, business practices and satisfaction/performance criteria.
* Act as single point of contact for coordination and execution of Insidesource activities (ie. Pre- and post-sale).
* Responsible for overall performance of Insidesource account / project teams (sales support, design, project management and field service teams).
* Accountable for end-to-end client experience and satisfaction.
* Provide timely response to customer requests for products, services, and information.
* Ensure generation of weekly status reports.
* Responsible for relevant third-party influencers - contractors, A&D and PM firms, etc. - in relation to client account/projects.

* Develop and execute service contracts and service level agreements.

* Oversee and direct Insidesource implementation of all client projects, work orders, and service requests.
* Review and/or establish work plans, schedules, and logistics.
* Oversee work of all team members, including designers, project managers, account coordinators, delivery, and installation crews.
* Perform project management responsibilities as required, including site visits during installations.
* Provide (and prepare, if required) project and work order status reports.
* Attend project and construction meetings as required.
* Provide exceptional leadership and communication to customer and internal teams.
* Achievement of annual sales goals as established by Manager.

* Manage positive and productive interactions of internal and external teams, including collaboration with subcontractors and manufacturers.
* Manage workload of internal teams to ensure activities are appropriately balanced and supported.
* Provide mentorship and encourage growth and development of team members.

* Participation in weekly Sales Meetings and Monthly Staff Meetings.
* Regular attendance at industry events.

None

* Experience working on RFPs.
* Product knowledge and product specification experience.
* Ability to lead and inspire cross functional players.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22-$23/hr based on experience level
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22-$23/hr based on experience level
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

jobs.title: School Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Flexible schedule
* Home office stipend
* Opportunity for advancement

**We Offer**

* Tutu school onboarding and online training
* Sick pay provided
* Positive company culture
* Additional perks are available!

**Job Summary**  
At Tutu School, we look for magic makers. On our team, we want hearts that never stop twirling and minds that thrive on creativity. We require our teachers to have a strong background in dance, great communication skills, and a commitment to our carefully crafted curriculum. Most of all, we want instructors who are invested in nurturing the big dreams of little dancers.However, this position is unique. We are looking for someone to manage, organize, and host monthly events and birthday parties at our two locations: Burlingame and San Bruno.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, host, manage, organize monthly themed parties, as well as, any booked birthday parties following Tutu School's carefully crafted Class Curriculum.
* Take attendance and answer basic questions about class membership and promotions.
* Build rapport and communication with students' families and prospective clients.
* Perform basic retail duties including product restocking and processing sales using a point-of-sale system.
* Maintain organization and cleanliness of the studio, lobby, retail display, and bathroom.
* Communicate effectively with management and administration.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in dancing with a ballet background is strongly preferred
* High school or equivalent is preferred
* Teaching experience is preferred

**About Tutu School**

* Tutu School is a collection of quaint boutique ballet schools that provides a creative dance education experience for children from 6 months to 8 years old.
* It is a place where students are urged to fully exercise their imaginations as well as their bodies, and where we not only focus on teaching children age-appropriate motor skills and the fundamental principles of ballet but also expose them to the world of classical music and the enchanting stories of famous ballets.

**Our Founding Principle**

* Every child should know what it feels like to dance. We exist to make space in children’s lives for confident creativity and the pure joy that comes from finding oneself in music and movement.

**Tutu Principles**

* **Keep Moving**: Keep dancing. Keep twirling. Keep going. Momentum doesn’t generate itself.
* **Exceed Expectations**: Tutu School families have high expectations. We want to leap over them.
* **Mistakes Happen**: Own them. Understand them. Grow from them.
* **Remember Why**: Tutu School exists to make space in the world for creativity and joy.
* **Next Right Thing**: Find it. Follow it. One right thing at a time.
* **Find The Magic**: Always. In everything you do.

*All Tutu School® locations are independently owned and operated by third-party franchisees. Franchisees, not Tutu School Franchises, LLC., are responsible for all hiring and personnel matters at their individual locations.*

jobs.title: Event & Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing - they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce - where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Event & Community Manager based in Palo Alto to own our West Coast events. This is the founding role for our West Coast events program: you'll build it across the Bay Area and Los Angeles from the ground up, with no existing playbook to inherit and full ownership over how it takes shape. You'll design and run the experiences that bring our customers, prospects, and industry community together, from intimate dinners and executive roundtables to conference presence. You'll also help grow Nectar's community alongside the broader marketing team.

The Bay Area is home base. From Palo Alto to San Francisco, it's where we connect with tech founders, investors, and B2B operators. Los Angeles is where we show up for consumer brands, creators, and agencies. You'll split your time between both and make Nectar a known name in each.

You'll report directly to the marketing leadership team and work closely with sales, customer success, and the founders to make sure every event and community touchpoint ladders up to pipeline, retention, and brand.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Events**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution for Nectar's West Coast event calendar across SF and LA: customer dinners, executive roundtables, happy hours, creator meetups, and conference sponsorships and booths.
* Run account-based event programs with sales: executive dinners and roundtables built around target accounts, with a follow-up plan for every attendee.
* Build a recurring event series in both cities so Nectar has a consistent, recognizable presence in each market.
* Manage budgets, vendors, venues, and logistics in both cities, and build repeatable processes so events scale smoothly as the company grows.
* Partner with sales and customer success on event strategies that generate pipeline and deepen relationships with existing customers.
* Track and report on event ROI (attendance, sourced and influenced pipeline, and customer sentiment), and use that data to sharpen the calendar over time.
* Represent Nectar at West Coast industry conferences and manage on-site logistics, staffing, and sponsor deliverables.

### **Community**

* Support the launch and growth of Nectar's customer and industry community program (e.g., a Slack community, ambassador program, or customer council).
* Help run the content and engagement cadence that keeps the community active: AMAs, office hours, member spotlights, and peer-to-peer discussion.
* Use in-person events to feed the community, turning SF and LA attendees into active members.
* Build authentic relationships with key West Coast customers, creators, and industry voices.
* Identify and cultivate community advocates who can support case studies, referrals, and word-of-mouth growth.
* Feed community insights and feedback back to the product, marketing, and customer success teams.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5-8 years of experience in B2B event marketing, community management, or a hybrid of both, with most of it at B2B SaaS companies.
* A track record of running B2B field and executive events end-to-end, from concept through post-event reporting, that sourced and accelerated pipeline alongside sales.
* Fluency in B2B event measurement: campaign attribution in HubSpot or Salesforce, sourced versus influenced pipeline, and post-event follow-up with target accounts.
* Experience supporting or growing an online or in-person community.
* Based in or near Palo Alto, with working knowledge of the Bay Area and LA event scenes: the venues, the vendors, and the people worth knowing.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in an early-stage environment where processes don't exist yet. You're excited to build them.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple events across two markets without dropping details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a real interest in connecting with people.
* Willingness to travel regularly to San Francisco, Los Angeles, and industry conferences (estimated 20-30%).

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in the social media, marketing technology, or creator economy space.
* Experience marketing to brand, social, or marketing leaders as the buyer.
* An existing network in Bay Area tech and in LA's consumer brand or creator communities.
* Familiarity with community platforms (Slack, Discord, Circle) and event tools (Luma, Bizzabo, HubSpot).
* Prior experience as an early hire at a startup, building a function from zero to one.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and early equity
* Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match
* ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes
* $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees

**For our Palo Alto Office:**

* Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)
* Free lunch in the heart of University

jobs.title: Field Marketing & Community Manager
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Together AI is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build and scale our account-based field and in-person community programs across priority markets.

This role will be responsible for developing the strategy, audience, format, and execution of high-impact field programs designed to engage priority accounts, accelerate pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and build authentic technical community.

You’ll own programs end-to-end, from identifying the right accounts and developing the event concept to driving attendance, managing the attendee experience, partnering with Sales on follow-up, and measuring business impact.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can pair strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You should be just as comfortable building an ABM event strategy with Sales as you are selecting a venue, shaping an agenda, managing a vendor, or reviewing the attendee list the day before an event.

### **Responsibilities**

#### **ABM & Account-Based Events**

* Develop and execute an ABM event strategy aligned to priority segments, accounts, pipeline goals, and sales priorities.
* Develop repeatable account-based field programs for priority accounts and segments, including dinners, roundtables, customer gatherings, and other targeted regional programs.
* Partner closely with Sales to identify the right accounts, stakeholders, and moments in the buying cycle for each program.
* Own account targeting, invitation strategy, registration goals, attendance conversion, and post-event follow-up plans.
* Ensure every program has a clear business objective and defined next step for participating accounts.
* Evaluate program performance based on account engagement, pipeline creation and acceleration, POCs, opportunities, and other meaningful business outcomes.

#### **Community Programs**

* Build and scale Together AI’s community event strategy across key markets.
* Develop meetups, technical gatherings, workshops, partner programs, and other formats that bring together developers, researchers, AI practitioners, customers, and ecosystem partners.
* Partner with DevRel, Research, Product, Engineering, and other technical teams to develop programming that is genuinely useful and relevant to the audience.
* Identify opportunities to partner with customers, investors, technology partners, startups, and community organizations to extend reach and credibility.
* Build repeatable playbooks while ensuring programs still feel authentic to the local community.

#### **End-to-End Program Ownership**

* Own programs from strategy through execution, including concept development, audience strategy, venue sourcing, budget, vendors, registration, attendee communications, run-of-show, onsite execution, and follow-up.
* Manage multiple programs simultaneously while maintaining a high bar for quality and attendee experience.
* Partner with the broader Events team to support select third-party conferences and industry moments where field, community, or account-based activation can extend the impact of Together AI’s presence.
* Partner with Creative and Brand on event identity, environmental design, signage, swag, and other experience touchpoints.
* Develop clear event briefs, timelines, budgets, staffing plans, and cross-functional workbacks.
* Own vendor relationships and negotiate contracts to maximize quality and efficiency.
* Travel as needed to support programs onsite.

#### **Measurement & Optimization**

* Partner with Marketing Ops, Demand Gen, and Sales to ensure programs are properly tracked through Salesforce and our event technology stack.
* Build consistent pre- and post-event reporting that shows who attended, account engagement, pipeline impact, and follow-up status.
* Conduct post-event retrospectives and turn learnings into stronger future programs.
* Use data and qualitative feedback to recommend where we should invest more, change approach, or stop investing.

### **Requirements**

* 5–7+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, ABM, or a related B2B technology marketing role.
* Experience developing and executing account-based programs in close partnership with Sales.
* Strong understanding of how events can support pipeline creation, acceleration, customer expansion, and relationship development.
* Experience creating community or experiential programs for technical audiences.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple complex programs at once.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for attendee experience.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively across Sales, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, DevRel, Research, Creative, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders.
* Comfortable using Salesforce and event/marketing technology to track performance and business impact.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on expected impact, not simply volume of requests.
* High agency and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity.
* Ability to travel up to 30–40% based on event schedules, including international travel.

### **About Together AI**

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

### **Compensation**

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and other benefits. The US base salary range for this full-time position is: $170,000 - $195,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. I

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

BOOTS ON THE GROUND. Check on listings for lights, lockboxes and signage. Meet vendors and inspectors on site. Pick up and make keys. Coordinate staging logistics. Handle broker tour catering and setup.

CLIENT-FACING MOMENTS. You may deal with clients by phone or in person. You will need to be warm, professional and comfortable representing the Marin Home Team.

VENDORS. Schedule inspectors, stagers, photographers and contractors. Manage quotes and project timelines. Maintain our vendor list.

**ADMIN**

EXPENSES. Add my expenses to the team tracker, pay invoices, keep the records straight.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TOOLS. Manage operational subscriptions such as the website, Dropbox and Zoom. Troubleshoot tech issues. Research new tools.

INDUSTRY. Attend Compass meetings and industry events as needed, take notes, keep me informed.

REPORTING. Enter new listings and buyer activity in our business tracker. Monitor Top Agent. Network for inventory and opportunities.

**THE FIRST SIX WEEKS**

My days are genuinely different from one another, and real estate does not run to a tidy schedule. So rather than pretend I know exactly which hours I will need you and get it wrong, the first six weeks are a working trial for both of us.

Part of your job in those six weeks is helping me work out what the rhythm actually is. Which days, which hours, what gets batched, what has to happen live. At the end of it we lock in a schedule that reflects reality, and you will know what you are agreeing to because you helped build it.

If it is not right for either of us at that point, we shake hands and part on good terms.

**WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:**

THE ESSENTIALS

* You are organized in a way other people notice and appreciate
* You are a problem solver who anticipates what is needed before being asked
* You are comfortable with technology and pick up new tools quickly
* You communicate clearly, professionally and warmly
* You can work independently and manage your own time
* You are based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley daily. This role needs you physically present here on a regular basis
* You have strong computer skills: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Claude, and a willingness to learn whatever else comes

NICE TO HAVE

* Previous experience in real estate operations, or somewhere similarly client-facing and
* detail-heavy
* Comfort with CRM systems. Compass experience is a bonus and not a requirement
* Marketing or design skills
* Social media experience
* Experience with DocuSign, Dropbox, Slack or other project manageme

Ensure that Johnson Controls resources and our subcontractor/vendor resources are adhering to the site/JCI safety policies, whichever is more stringent.

Manage risks and establish project recovery plans when required. Resolve disputes with minimal need for escalation.

Prepare RFPs, negotiate, and issue subcontracts.

Ensure project document controls comply with contract requirements and JCI standards.

Oversee project construction for compliance with specifications, local codes, and installation techniques.

Manage the selection, ordering, and delivery schedule of materials to be procured for the projects assigned.

Develop and maintain viable long-term relationships with customers, consultants, prime contractors, and subcontractors. Attend job progress meetings as required. Ensure subcontractors understand project expectations.

Provide feedback on the performance of Engineers and Designers to Engineering and Design Team Leaders as well as Operations Management.

Bachelor’s degree in Construction, Civil/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or Architecture is preferred. ### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

#### **Overview**

We're looking for someone exceptionally sharp who treats a funnel like a puzzle to solve. Ideal backgrounds include: Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Web Growth, or Growth Product roles, especially at high-growth consumer or prosumer companies where experimentation is a way of life. You could also be one of the first marketers at a startup, or come from an equivalent role like biz ops or growth analytics with experience building from 0 to 1. We care more about how you think and how much you own than about whether you've done this exact job before.

#### **About the Role**

At Verkada, we're known to push traditional boundaries, and our B2B growth efforts are no exception. We're reinventing Growth here. As a **Growth Marketing Manager, Organic & Conversion**, you'll be part of a high-performing team with backgrounds spanning investment banking, consulting, marketing, and high-growth startups. In this role, you'll own verkada.com as a revenue engine and the warm email programs that turn interest into pipeline. You'll build our organic and AI search engine from the ground up, run experiments on every page and form that matters, and make sure every lead gets the right next step. This is a highly visible, high-autonomy role that offers the opportunity to directly influence how Verkada converts demand into revenue.
