* **Measurement & Signals:** Define the conversion events that matter and make sure tracking is clean.
* **Cross-Department Collaboration:** Work closely with data science, marketing operations, web and design, product marketing, marketing development representatives (MDRs), and sales. Share learnings across teams to drive continuous improvement.

#### **What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth product, biz ops, a startup or equivalent. Consumer or prosumer growth experience highly preferred.
* A track record of owning a number and moving it, with fast promotions or expanding scope to show for it.
* Strong experimentation judgment: you have run A/B tests yourself and can explain why you chose them.
* A working understanding of how SEO and AEO work, and real curiosity about where AI search is going. Deep specialist expertise is not required.

* Familiarity with the AI ecosystem and how enterprises adopt AI products

$255,000 - $320,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success

============================

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our team. This role is a unique opportunity to be a part of the early Rec team and help define the operations, business strategy, and culture of the organization. You will work closely with best-in-class operations, sales, product, and engineering leaders across the company.

You will primarily be responsible for managing everything it takes to make each city partnership a success. This includes developing deep relationships with city partners and acting as their voice internally, driving adoption of new AI-powered features, and building the processes needed to ensure existing city deployments thrive and grow into upsell opportunities.

This is a role for the client operations “athlete”, a voracious learner that wants exposure to all aspects of our B2B SaaS business and is relentlessly resourceful in achieving their goals. You should be client-obsessed and ready to build solutions to whatever challenge a city is facing. This is a strategic role and we will give you both the freedom and responsibility to become the domain expert trusted to make the right calls. However, this is also a hands-on early stage role where strategic insight comes from putting in the execution work yourself.

Who You Are:

* 5+ years working in Customer Success at a tech company or startup, at a top consulting firm or finance firm, or a combination of both.
* You have strong client-services experience. You’re cool under pressure in front of senior client stakeholders and know how to manage key relationships
* You are a strong communicator. You can crisply communicate actionable data-driven insights and pitch tailored solutions to solve customers’ problems
* You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first principles approach to solving them
* You have exceptional project management skills. You can juggle multiple complex projects in flight and can reprioritize quickly

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x'd engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world's first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

THE TEAM

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We're backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

CORE PRINCIPLES

TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers' requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

ACTION: GET IT DONE.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

YOUR ROLE

As a Customer Success Manager at Rox, you'll own the post-go-live customer lifecycle: adoption, health, risk recovery, and expansion readiness. You'll work across Guided and lower-touch accounts so Growth Strategists and FDEs can stay focused on high-stakes managed launches and technical delivery.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You'll run a clear operating cadence with accounts, keep utilization and value evidence visible, and catch leading indicators before they become churn. You'll partner closely with AEs when accounts are ready for expansion, and with Product and Engineering when post-sales signal should change the roadmap.

If you believe retention is earned through product value rather than promises, and you want to help build Customer Success at an agentic revenue platform from the ground up, we'd love to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own a book of post-go-live accounts through Momentum, Growing, At-Risk, and Active Expansion stages with clear success criteria per account
* Drive adoption and proof of value in the first period after go-live: consumption ramping, value evidence captured, and adjacent-team introductions while goodwill is highest
* Run the steady-state rhythm for healthy accounts: QBRs with exec sponsors, live org maps, and a committed rate of qualified expansion opportunities passed to AEs
* Diagnose At-Risk accounts early, own a dated recovery plan, and pause expansion plays until the health bar is met
* Partner with Growth Strategists and FDEs on handoffs so customers always know who owns them and what "good" looks like next
* Establish a reliable internal and customer operating cadence: standups, office hours, metrics reviews, and crisp written updates
* Turn post-sales signal into roadmap and docs input with Product and Engineering
* Build the playbooks and reporting that make time-to-value and health management repeatable as the book scales

QUALIFICATIONS

* 3+ years in customer success or post-sales, with ownership of retention, utilization, or expansion outcomes
* Track record managing relationships with VP-level stakeholders or above
* Strong balance of strategic thinking and operational execution; comfortable moving from an exec QBR to a deployment debug in the same day
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable time-to-value and turn healthy usage into expansion pipeline
* Deep empathy for enterprise customers and a passion for helping them succeed
* Strong analytical mindset; fluent working with metrics, success criteria, and customer data
* Experience with technical or AI-native products; able to speak credibly to current trends and tools
* STEM degree or quantitative background preferred
* Previous experience in consulting, banking, or similar structured environments is a plus
* Be located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

BENEFITS

* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
* Health Insurance

APPLY

To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer

As a **Customer Success Engineer** at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

**Your Role and Impact:**

* **Onboarding Ownership:** Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.
* **Success Planning:** Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.
* **Value Articulation:** Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.
* **Proactive Engagement:** Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.
* **Technical Credibility:** Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

**This Role is a Fit for You If:**

* **Proven Post-Sales Experience:** You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.
* **Technical Credibility:** You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.
* **Stakeholder Range:** You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.
* **Structured and Proactive:** You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.
* **Commercial Awareness:** You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

**Bonus Points For:**

* Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure.
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.
* Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector - where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.
* Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.
* Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

**About vCluster Labs**
-----------------------

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs

* Ability to learn to identify trees and shrubs common to the region, diagnose pests and diseases, and recommend corrective action or proactive management plans
* Valid driver's license
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Degree in Arboriculture, Forestry, Horticulture, Turfgrass, Environmental Science, Plant Science, Outdoor Recreation, Agriculture or a related field is preferred but not required

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Full time • San Francisco, CA • $80K – $90K base • $130K – $160K OTE**

Parameter builds AI agents that do offensive security work. Our agents run autonomous penetration tests against production applications and cloud environments, finding IDORs, broken access control, XSS, and infrastructure misconfigurations that scanners miss and that human pentest firms only look for once or twice a year.

We are not a theoretical security company. Our team has responsibly disclosed real, high-severity vulnerabilities to well-known technology companies, and our findings are the front door to most of our customer relationships.

Our best conversations start the same way: we find something real in a prospect's environment and tell them about it. You'll own the top of that funnel. That means researching accounts, working with the security team on what we found, and writing the outbound that makes a CISO reply within the hour.

This is not a role where you read a script into a dialer. The people you're emailing break software for a living and can tell within one line whether you understand their problem. You'll need to learn enough security to be credible: what an IDOR is, why broken access control is the thing that keeps them up, and why a once-a-year pentest doesn't cover a codebase that ships daily.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own outbound to security and engineering leaders: build the account list, write the sequences, and run the follow-up
* Turn our vulnerability research into first meetings. When we find something real, you're the reason the right person hears about it
* Book and prepare qualified calls for the founders, and sit in on them until you're running discovery yourself
* Keep the CRM honest. Clean data, accurate stages, and a pipeline number nobody has to caveat
* Close the loop on messaging. Tell us which lines land, which segments convert, and what we should stop saying

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 1+ years of outbound sales development, ideally into technical buyers, or a track record that makes the case some other way
* You write well. Short, specific, and free of the phrasing every other vendor in their inbox is using
* Genuine curiosity about security. You do not need a background in it, but you do need to want one
* Comfort with rejection and with volume. The job is a lot of activity and a small number of very good conversations
* You build your own leverage: research workflows, enrichment, automation, whatever gets you more at-bats without more hours
* Bonus: sold into security or developer tools, worked at an early-stage startup, or hold a security certification

**Interview process (3 rounds)**
--------------------------------

* Intro call with a founder (30 minutes)
* Written exercise and mock call (10 minutes)
* Paid work trial (1 day)
* References and offer

You'll have the founders on your calls, the research team feeding you reasons to reach out, and a product that proves itself in the first engagement. We move quickly and aim to make an offer within two weeks of first contact.

*This role is onsite in San Francisco. You must be authorized to work in the US; we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.*

jobs.description:
**Great marketing gets attention. Great customer engagement turns that attention into action.**

Our Campbell team works with nationally recognized brands to create customer-focused campaigns that build brand awareness, connect with new audiences, and drive measurable results. We’re looking for a Sales & Marketing Assistant to join our team and support promotional campaigns for a leading telecommunications provider in local retail locations.

This is an entry-level, hands-on opportunity for someone interested in marketing, communications, sales, and working directly with customers. You’ll learn how a campaign comes to life, from the way a brand is presented to how customers respond and ultimately make purchasing decisions.

**Responsibilities of the Sales and Marketing Assistant**

* Learn the goals behind each campaign and how the brand is positioned for different customer audiences.
* Communicate campaign messaging in a way that captures attention and encourages customers to learn more.
* Support sales conversations by connecting customer interests with relevant products, services, and current offers.
* Pay attention to customer questions and reactions to understand how people respond to brand messaging and promotions.
* Share customer feedback with other Sales and Marketing Assistant team members to help strengthen campaign communication and brand presentation.
* Build practical experience connecting marketing activity, customer engagement, and sales performance to overall brand growth.

**What We’re Looking For in the Sales and Marketing Assistant**

* Strong communication and people skills.
* Someone who enjoys meeting and talking with new people.
* A genuine interest in marketing, sales, communications, or customer engagement.
* Positive, outgoing, and comfortable interacting with customers in person.
* Goal-oriented and motivated to learn.
* Coachable, adaptable, and able to work well in a team.
* Previous experience in sales, retail, hospitality, marketing, or customer service is a plus, but not required.

**What You’ll Gain**

You’ll get hands-on experience seeing how marketing, customer engagement, and sales work together in a real-world environment. You’ll also have the opportunity to build valuable communication, customer service, and professional skills while working with an established telecommunications brand.

If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can learn, interact with people, build your communication skills, and grow professionally, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply today to join our Campbell team as a Sales & Marketing Assistant!**

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SPD Assistant Project Manager | High End Residential GC
jobs.description:
**Join MatPel Builders as a Assistant Project Manager and help shape some of the most stunning homes in the Bay Area.**

MatPel Builders is a premier general contractor based in the San Francisco Bay Area, specializing in architecturally significant, high-end residential construction. Our portfolio includes modern custom homes, historic renovations, complex remodels, and structural retrofits, each reflecting exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and close collaboration with our clients and project partners.

The Special Projects Division (SPD) is a dynamic and essential part of MatPel. Built on a commitment to exceptional client service and operational excellence, SPD provides continued care for our portfolio of completed homes while managing service and maintenance work, warranty projects, and small to medium-sized renovations. Through these relationships, SPD also creates opportunities for referrals, repeat business, and new project development.

The SPD Assistant Project Manager supports the full project lifecycle, from responding to new project inquiries and evaluating business development opportunities through preconstruction, estimating, execution, and closeout. Working under the direction of the SPD Manager within the Project Management department, the APM develops scopes of work, budgets, and schedules; coordinates with clients, trade partners, and internal teams; and helps manage projects through completion while maintaining established budgets, schedules, and quality standards.

This role requires someone who can effectively manage multiple active projects, service requests, and evolving client needs while delivering a consistently high level of responsiveness and customer service. The SPD APM will also contribute to the continued growth of the division by building strong client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and supporting referrals and repeat business.

Success in this position requires strong organization, communication, judgment, and follow-through, along with the ability to shift between immediate service needs and longer-term project and business development priorities.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES – Project Lifecycle**

**Estimating & Business Development**

* Support and/or lead the business development process with input from the SPD team.
* Identify project phases, details, existing conditions, and requirements that may present potential problems.
* Communicate SPD processes and project requirements to Clients, Architects, Subcontractors and Field Personnel.
* Prepare and/or review estimates with input from Field Personnel.
* Generate and distribute subcontractor walk invitations, and facilitate project job walks.
* Lead or support the subcontractor selection process.
* Develop and/or review the initial project schedule.
* Prepare, review, and approve service, maintenance, warranty, and construction pricing as appropriate.
* Ensure estimates accurately reflect project scope, anticipated requirements, and subcontractor work.

  

**Contract Administration & Project Set-Up**

* Prepare, review, and administer Service Agreements, contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders.
* Complete project setup documentation and coordinate with accounting to establish project numbers.
* Review the final project budget with the SPD team.
* Confirm subcontractors and coordinate project startup and scheduling.
* Maintain familiarity with all phases and terms of project contracts, estimates, and subcontracts.
* Attend and/or lead preconstruction meetings, site walks, and vendor meetings as required.
* Compile and maintain the project directory.
* Procure and/or coordinate required permits.
* Ensure the project is properly organized and prepared prior to the start of construction.

  

**Project Management & Construction**

* Manage and/or support the project from initial pricing through completion.
* Ensure project scope, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements are actively monitored and managed.
* Maintain and update the project schedule and communicate schedule information to the project team.
* Communicate regularly with the Site Superintendent/Foreman and SPD team.
* Attend and/or facilitate jobsite, OAC, and project meetings as required.
* Facilitate communication between Clients, project team members, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate material ordering, pickup, delivery, and long-lead-time items with the Site Superintendent/Foreman.
* Plan and facilitate the shop drawing and submittal process.
* Assist with subcontractor scheduling and coordination.
* Provide cost and financial information to the project team.
* Maintain complete and well-organized project documentation, including contracts, schedules, change orders, submittals, RFIs, invoices, and other pertinent information.
* Maintain project folders, binders, and electronic documentation.
* Create, review, process, and track change orders, submittals, and RFIs.
* Review subcontractor change orders and prepare them for Client approval as required.
* Auditing of monthly invoices for accuracy and submit them to the Client for payment.
* Review and monitor project budgets, cost tracking, cost projections, and overall job status.
* Identify and communicate project risks, potential issues, and required decisions in a timely manner.
* Ensure key project decisions and contract changes are clearly communicated and documented.
* Administer contract documents and take appropriate steps to identify and mitigate project risk.

  

**Scheduling & Field Coordination**

* Coordinate project meetings, appointments, site visits, and other scheduled activities.
* Send calendar invitations to appropriate project participants and ensure Clients and project stakeholders are aware of scheduled visits.
* Work closely with the Site Superintendent/Foreman to coordinate subcontractor activities and material deliveries.
* Assist with the weekly labor schedule (SIP) for SPD field employe

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**

**Position Purpose:**

The Program Coordinator serves as administrative and operational support for assigned data center commissioning projects for a particular client. This role supports and coordinates various aspects of complex commissioning projects to ensure on-time/budget delivery and client satisfaction. This is NOT a technical field role, success requires strong project management, financial acumen, team relationship skills.

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Administrative tasks for assigned programs - Process administrative requests; maintain project records; support program coordination; ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Project financials and performance - Monitor, and reconcile project budgets; track costs and expenditures; identify budget variances and cost overruns; ensure accurate project profitability tracking; prepare financial reports for leadership and clients.
* Project schedules and milestones - Understand project schedules maintained by PM; monitor project progress against SoW and milestone schedule; maintain communication for project activities across technical teams and sub-consultants.
* Documentation and records - Support organization of project files and folders; ensure accurate project records; support project closeout and lessons learned documentation.
* Project status reports - Develop monthly project status reports; support development of reports for leadership and clients; track key performance indicators; identify trends and issues.
* Client meetings and program activities - Support client / team meetings and workshops - invites and minutes; prepare meeting agendas and materials; track meeting decisions and action items.
* Technical teams and sub-consultants - Work with technical Project Managers/Commissioning Managers on milestone / task assignments; communicate assignments and scheduled work.
* Change orders and contract modifications - Support change order proposals and workflow; track status of pending and approved change orders.
* Proposal development and pricing - Enter sales leads into Salesforce and support with proposal development; manage proposal process.
* Process improvement - Support standardized processes and deliverables; collaborate with other Program Managers on cross-program issues.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education/Experience/Background:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Project Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3+ years of project coordination, operations, or business coordination experience.
* 3+ years coordinating project budgets, schedules, and financial tracking.
* 2+ years in a fast-paced, technical environment (data center, commissioning, or similar).
* Experience with change order management and contract administration.
* Experience with client program management and stakeholder communication.
* Experience with proposal development and pricing.
* Working knowledge of the commissioning process (Pre-Design, Design, Commissioning, Post-Turnover).
* Experience in AI tools such as Gemini Notebook, chat agents, and/or agent builders.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Excellent project coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong financial acumen and budget management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with project management tools (Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar).
* Proficiency with financial tools (Excel, accounting software).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Attention to detail and accuracy (especially financial).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Great PC and Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to navigate through a variety of computer applications.
* High level of professionalism and integrity,
* Excellent typing skills.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Data center operations or commissioning program management.
* Smartsheet or similar collaborative project management tools.
* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).
* Consulting or professional services environment.
* Background in PMO (Project Management Office) or program coordination.
* Contract administration and legal document review.

  
**Additional Information**

**Pay Range:** $70000 to $80000 Per Hour.

**Benefits:** Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

Sick leave – 56 hours; Observed Holidays – 11 days; Vacation – 15 days

Eligible for up to 5% Annual Performance Bonus

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

About Us:

**Welcome to Hudson Regional Health**

**Technology Transforming Care**

Hudson Regional Health is a newly unified healthcare network serving Hudson County through four hospitals.

Together, these hospitals form a single, integrated system with a shared vision—to deliver modern, patient-first care supported by innovation. From robotic-assisted surgery and AI-powered diagnostics to real-time monitoring and precision neurosurgery, HRH is redefining what’s possible in community healthcare.

Patients across the region now have access to state-of-the-art procedures and nationally recognized specialists, all within a connected, local network designed to put care first.

**Our Services**

We focus on the care our patients need most, delivered with precision, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.

* Advanced Emergency Services - 24/7 emergency departments across all four hospitals
* Robotic-Assisted Surgery - featuring the Da Vinci XI and ExcelsiusGPS systems
* Neurosurgery & Spine Care - including Stealth Navigation and precision-guided treatment
* Women’s Health & Maternity -comprehensive services tailored for every stage
* Imaging & Diagnostics - AI-enhanced systems for faster, more accurate results
* Outpatient & Specialty Care - coordinated care across multiple disciplines

Explore our hospitals and discover care that’s high-tech, high-touch, and close to home:

* Secaucus University Hospital, Flagship campus featuring the Robotic Surgery Institute and modernized emergency care.

What You'll Be Doing:

The **LPN – Patient Program Coordinator** is responsible for coordinating day-to-day program operations and overseeing patient flow to ensure an efficient, organized, and positive patient experience. * Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment and adapt to changing program needs.

jobs.title: Residence Program Specialist - Morning
jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Digital Skilling Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Description: **Who We Are:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) is the nation's premier Latino nonprofit membership organization. Founded in 1990, HF supports Hispanic families and strengthens Latino institutions through grantmaking and direct services in the areas of education, health, immigration, civic engagement, economic empowerment and the environment. Values that drive our work include equality, fairness, diversity, and empathy.

Technological advancements are changing the workforce requirements of our economy. According to Brookings, nearly two-thirds of all new jobs created since 2010 required either high or medium level digital skills. Latinos make up 18% of the overall U.S. labor market and account for approximately one out of every two new workers entering the workforce in 2025 but also make up 35% of workers with no digital skills; 20% of those with limited skills; and only 8% of all STEM jobs. Hispanic Federation's Digital Skilling Program seeks to address these issues through community-based workforce development and technology trainings.

  

**Who we seek:**

Hispanic Federation (HF) seeks a Digital Skilling Program Coordinator to help manage and contribute to HF’s Workforce Initiatives programmatic efforts aimed at increasing the financial security of Latino families. Under the supervision of the Workforce Initiatives Program Manager, the coordinator will be instrumental in supporting administrative and reporting duties for a technology program running three (3) cycles a year at three (3) locations within New York City. The coordinator will learn the intricacies of community outreach, workforce development, program management, technology training programs, digital adoption programs, and poverty reduction efforts.

  

The successful candidate is detail-oriented and has experience and interest in technology training programs, workforce development, and nonprofits. The position requires a high attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to increasing workforce development opportunities to underserved communities.

  

**Position Location:** New York, NY

**Reports to:** Workforce Initiatives Program Manager

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming and active program participants providing guidance through the entire program lifecycle and tracking attendance and engagement
* Coordinate day-to-today logistics across site locations for program cycles
* Weekly travel within New York City to the Bronx, Queens and Manhattan
* Prepare, organize, and update digital and physical course materials and cohort schedules
* Administer, distribute, and collect mid-cohort and closeout evaluation surveys; organize qualitative feedback and quantitative ratings into summary decks
* Travel nationally once a year to participate in a train-the-trainer program
* Manage regular communication with program leadership and stakeholders to provide updates on program health, and/or additional support
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely program activity reports
* Ensure compliance with all reporting requirements and prepare programmatic reports
* Serve as point of contact to other program service providers, grantees, and consultants, monitoring performance, funding, and payments
Complete additional tasks as assigned  

  

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a bachelor's degree and demonstrated knowledge of non-profit programs and services within underserved low-income communities preferably centered around digital equity and workforce development
* At least one (1) year of professional experience in administration, logistics, adult education and / or program management
* Excellent technology skills; experience with Office 365, conference platforms, and third-party databases
* Efficient, detail-oriented and organized
* Ability to multi-task and balance assignments from more than one staff person
* Strong, well-developed verbal and writing skills
* Exceptional ability to work with others and develop trust with partner agencies, staff and program participants
* Commitment to Hispanic Federation's mission and core values
* Willingness to learn new technology programs, including AI tools and the Swift Programming Language
* Familiarity with Apple products and systems is a plus, but not required
Fluency in written and spoken Spanish is a plus, but not required  

  

**Compensation**

The salary for this position is $55,000. Compensation includes fully subsidized medical, dental, vision insurance accessible on first day of employment; access to flexible spending for medical and transportation; and a 403 (B) retirement plan with a company match after 6 months of service.

**To Apply**

Please submit a résumé and cover letter detailing your interest and qualifications via the dedicated link. No telephone calls or emails will be accepted regarding this position. Only specific candidates will be contacted regarding their application for this role.

**Research Coordinator**
========================

The Research Coordinator serves as the Core Imaging Laboratory (CIL) Manager for the Chronic Subdural Hematoma Treatment with Embolization Versus Surgery Study (CHESS), a multicenter clinical trial within the Department of Medicine at RWJBarnabas Health. The CIL Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of centralized imaging workflows and serves as a critical connection between participating study sites, the Central Imaging Laboratory, and the study team.

By coordinating the acquisition, verification, processing, secure storage, and quality control of clinical imaging data, the CIL Manager helps ensure the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance of imaging data used in clinical research. This role works closely with study investigators and participating sites to maintain protocol adherence, support blinded analysis, and ensure imaging workflows remain consistent, efficient, and audit-ready throughout the study.

**A Typical Day:**
------------------

As a Research Coordinator, a typical day might include the following:

* Coordinating the acquisition, transfer, verification, and secure storage of CT imaging data from participating clinical trial sites.
* Managing day-to-day imaging workflows within the centralized, independent Core Imaging Laboratory.
* Serving as the primary point of contact between participating study sites and the Central Imaging Laboratory regarding imaging submissions and study requirements.
* Reviewing incoming imaging data for completeness, accuracy, quality, and compliance with study protocols.
* Performing quality checks on submitted imaging studies and identifying missing, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
* Communicating with site personnel to resolve imaging discrepancies and ensure appropriate data submissions.
* Overseeing image processing workflows using imaging technologies and platforms such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* Monitoring adherence to imaging acquisition and submission protocols across participating study sites.
* Ensuring imaging workflows comply with study requirements, institutional policies, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation related to imaging submissions, quality checks, processing, and study activities.
* Ensuring compliance with blinded image analysis procedures and maintaining the confidentiality and security of clinical research data.
* Preparing and batching imaging datasets for independent analysis in accordance with study protocols.
* Supporting regulatory documentation, reporting requirements, and study deliverables in coordination with the research team.
* Assisting with training and onboarding participating site personnel on imaging submission procedures, requirements, and workflows.
* Maintaining secure imaging archives in accordance with institutional policies and applicable NIH and research standards.
* Monitoring the overall imaging workflow to identify operational issues and implement appropriate solutions in collaboration with the study team.
* Collaborating with the Clinical Review Committee (CRC) Manager to ensure continuity of Core Imaging Laboratory operations when the CIL Manager is unavailable.
* Supporting other clinical research activities, operational needs, and study-related assignments as directed.

**This Role Might Be For You If:**
----------------------------------

* You are passionate about clinical research and are interested in contributing to studies that improve the treatment and outcomes of patients with neurological conditions.
* You have a strong understanding of clinical research processes and the importance of accurate, reliable, and secure research data.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing complex imaging workflows involving multiple clinical trial sites.
* You understand the importance of following study protocols and maintaining consistent processes across a multicenter clinical trial.
* You have strong attention to detail and can identify discrepancies, missing information, and quality issues within clinical imaging data.
* You are comfortable communicating with physicians, research staff, imaging personnel, and participating study sites.
* You can work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and collaborate with investigators and members of the study team.
* You are comfortable working with medical imaging systems and technologies such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* You understand the importance of confidentiality, blinded analysis, data security, and regulatory compliance in clinical research.
* You are able to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet study timelines.
* You have strong analytical, organizational, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
* You are interested in neurosurgery, neurology, neuroradiology, neurovascular conditions, or related areas of clinical research.
* You are comfortable supporting training, troubleshooting, and workflow coordination across multiple participating research sites.
* You value collaboration and understand the importance of maintaining contin

jobs.title: Scheduler & Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
A New York City Council member, representing District 4 , is seeking an enthusiastic and highly organized Scheduler & Office Operations Coordinator. The individual will oversee the Council Member’s daily and long-term schedule, field meeting requests, and support office operations as needed, to ensure the Council Member’s time reflects office priorities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Executive Assistant:

* Provide day-to-day executive assistance to the Council Member, including managing her correspondence and email inbox, keeping her on schedule, and tracking follow-up items from meetings and routing them to the appropriate staff.
* Prepare the Member for each engagement by assembling and maintaining the weekly briefing binder, writing briefing memos that cover attendees, background, key issues and talking points, and compiling relevant legislation and prior meeting notes.

Scheduling:

* Manage the Council Member's daily and forward calendar, including meetings, site visits, hearings, events and occasional travel, while reviewing incoming requests, maintaining holds and RSVPs, and confirming logistics with outside parties.
* Prepare a daily schedule each evening with locations, contacts, timing and materials, handle last-minute changes with professionalism, and coordinate with the Chief of Staff and the legislative and communications teams so the calendar reflects office priorities.

Office Operations Coordination:

* Manage the district office's day-to-day operations, including triaging the general inbox, voicemail and mail, ensuring phones are answered from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and maintaining shared calendars, filing systems, contact lists, and productivity and task management systems in coordination with the Chief of Staff.
* Order office supplies before stock runs low, track non-personnel (OTPS) spending, coordinate with building management, vendors and IT on equipment and facility needs, and lead by example in keeping the office, kitchen and common areas clean and professional.
* Oversee weekly staff meeting agendas in coordination with the Council Member and team, provide hands-on logistical support to the Community Liaison team for public-facing events, from identifying venues to stakeholder outreach, and support the Chief of Staff with office procedures and additional administrative projects as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience as an executive assistant, scheduler, office manager, or in a similar administrative role; experience in a government, political, or nonprofit office a plus.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong writing skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise briefing memos on short notice.
* Sound judgment, discretion, responsiveness, and professionalism in handling confidential information and high-profile contacts.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable working with elected officials, agency staff, and community leaders from diverse backgrounds.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and calendar management tools.
* Familiarity with NYC government, City agencies, and the District 4 community preferred.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:**

New York City residency is required within 90 days of appointment.

**For eligible employees, health, dental and vision insurance coverage are offered upon hire. Retirement plans, deferred compensation plans, group life insurance, paid time off and paid holidays, training resources, health & fitness reimbursement and wellness programs are also available.**

The New York City Council makes reasonable accommodation for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact EEOOfficer@council.nyc.gov.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Qualified candidates should forward their cover letter indicating your match to the stated job requirements and your resume to:

**E-MAIL:** D04Jobs@council.nyc.gov

**MAIL:** New York City Council

Attn: Personnel Services/Recruiting (S&OO)

250 Broadway, 26th Floor

New York, New York 10007

**FAX:**  12124014711

**Job Description**

About the Agency:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.  
  
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.
  
  
HPD’s Office of Policy and Strategy (OPS) leverages its expertise to guide and support HPD and its many offices in their efforts to deepen their impact, optimize their efficiency, and become more data-driven, climate-adaptive, and mission-focused. To do so, OPS collaborates with staff and senior leadership from across the agency, as well as with representatives from other Agencies. * People skills with the ability to build relationships, influence others to achieve outcomes and thrive in a team environment;
* Attention to detail and ability to adapt and work under pressure and restrictive deadlines, in an atmosphere of intense activity;

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JCCA** is one of New York’s **leading child welfare and children’s behavioral health organizations**, serving thousands of children, youth, and families each year. Through preventive services, foster care, behavioral health, residential programs, education, and community-based supports, we help children and families thrive.

We are seeking a **dynamic, relationship-oriented Outreach Coordinator** to expand awareness of JCCA’s programs, strengthen community partnerships, and develop referral opportunities across our child welfare and behavioral health services.

This is a highly visible, community-facing role for someone who enjoys **building relationships, connecting people and organizations to resources, and creating partnerships that make a difference.** The Outreach Coordinator will serve as an ambassador for JCCA, developing relationships with schools, healthcare providers, community organizations, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders throughout New York City, with a particular focus on the **Bronx and Brooklyn**.

### **Summary of Responsibilities**

**Build Community Partnerships**

* Develop and maintain relationships with community organizations, schools, healthcare providers, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders.
* Represent JCCA at community meetings, conferences, networking events, resource fairs, and public forums.
* Conduct presentations and informational sessions to increase awareness of JCCA programs and services.
* Identify opportunities to develop new partnerships and strengthen existing relationships.
* Maintain regular communication and follow-up with community partners.

**Community Engagement & Referral Development**

* Support outreach efforts connecting children, youth, and families with JCCA’s child welfare, behavioral health, educational, and family support services.
* Partner with program leadership to understand service priorities, referral needs, and opportunities for growth.
* Identify community resources, service gaps, emerging needs, and potential referral pathways, particularly in the Bronx and Brooklyn.
* Monitor community feedback and referral activity to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities to improve access to services.
* Support culturally responsive outreach to diverse and underserved communities.

**Program Promotion & Outreach Coordination**

* Collaborate with program and communications teams to promote JCCA’s services and community resources.
* Assist with outreach materials, presentations, campaigns, special events, and other engagement initiatives.
* Share feedback and recommendations with program leadership to inform outreach and engagement strategies.
* Maintain accurate records of community contacts, referral sources, outreach activities, and partnership opportunities.
* Track outreach activities and follow-up and prepare regular updates for leadership.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, Public Health, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* At least **3 years of experience** in community outreach, business development, community relations, behavioral health, healthcare, child welfare, education, nonprofit organizations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong organization, follow-through, and project coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM/database systems.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Bilingual Spanish/English strongly preferred.**
* Experience in child welfare, behavioral health, healthcare, education, or other family-serving systems.
* Familiarity with New York City communities, particularly the Bronx and Brooklyn.
* Experience presenting to community groups or professional audiences.

### **Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel throughout New York City, including the Bronx and Brooklyn, **at least weekly**.
* Valid driver’s license and/or ability to travel independently using public transportation.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for community events, partner meetings, and outreach activities.
* Commitment to JCCA’s mission and dedication to serving children, youth, and families.

### **Why Join JCCA?**

At JCCA, your work helps strengthen the connection between children, families, and the services they need. This is an opportunity to build meaningful community partnerships, expand access to critical services, and make a lasting impact.

**If you are an energetic relationship builder who enjoys being out in the community and creating opportunities for children and families, we want to hear from you!**

**Compensation:** $67,000 annually

jobs.title: Network Finance Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Finance Operations Specialist**
=================================

**The Organization**

Prospect Schools is a high-performing, intentionally diverse K-12 college preparatory charter network serving more than 3,000 students in nine schools in Brooklyn. Prospect Schools models its curriculum on the renowned International Baccalaureate Program, a rigorous program that raises the level of academic responsibility for students while also preparing them to be global citizens.

Our experienced team is dedicated to our mission to prepare a diverse student body to have a positive impact on society and develop a lifelong passion for learning, and guided by our Core Values:

* **Curiosity**: Develop sound judgment and intellect by asking questions confidently and thinking critically
* **Care**: Support others by grounding every action in empathy while championing equity and inclusion
* **Persistence**: Grow and learn by solving problems with determination, creativity and tenacity
* **Passion**: Succeed by approaching challenges with excitement, enthusiasm and self-assurance

We have a vision to become, by 2030, the leading network of intentionally diverse schools where all students and educators can learn, work and thrive. Find out more about who we are and what we believe by spending a few minutes reading our 2025 Annual Report.

**The Role**
------------

The Finance Operations Specialist supports day-to-day financial operations, procurement coordination, grant administration, and contract management functions across the network and schools. This role serves as a key operational partner to central office teams and school based leaders by supporting transaction management, troubleshooting financial processes, monitoring grant-related spending, and coordinating vendor and resource management systems.

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

### ***Finance Operations***

* Support network and school operations stakeholders in executing day-to-day finance transactions in support of programming

In this role, you’ll manage a portfolio of small and medium-sized business (SMB) clients with lower contract values, taking ownership of their renewal, retention and growth with WGSN.

This is a high-volume account management role, so being organized, commercially focused and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once will be critical. Your primary focus will be retaining existing revenue, identifying risk early and finding opportunities to grow accounts through additional products, teams or longer-term partnerships where there is a clear client need.

* Manage an SMB Portfolio: Own a portfolio of small and medium-sized clients across lower contract values, balancing multiple accounts, renewal cycles and commercial opportunities at the same time.

* Prioritize Effectively: Manage a high volume of accounts efficiently, knowing where deeper engagement is needed and where a more streamlined commercial approach is appropriate.
* Build Client Relationships: Develop relationships with key users and decision-makers across your accounts, understanding their priorities and ensuring WGSN continues to demonstrate value.
* Communicate WGSN’s Value: Deliver engaging product demonstrations, presentations and commercial proposals tailored to clients across industries including Fashion, Beauty, Food & Drink, Interiors and Consumer Tech.
* Maintain an Accurate Pipeline: Keep Salesforce current and accurate, including opportunities, client notes, next steps, close dates and forecasts, providing clear visibility into the health and performance of your portfolio.
* Work Collaboratively: Partner with colleagues across Account Management, Client Services, Product and other teams to support clients while maintaining ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Meet Clients Locally: Build relationships through in-person client engagement where it adds value, primarily across New York City and the Tri-State area.

This list is not exhaustive, and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

**Skills, Experience & Qualifications Required**

* B2B Sales or Account Management Experience: Ideally 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, customer growth or another commercial role.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. * Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions

The Omnichannel Customer Development & Client Relations Management (CDCRM) team is a newer, retail-facing team focused on customer acquisition and retention through Analytics, CRM, After Sales, Client Services, and Experience. The focus of the team is to reach new and existing clients through the sales and service ceremony, bespoke services, smart analytics, and animations all to strengthen acquisition and customer loyalty. The multifaceted team works in tandem to drive traffic to stores and provide one-of-a-kind experiences.

The Internship Program:

For more than 185 years, Hermès has encouraged a culture of discovery for our clients and our people. We invite you to contribute to this legacy while exploring your own professional future. Discover new opportunities and expand your passions with the Hermès US internship program, Generation H!

As part of Generation H, you will have the opportunity to join Hermès and gain real-world, professional experience as a complement to your academic studies. In addition to the work you will provide within your specific team, you will also attend a learning-focused guest-speaker series that will provide you with exposure to various teams throughout the company; partner with a mentor who will provide feedback and coaching to support your professional skills development; network with stakeholders; and collaborate on a capstone Generation H project.

The duration of the Generation H program is five months. Please note in order to qualify for the program, you must be able to work during this five month period. This internship is scheduled for January 11, 2027 – June 28, 2027 and is full-time.

All internships are in-person (non-remote) and based in the Hermès US corporate headquarters located in New York City. Interns are paid an hourly rate of US $20.00. A Full-Time Internship will be scheduled for 37.5 hours per week.

About the Role:

The After Sales and Client Development intern will support the Senior Manager of After Sales by providing administrative and analytical support on key global initiatives. Through this experience, the successful candidate will learn the intricacies of the business and provide a fresh perspective on how to streamline processes and create efficiencies related to uniform procurement, sharing and implementing After Sales strategies with stores and sourcing new repair vendors. The intern will also work closely with the Client Development team to better understand the special-order process and help in streamlining the process as well as well creating reporting.

This position is expected to assist with functions including but not limited to:

* Working with the Senior Manager of After Sales on all aspects of the uniform dispatch process, from initial data gathering through uniform delivery, collaborating with partners in Paris as needed.
* Creating PowerPoint presentation decks for After Sales trainings
* Working with the Client Development team on understanding the special-order process and identify opportunities to streamline it
* Repair vendor validation– scheduling visits to and reviewing vendor tests
* Conducting competitive market research to identify new repair vendors
* Compiling After Sales meeting recaps
Special projects for After Sales and Client Services  

About You:

* Enrolled in an Associates, Bachelor’s, or Master’s Degree program
* Previous Internship Experience in Fashion or Luxury is a plus
* Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a highly complex work environment
* Ability to take initiative and work independently at times
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work assignments
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and to exercise discretion and professionalism with sensitive information
* Ability to deliver information in a clear, concise manner
* Strong Organization and follow-through skills
* Time sensitive, accurate and highly dependable
* Strong Excel skills, including the ability to create pivot tables and complete v-lookup
* Proficiency in PowerPoint and Microsoft Word required
* Regular in-person work at a Company-designated work location is an essential function of this position.

We are looking for a candidate that has a combination of the above attributes and can perform the key functions of the role with or without reasonable accommodations.

**Company Overview:**

Since 1837, Hermès has remained faithful to its artisan business model and humanist values. We place people at the heart of what we do and aspire to make a positive impact on the world. The freedom to create, the constant search for beautiful materials, the transmission of a savoir-faire of excellence and the aesthetic of functionality define the singularity of Hermès, a house dedicated to making highly-crafted, beautiful objects made to stand the test of time.

An independent, family-owned company, Hermès is dedicated to keeping production in France through its 42 workshops, The Hermès organization is also a truly global community with a network of 310 stores in 49 countries. Hermès employs more than 15,000 people worldwide with over 6,000 of the workforce being Hermès craftspeople engaged in making artisanal products, nurturing a 180+ year tradition of creativity and innovation.

At Hermès, our actions for sustainable development and corporate social responsibility are founded in values passed down by generations of humble artisans who have shaped the story of our house and the integrity of our objects. The roots of Hermès’ success and longevity lie in a sense of responsibility; a quest for authenticity and respect for time and preservation of natural resources. All at Hermès wish to leave a positive footprint on the world, a mission that’s at the heart of our commitment to progress. This narrative can be experienced in a series of shorts films “Footsteps Across the World” available on our website. Link here .

**Our Commitment:**

Family is at the heart of Hermès. At Hermès of Paris, we are committed to being a Maiso

Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Our Brand Marketing team at Plaid builds awareness, shapes perception, and grows Plaid's presence in the market. We combine deep product and industry knowledge with strong creative instincts. We want Plaid known and trusted by the companies and people who rely on financial technology. We believe every company offering financial products to consumers deserves the best financial technology, and people should understand why it matters.

As our Social Community Manager, you'll help us get there. You'll build and run Plaid's social communities, showing up where our audience already is, listening closely, and turning those conversations into trust. You'll also help bring customer and employee voices to the forefront, so the people who know Plaid best are the ones telling its story.

--------------------

* Managing day-to-day engagement across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit, responding to comments, DMs, and mentions with a voice that's human first
* Proactively building community, customer love, and advocacy — identifying and nurturing fans, developers, and customers into repeat advocates for Plaid (superfans, referrals, UGC)
* Defining Plaid's voice on social media, in partnership with the Social Lead and larger Brand team
* Staying culturally tuned in, knowing what trend or moment is worth jumping on and what to skip
* Monitoring conversations and sentiment across channels, flagging trends, questions, or risks to the Social Lead and relevant teams
* Supporting execution of community-facing content and campaigns in partnership with content and design
* Adapting tone and approach for each platform's distinct culture and norms
* Tracking engagement metrics and contributing to regular reporting
* Escalating sensitive situations, including PR risk or customer issues, quickly and calmly

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3-5 years of experience managing B2B social channels, in-house, including building community and customer advocacy
* Working knowledge of LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit, including the distinct culture and etiquette of each platform
* A sharp, current feel for internet/meme culture and what's culturally relevant right now
* Strong, adaptable writing skills, with the ability to shift tone across channels while staying on-brand
* A level head under pressure, with good judgment on when to respond directly versus escalate
* Interest in fintech or technology, with a genuine curiosity to learn the space
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple platforms and stakeholders at once
