jobs.title: Digital Marketing Designer
jobs.description:
**Mission**
-----------

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn’t be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we’re building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate and lower bills, and make coverage easier to understand—saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the American’s most trusted advocate and partner to manage their healthcare, and healthcare financial decisions.

**About Us**
------------

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we’re a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We’re lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded and have solid runway.

Bill lowering is the hook. People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it — catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring our first in-house Digital Marketing Production Designer to own hands-on creative production across web, email, collateral, and video. You take a brief: usually from marketing and turn it into finished, on-brand assets ready to ship. This is a high-volume execution role: multiple landing pages, email templates, ad cuts, and decks each week, all held to Granted’s brand system and healthcare compliance rules.

One thing to flag up front: ads, landing pages, and emails are the core requirement. Video editing is a strong plus, not a must-have.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Landing page design**

* Design and revise marketing-site and campaign landing pages in Figma (partner pages, patient-stories page, signup screens, and similar).
* Design mobile-first, keep animation minimal, and match each page to the ad that drove the click.
* Work from copy briefs and conversion benchmarks, not aesthetics alone.

### **Email design**

* Design and iterate responsive email templates for lifecycle, promo, and partner (FFGA) sends.
* Keep templates consistent with the design system: icons, logo lockups, buttons, and spacing.

### **Collateral design**

* Build BD and partner decks, including reusable base templates that partner-specific versions fork from.
* Produce sales enablement materials and co-branded partner assets (e.g., FFGA x Granted), plus a self-serve asset library reps and HR teams can pull from.
* Turn around one-off brand and marketing design requests as they come in.

### **Social-first video editing**

* Cut UGC and talking-head ads into multiple lengths (e.g., 15s and 30s) and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) for Meta and YouTube.
* Burn in captions, add B-roll and text reveals, and keep the edit moving so it holds retention through the hook.
* Version and riff winning ads: new hooks, on-screen insurer callouts, swapped presenters (including AI-generated), and platform re-cuts from existing masters.
* Build light motion graphics and AI-assisted animation, such as product and explainer sequences (e.g., a bill-scan animation).

**You'll Bring**
----------------

### **Must-haves:**

* 3+ years in production or creative design, with a portfolio spanning web, email, and static work.
* Proficiency in Figma for landing pages and web layouts.
* Responsive email design in an ESP (Klaviyo, Customer.io, or similar).
* Comfort designing to an existing brand system and holding output consistent across formats.
* Fast, reliable turnaround on high volume; you can read a written brief and run with it.

### **Nice-to-haves:**

* Social-first video editing in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent — captioning, resizing, and fast multi-cut delivery.
* Motion graphics or AI-assisted animation experience.

### **Toolkit:**

Figma, Adobe Premiere and After Effects (or CapCut), an ESP for email (Klaviyo or Customer.io), Canva, Linear for briefs and tickets, Slack, and Notion.

**You'll Thrive Here If**
-------------------------

* You get energy from taking a rough brief and shipping the finished thing — the ad cut, the landing page, the email — not just art-directing it
* You move fast without dropping the details: multiple versions a week, every one on-brand and within the compliance rules
* You like variety and don’t need to own one polished flagship — you’d rather turn around video, web, email, and decks and see what actually performs
* You care about the same problem Granted is solving — helping people who are stressed and overwhelmed feel like someone’s actually on their side

Compensation Range: $100K - $160K

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in consumer-facing social media marketing.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience driving earned conversation on social media and in PR.
* Experience working with social talent such as creators/influencers.
* Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to solve complex, multi-layered problems and streamline business or development workflows.
* Experience in social channel management and with social media content publishing and reporting tools (e.g., Social Media Platform Business Manager, YouTube Studio, or other native channel platform tools).

* Strong understanding of how social performance connects to brand marketing objectives and business KPIs.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Social Media Manager on the Platforms and Devices (P&D) Marketing team, you will lead strategy and execution for Google Chrome. You will grow in ambiguity and operate in a rapidly changing environment. You will have experience running global programs driving business impact through collaboration with both internal talent and external partners. You will understand platform nuances and how to cultivate community engagement through creative messaging. You will possess obsessive attention to detail and visual quality. You are the ultimate multitasker, able to manage heavy workloads efficiently while identifying opportunities to scale and streamline internal operations. You will be resourceful and highly adept at working cross-functionally to achieve goals.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems-from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can-changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $141000 - $205000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

--------------------

* Own and manage the editorial calendar across social channels, ensuring a consistent mix of always-on and campaign-based content.
* Oversee end-to-end content quality and publishing, including creative reviews, platform optimization, and community engagement.
* Collaborate effectively with internal makers and agency partners to ensure all creative work intended for social channels adheres to brand and legal standards.
* Provide input on campaign briefs to shape impactful, platform-native organic social deliverables.
* Analyze and report on content performance, surfacing insights that inform future content and platform strategy.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist, Growth Marketing & Innovation
jobs.description:
Position Summary: The Digital Marketing Specialist supports the development and execution of digital marketing initiatives that build awareness of and drive enrollment in NYU’s graduate programs. Serve as a versatile creative and digital marketer for the team, with a particular emphasis on creating compelling, engaging visual and multimedia content for organic social and paid advertising that engages prospective students throughout the enrollment journey. Support the planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns and digital nurture initiatives designed to move prospective students from initial engagement through submitted applications. Help develop and execute advertising and nurture content across the enrollment cycle, monitor campaign performance, and leverage data and audience insights to identify opportunities for optimization and improve conversion at each stage of the funnel. The ultimate goal is to create more effective, integrated digital experiences that drive qualified leads and applications to NYU’s graduate programs. Qualifications: **Required Education:**  
Bachelor's Degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field.  
  
**Preferred Education:**  
Master's Degree in marketing, communications, business, digital media, advertising, or a related field.  
  
**Required Experience:**  
2+ years Experience producing and editing video content for marketing content. Experience in graphic design. Experience managing paid media campaigns. Experience writing and editing.  
  
**Preferred Experience:**  
3+ years Experience managing paid search campaigns across Google Ads and additional digital advertising platforms such as Meta, Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn or emerging AI search platforms. Experience with SEO, landing page optimization, marketing automation, conversion tracking, data visualization, or dashboard development is also preferred. Strong copywriting abilities.  
  
**Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:**  
Demonstrated proficiency in video production and editing, including the ability to independently conceptualize, shoot, edit, and deliver video content for digital and social platforms. Demonstrated proficiency in graphic design and visual content creation, with a portfolio showcasing relevant work. Strong visual storytelling skills and an understanding of how to create content that captures attention and communicates effectively across digital platforms. Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences and channels. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and collaborate effectively with creative and marketing stakeholders. Demonstrated curiosity about digital marketing, social media, emerging technologies, and evolving content formats. Demonstrated ability running paid media campaigns.  
  
**Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:**  
Working knowledge of paid social and emerging digital advertising platforms, especially Google ads.. Knowledge of SEO and the relationship between paid and organic search strategies. Experience with web analytics, conversion tracking, attribution, and marketing performance measurement. Experience developing or maintaining automated marketing dashboards and performance reporting. Ability to identify trends and patterns in complex datasets and translate them into clear recommendations for marketing strategy. Knowledge of AI-powered search and emerging digital advertising technologies. Familiarity with higher education marketing, enrollment funnels, and prospective student behavior. Experience with A/B testing, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization. Experience writing copy for ads, pitch decks, landing pages, email campaigns, and for SEO optimization.  
Additional Information: In compliance with NYC's Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary range for this position is USD $77,000.00 to USD $88,000.00. New York University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and organizational considerations when extending an offer. This pay range represents base pay only and excludes any additional items such as incentives, bonuses, clinical compensation, or other items.

We are Tennis! The USTA (United States Tennis Association) is the national governing body for the sport of tennis and the leader in promoting and developing the sport’s growth on every level in the United States, from local communities to the crown jewel of the professional game, the US Open.

**Why Work for the USTA?**

We are a passionate team of staff and volunteers focused on growing the sport of tennis and making it accessible to all. We are committed to removing barriers and creating opportunities for ALL to participate. Don’t know tennis? Don't worry, you can still find yourself in the game!

**The Role**
------------

In this role, you will support social media content and engagement, assist with the coordination of tennis programs, and contribute to the successful execution of special events at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center. You will help strengthen our digital presence while supporting programs and experiences that engage our tennis community.

**Social Media Content & Engagement**

* Create engaging and relevant social media content across platforms, including Instagram and Facebook.
* Support the development and execution of social media strategies to increase engagement and strengthen brand presence.
* Monitor social media performance and engagement, identifying opportunities to improve content and outreach.
* Engage with followers and respond to comments and messages in a timely and professional manner.
* Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify content opportunities and promote programs, events, and initiatives.

### **Program Coordination**

* Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of tennis programs and related activities.
* Coordinate tennis professional scheduling with designated internal teams and external partners to support smooth program operations.
* Maintain accurate program records, schedules, and participant information.
* Support the development and distribution of promotional materials for programs and activities.
* Respond to program-related inquiries and provide accurate and timely information to participants.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support day-to-day program needs and address scheduling or operational changes.

### **Event Support**

* Support the planning and execution of events at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center.
* Assist with event logistics, including preparation, setup, onsite coordination, and breakdown.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to support event needs and ensure a positive participant and guest experience.
* Provide onsite support and assist with other event-related responsibilities as needed.
* Who You Are

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience with social media management, digital marketing, content creation, program coordination, or a related area preferred.
* Creative and organized, with an interest in sports, tennis, and engaging with diverse audiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable collaborating across teams while also working independently when needed.
* Familiarity with major social media platforms, including Instagram and Facebook.
* Proficiency with graphic design and content creation tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, is a plus.
* Ability to work onsite at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center and support events outside of standard business hours as needed.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience with social media management, digital marketing, content creation, program coordination, or a related area preferred.
* Creative and organized, with an interest in sports, tennis, and engaging with diverse audiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable collaborating across teams while also working independently when needed.
* Familiarity with major social media platforms, including Instagram and Facebook.
* Proficiency with graphic design and content creation tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, is a plus.
* Ability to work onsite at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center and support events outside of standard business hours as needed.

**What We Offer**

At the USTA, we know people are our most important asset.

The hourly rate for this position is **$20.00-23.00.**

* **Flexibility:** Our Hybrid with Flexibility approach combines a balance of remote working with in-office collaboration to spark teamwork and creativity.

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the company**

Jay Franco is a New York-based licensed home textile company. We design and develop bedding, bath, and home products featuring brands like Disney, Marvel, Star Wars, LEGO, and Minecraft, and we sell them to major U.S. retailers including Walmart and Target. Every product starts as artwork and a spec sheet and ends up on a store shelf — and the Product Development Coordinator is the person who keeps dozens of those products moving between our design team, our overseas agents and factories, testing labs, licensors, and retailers, without a detail getting lost on the way.

**What you'll own**

You'll run 20+ active product programs at a time — more in peak season. For each one, you are the single source of truth: you write and send the daily project emails that tell agents and factories exactly what's needed (timelines, specs, colors, sizing, fabrication, sample requests, testing, changes), you evaluate every sample that comes back, and you chase down whatever is holding a program up — whether that's artwork, packaging, a lab test, a licensor approval, or a factory date. When a program ships on time and right, it's because you caught the wrong Pantone, the missing size, or the expired test before it became a problem.

**Who this is for**

This role is open to someone early in their career or someone with a few years of product development, sourcing, merchandising, or production coordination behind them. A background in textiles, apparel, home goods, or fashion is a real plus (a degree in textile, fashion merchandising, or product development counts). What we can't teach is the mindset: you notice small things — a color that's slightly off, a measurement that doesn't match the spec, a date that moved in one email but not another — and you can't leave them alone. You write clear, complete emails that someone overseas can act on without a follow-up question. You keep your own tracker, you know where every sample is, and you raise a problem the day you see it, not the day it's due.

**Who this isn't for — please read before applying**

Be honest with yourself about these points:

* This is a high-volume, detail-heavy coordination job. Most of your day is email, spreadsheets, spec sheets, and samples. If you're looking for a mainly creative or design role, this isn't it.
* You will manage 20+ programs at once, and in peak season more. Priorities shift daily based on factory responses, retailer requests, and sales meetings. If juggling many open threads at the same time stresses you out, this role will too.
* Accuracy is the job. A wrong color code or size in one email can mean a re-sample, a missed retailer date, or a failed test. "Close enough" is not a standard we can work with.
* Our factories and agents are overseas, so the overnight replies are waiting for you every morning and need clear answers fast.
* This is fully onsite in our New York City office, five days a week.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Daily project communication:** Prepare and maintain a detailed email summary for every assigned program, clearly documenting timelines, required actions, consumer testing, sample requests, product specifications, color details, sizing, fabrications, and factory change requests for agents and factories.
* **Program management:** Manage 20+ active projects daily (volume varies by season), keeping every piece of information accurate, current, and sent on time.
* **Sample evaluation:** Review every incoming sample for design execution, color, sizing, fabrication, construction, quality, and adherence to product specifications.
* **Sample control:** Organize, track, and clearly label all samples through development so they can be found and used the moment they're needed.
* **Sample expediting:** Coordinate and expedite samples for sales meetings, presentations, retailer reviews, and other key milestones.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Keep programs on schedule with internal teams and external partners:
* Art Department — transfer and upload artwork to factories for development, and keep artwork files organized and accessible.
* Packaging Design — confirm packaging is accurate, approved, and aligned with product specs and retailer requirements.
* Director of Product Integrity — make sure products go to the correct retailer-designated testing lab and follow all required testing protocols.
* Production — confirm that factory ship dates and production timelines in your daily communications are accurate and current.
* **Project resources:** Give the Art Department and overseas teams links to current artwork, spec sheets, and development documents — always the latest version.
* **Artwork review:** Check artwork before it goes to factories, flagging color limitations, production restrictions, or anything else that could affect development or final production.
* **Prototypes and color standards:** Coordinate prototypes and color standards with factories so products meet design and quality expectations.
* **Document accuracy:** Review purchase orders, production forms, and related documents for accuracy against approved specifications.
* **Deadline ownership:** Own every program's deadlines and requirements — licensor approvals, retailer requirements, testing, sampling, and development milestones — and make sure each is completed correctly and on time.
* **Problem-solving:** Spot issues early, raise them immediately, and work with the right teams to fix them and keep the program on track.
* **General support:** Assist with sample reviews, meetings, project organization, and other product development tasks as requested.

**Qualifications**

* 0–3+ years in product development, sourcing, merchandising, production, or a related coordination role. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships or coursework are welcome.
* Textile, apparel, home goods, or fashion industry experience strongly preferred; a degree in textiles, fashion merchandising, product development, or a related

Each day will be challenging and exciting for the right person.

* Exciting opportunities: competitive compensation and opportunities for advancement within the company. High performance will lead to promotion and pay raises.
* Positive work environment: a supportive and collaborative culture where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Training and development: excellent training sessions and ongoing development programs to help you excel in both customer service and vehicle inspection.

* Exceptional interpersonal, customer service and relationship-building skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task
* Ability to manage stressful or unusual situations while maintaining good customer service
* Ability to learn about the customer's rental needs and upgrade them to a more premium vehicle and additional services that will enhance their experience
* Familiarity with video inspection processes and basic photography skills for capturing pre-existing conditions
* Ability to manage traffic flow efficiently

Rental and sales

* Provide excellent customer service in all customer contact situations
* Meet all sales and service standards
* Assist customers with inquiries about car features and conditions
* Inform customers of return policies (e.g., No Smoking, No Pet Hair, Gas)

Vehicle check-out

* Ensure high-quality video check-out processes
* Record pre-existing conditions by capturing additional photos

Vehicle return and inspection

* Secure vehicle keys, confirm documentation and perform necessary checks
* Perform video inspections for damage and remind customers to check for personal belongings
* Identify and record lost items found in vehicles with detailed information
* Thoroughly review cars for damage upon return, and open and file claims promptly
* Park units requiring service in designated areas and inform the Service Supervisor

Branch support

* Control traffic flow as a guide for incoming and outgoing rental cars
* Assist the branch with the return and turnaround of vehicles
* Complete administrative tasks, including daily lists to assist the office
* Perform other job duties as assigned to meet business needs

**About you:**

* High school diploma or GED
* Minimum 1 year of customer service or sales experience
* Must be at least 18 and have a valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Experience meeting sales quotas or working in highly commissioned positions preferred
* Ability to follow defined service and sales processes
* Must be willing to wear company uniforms
* Ability to communicate in English; speaking other languages, including Spanish, is a plus

**Position available at BRK and BRKJS city locations**  
**Salary: From $18.00 per hour - $20.00 per hour + Comissions**  
**Expected hours: 40 per week**

We help people bring their old 401(k)s and IRAs together into one simple, transparent account they can actually understand. For employers, we take small-balance headaches off their hands with automatic rollover solutions that protect former employees' savings and keep plans healthy.

* Keep our CRM (Pipedrive) accurate and hand over new accounts smoothly to Operations.
* Run the weekly sales rhythm, including the team coordination call and the activity summary for US leadership.
* Coordinate our conference calendar, event materials and client activities.

**What you'll bring**

* 1–3 years in an SDR/BDR, inside sales or sales support role, ideally in financial services, retirement or B2B fintech.
* Confidence on the phone and strong written communication.
* An organized, detail-oriented approach and experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, Salesforce or HubSpot).

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work.** We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven **Customer Success Manager** to join our Americas team.  
  
**What you’ll be doing:**

As a Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximize opportunities for our SMB customers and Semperis.

Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.

**You will be responsible for:**

* Designing success plans for a Book of Business of approximately 50 SMB customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upselling, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to help them reach their business objectives and operational goals.
* You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets.
* Acting as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs.
* Leading training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations.
* Monitoring record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalized customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc.
* Developing and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)
* Identifying potential customer references and assisting with development of customer case studies.
* Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services.
* In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program.

**What you will bring to the table:**

**Technical & Cyber Security Skills**

* Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities.
* Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organization structures

Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains:

* Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc.
* Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2)

**Customer-facing & Soft Skills**

* 3+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company.
* Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language.
* Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives.
* Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities.
* Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations
* Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals.

**Business & Strategic Skills**

* Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics)
* Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps)
* Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths)
* Competitive intelligence: Know how our product differentiates from the competition.

**Preferences:**

* Experience with SFDC and Active Directory

#LI-KG1

**Why Join Semperis?**
  
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (NYC)
jobs.description:
**About Greenboard**
====================

At Greenboard, we’re building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money.

Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We’re backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard — and we’re growing fast.

**About the Role**
==================

As a Business Development Representative at Greenboard, you’ll be the tip of the spear for our go-to-market motion, generating pipeline and creating the first conversations that turn financial institutions and regulated businesses into customers. You’ll research target accounts, craft compelling outbound, and turn evolving compliance pain points into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.

You’ll help shape the outbound playbook in real time, set the tone and energy for a growing sales team, and operate with significant autonomy. Success in this role means creating momentum from ambiguity, opening doors with senior compliance and finance stakeholders, and consistently converting research and outreach into qualified pipeline.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our NoMad, NYC office.

**What You’ll Work On**
=======================

* Generate qualified pipeline through high-volume, high-quality outbound across SMB, mid-market and enterprise accounts — cold calls, email, LinkedIn, and strategic sequences
* Research target accounts and personas to craft personalized outreach that resonates with finance, compliance, legal, and operations leaders
* Run initial discovery conversations to identify pain, qualify fit, and book meetings that convert into opportunities for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives and leadership to refine targeting, messaging, and outbound strategy
* Help shape Greenboard’s GTM motion by testing outbound plays, maintaining clean CRM data, and feeding market insights back into the business

**Who Are You?**
================

* Highly resourceful and self-directed, you thrive in ambiguity and don’t wait for perfect processes to exist
* Resilient and energized by outbound, you’re undeterred by rejection and motivated by activity and results
* Clear, concise communicator who builds rapport quickly with both executives and operators
* Naturally curious about financial infrastructure, compliance, and how modern businesses manage operational risk
* Competitive, accountable, and excited to help build something from the ground up — including a brand-new office

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 1–3 years of experience in a customer facing, sales, business development, or pipeline-generation role (fintech, compliance, or B2B SaaS experience is a plus)
* Proven ability to generate meetings and pipeline independently through outbound prospecting and creative, relationship-driven outreach
* Comfortable with high-volume outbound activity — cold calling, email, and social selling — and structured discovery to qualify fit
* Strong CRM hygiene and a data-driven, organized approach to managing your pipeline and activity
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* Based in the greater NYC area, or willing to relocate to work from our NoMad office

**Benefits**
============

* 401(k) with 5% company match
* $95,000 OTE
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 15 days PTO + 11 company holidays + flexible sick time
* 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days)
* 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays
* Bi-annual off-sites and team retreats
* Front-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance

Compensation Range: $75K - $110K

jobs.description:
**Whatever the role, everyone at Grady is part of something bigger. Choosing a career at Grady is choosing to be part of a legacy of service and commitment to our communities. If you want to make a difference, we want to hear from you.**

**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator Perinatal is responsible for the overall coordination and communication of the Centering Pregnancy program, including community outreach, program development, maintaining Centering accreditation, and adhering to service principles. This position will also be responsible for customer service focus of innovation, service excellence and teamwork to provide the highest quality care and service to our patients, families, co-workers and others. Ensure complete and accurate documentation in the electronic medical record (EPIC) including patient interactions related to scheduling, pre-visit planning, follow-up and improving care team alignment.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Lactation Consultant certification preferred
* 2+ years of work experience in a healthcare setting.
* Medical terminology experience

**Core Competencies**  
These competencies reflect the values and behaviors expected of all Grady team members, regardless of role. They ensure that every employee contributes to safe, high-quality care, positive patient experience, and a collaborative work environment.

  

1. **Patient-Centered Care** – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering safe, compassionate, and high-quality care that prioritizes the well-being and satisfaction of patients and their families.
  
2. **Integrity & Accountability** – Acts ethically, maintains confidentiality, and accepts responsibility for actions, decisions, and outcomes.
  
3. **Collaboration & Teamwork** – Builds positive relationships, works effectively across departments, and supports colleagues to achieve shared goals.
  
4. **Communication** – Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with patients, families, colleagues, and leadership.
  
5. **Respect & Inclusion** – Creates an inclusive environment by valuing diversity, treating others with dignity, and ensuring equitable care and opportunities for all.
  
6. **Quality & Safety** – Adheres to best practices, regulatory standards, and policies to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes.
  
7. **Adaptability & Resilience** – Responds effectively to change, remains flexible in dynamic situations, and demonstrates resilience under pressure.
  
8. **Continuous Improvement** – Seeks opportunities to improve processes, skills, and outcomes through innovation, learning, and feedback.
  
9. **Leadership & Professionalism** – Inspires, guides, and develops individuals and teams while modeling professionalism, fairness, and transparency.
  
10. **Employee Experience Focus** – Champions a supportive and engaging employee journey that enables staff to thrive and, in turn, deliver exceptional patient care.

**Grady Total Rewards**  
At Grady, we believe in supporting the health, well-being, and growth of every team member. Our **Total Rewards** package is designed to provide competitive pay and comprehensive benefits that make a difference in your life and career, including:

* Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
* Financial Security: Retirement savings plans with employer contributions, life insurance, and disability coverage.
* Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, holidays, and family leave benefits.
* Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, professional development programs, and opportunities for advancement.
* Employee Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness initiatives, and discounts on services.

Grady’s Total Rewards are designed to ensure our employees feel valued, supported, and empowered, both at work and beyond.

**Why Join Grady?**  
Grady Health System is more than a hospital — we are a vital part of Atlanta and the surrounding communities. For over 125 years, Grady has been committed to providing exceptional care, advancing health equity, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve. When you join Grady, you become part of a team that values excellence, compassion, innovation, and collaboration.

Here, every role matters. Whether you provide direct patient care, support our operations, or lead teams, you play an important part in fulfilling our mission. We offer opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career in an environment where your contributions are recognized and valued.

At Grady, we don’t just work, we make an impact.

Grady Health System is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. **Industry**: Healthcare / Physician Services

**Position Overview**

A growing physician practice is seeking a professional, outgoing, and motivated Part-Time Healthcare Outreach Coordinator to support facility outreach and business development.

The primary focus of this position is to connect with healthcare facilities, build professional relationships, and identify their current and anticipated physician staffing needs. The Outreach Coordinator will gather information regarding the physician specialties and services facilities are seeking and communicate those opportunities back to practice leadership for follow-up and recruitment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is comfortable meeting new people, building professional relationships, and representing a growing healthcare organization in the community.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Conduct outreach to healthcare facilities and organizations within assigned markets.

● Visit facilities in person to introduce the practice and establish professional relationships.

● Connect with facility leadership, administrators, clinical leaders, and other appropriate decision-makers.

● Identify and assess each facility’s current and anticipated physician staffing needs.

● Determine which physician specialties or services facilities are actively seeking.

● Gather relevant information regarding potential physician coverage and partnership opportunities.

● Communicate identified staffing needs and opportunities to practice leadership for follow-up.

● Identify potential partnership and contract opportunities for the practice.

● Schedule follow-up meetings or presentations with practice leadership when appropriate.

● Maintain an organized pipeline of facility contacts, opportunities, and follow-up activity.

● Track outreach efforts, facility needs, contacts, meetings, leads, and potential contracts.

● Maintain consistent communication and follow-up with prospective facility partners.

**Qualifications**

● High school diploma or equivalent.

● Professional, confident, and comfortable communicating with healthcare facility leadership.

● Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

● Basic computer and email proficiency and the ability to learn new systems.

From practice management to imaging to revenue cycle automation, we’re tearing down the old infrastructure and rebuilding the future of dentistry. Planet DDS is the fastest-growing provider of dental practice management solutions and the #1 cloud platform for DSOs and multi-location groups.

Here, you won’t just join a team - you’ll join a movement. We want bold thinkers who are ambitious enough to push limits, empathetic enough to work as one, and accountable enough to own big outcomes. Trust is our currency, collaboration is our edge, and impact is our fuel. jobs.title: DSO Digital Account Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Cumulus Media** is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.

Position Overview:

**Cumulus Media | (Atlanta)** has an immediate, ***fully remote (US-based)*** opening for a **Digital Account Manager** to join our Digital Sales Operations team. The ideal candidate will help execute and maintain effective digital marketing programs for our clients while also supporting sales teams by maintaining strategic account relationships and requests.  
  
As a full-time Digital Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and growing client relationships, ensuring success from high-quality digital campaigns, and driving successful outcomes. Additionally, you'll provide ongoing performance-based digital strategy guidance, campaign management, and assistance in leading tactical digital presentations that represent media plans and/or results for:

* Cross-Platform Digital Marketing
* Audio Streaming
* Podcast Advertising
* Display Advertising
* Programmatic Strategies
* Social Media Marketing
* Online Presence Solutions
* OTT and Video Advertising
* Paid Search Engine Marketing
* Email Marketing

You will have the opportunity to use your passion for digital marketing to manage campaigns using personalized, innovative, full-scope advertising solutions to meet the marketing needs of new and existing clients through the integration of digital products and services focused on our advertisers’ end goals.

Key Responsibilities & Qualifications:

**RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* Help guide operations and sales teams to ensure that sold campaigns are executed and fulfilled with a high level of precision and performance to meet the client’s expectations on costs and KPIs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as their primary point of contact for all digital marketing needs, requests, changes, and other internal and external communication.
* Help execute digital marketing strategies that align with client goals, objectives, and expectations.
* Manage the organization, process, and delivery of digital campaigns, ensuring they are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest standard.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop creative strategies and innovative solutions that meet client needs and goals.
* Monitor campaign performance and provide regular reports to clients, highlighting successes and areas for improvement.
* Analyze and translate campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and improvement to meet client goals.
* Oversee ongoing internal reporting and account trackers in order to provide ongoing details about account health, project timelines, growth opportunities, monthly billing, etc.
* Lead presentation planning and development (including the build-out of media plans and client/industry research), ongoing monthly reporting, and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify opportunities for business growth, and work with clients to develop new projects and campaign renewal ideas to help the team meet its overall revenue goals.
* Support strategic agency projects as needed (like onboarding a new platform, researching new products/partners, or setting up new offerings in our planning tools).
* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices, sharing insights and knowledge with clients and internal teams.

**QUALIFICATIONS****:**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or related field preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a focus on account management required.
* Solid working knowledge of digital marketing channels, including SEO, PPC, social media, email marketing, and/or programmatic buying.
* Hands-on familiarity with digital marketing tools and platforms, such as Google Analytics, Google AdWords, Facebook Ads Manager, or programmatic DSPs
* Demonstrated experience navigating digital advertising platforms, including Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, DSPs, and other paid media technologies, with the ability to execute, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns.
* Ability to analyze digital campaign performance using platform data and reporting tools, identify trends, strengths, weaknesses, and optimization opportunities, and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Excellent presentation skills are required, as are strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to prioritize and solve client issues successfully.
* Demonstrated ability to be self-motivated and task-oriented for complex and fast-paced projects, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Dedicated focus on time management and organizational skills, with high attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Must be a team player, with the ability to work cross-functionally with internal teams and external clients equally.
* Excel

---------------

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. **Job Summary:**
----------------

This is a full-time, exempt, support position assisting the Account Team in the management of the existing Book of Business with emphasis in full retention responsibility. The primary function of this position is to provide quality service to clients and cross-sell/account-round within the existing book of business. The Account Manager (AM) will be the day-to-day liaison between the insurance company and designated middle-market accounts. You will lead and control relationships with clients in collaboration with Producers and/or Account Executives; you will support an Account Executive/s with a BOB of approximately 1M in revenue. Daily servicing of clients will include contract analysis, coverage and exposure analysis, endorsement activity, routine coverage and billing questions, problem-solving, renewal control, preparation of quotes/proposals, binding coverage, and claim reporting and follow-up. You will assist Producer(s) with the above functions as needed. You should have P&C experience and an active P&C license. Have knowledge and experience in select commercial insurance including, but not limited to, commercial auto, property, general liability, umbrella, inland marine, workers compensation, and flood.

*This is a full-time position, ideally working hybrid from either our Charlotte, NC or ATL offices. We will consider a remote option for well-experienced Commercial Lines candidates able to work on an EST schedule. When working remotely, maintain a dedicated workspace to safeguard company equipment and communications. Make sure your internet is reliable and high-speed and that you remain available and engaged online, and limit personal distractions throughout your work hours.*

--------------

* Give the most prompt, accurate, and courteous service that customers have ever received…anywhere.
* Increase revenue by rounding out commercial lines accounts. Negotiate pricing and coverage terms in the client’s best interest.
* Develop relationships that lead to new business sales.

**Essential Core Duties and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------

* Build and maintain constructive and effective partnerships with clients by meeting and exceeding expectations.
* Provide consistent, accurate, timely, and pertinent communication to clients.
* Resolve/assist with any service issues/questions.

* Follow established agency procedures for effective utilization of the agency management system.
* Take advantage of personal and professional development opportunities such as continuing education, professional designations, and in-house training.
* Adhere to all state laws and regulations regarding insurance agents (licensing, continuing education, etc).
* Assist with or complete other tasks as advised by management/team.

**Job Specifications/Requirements:**
------------------------------------

* Property and casualty insurance license upon hire is required.
* At least 2 years of experience in commercial lines insurance, with an understanding of underwriting, coverage and rate analysis.
* In-depth knowledge of insurance coverages and an ability to communicate this knowledge clearly to clients and underwriters.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize and self-manage workload.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* EPIC experience is preferred, but will consider other agency management system experience.

Product Marketing Manager

**Outside Sales Representative – Business Development**

**Disaster Restoration (B2B) | Norcross, GA | Territory: Greater Atlanta**

**$60,000–$80,000 Base Salary • Uncapped Commission • $100K+ Income Potential • Vehicle Allowance**

**You Already Know Half the People on Your Prospect List**

If you've spent a few years calling on property managers, plumbers, contractors, or insurance offices anywhere around Atlanta, you've built something valuable — and you probably haven't been paid much for it.

Nobody writes you a check because a facility manager in Marietta trusts your judgment, or because you can get a plumbing company owner on the phone on a Tuesday afternoon. Those relationships just sit there, quietly worth something.

This job pays you for exactly that.

Metro Atlanta is more than six million people, an enormous multifamily footprint, and tens of thousands of commercial buildings. Water damage, mold, and property emergencies happen across all of it, every single week. Somebody is going to be the person those property professionals call first when it does.

**We're hiring the person who wants that to be them.**

**Why the Income Compounds Instead of Resetting**

Most sales jobs start over at zero every January. This one doesn't, because of who you're selling to.

A plumber running service calls across the north metro will run into water losses over and over. A property manager may be responsible for hundreds of units. An insurance agent talks with property owners all day long. A facility manager may oversee an entire portfolio of buildings.

Earn the trust of any one of those people and you haven't made a sale — you've opened a source of work that keeps producing long after the meeting that started it.

So you're not chasing one-off homeowners. You're building a network of repeat referral partners and commercial accounts:

* Insurance agents and adjusters
* Plumbers, HVAC companies, and contractors
* Property managers and multifamily professionals
* Facility managers and commercial property professionals

Year one, you're building. Year three, you're still building — on top of everything that's already producing.

**To Be Clear: You Will Have to Go Get It**

Relationship selling and passive networking are not the same thing. Nobody is going to hand you a list of warm accounts and ask you to maintain it.

You'll be opening doors that are currently closed — introducing yourself to businesses that have never heard of us, asking for the meeting, and following up longer than most salespeople are willing to.

**You'll have structure, systems, and leadership behind you. You'll still be the one who has to execute.**

**What an Actual Tuesday Looks Like**

* Out in the territory meeting property managers, plumbers, and adjusters face-to-face
* Walking into businesses that don't know us yet and introducing the company
* Running consultative conversations about how properties get protected — not product pitches
* Attending association meetings, industry events, and networking functions where our customers already gather
* Following up on the twelve conversations you started last week
* Keeping your pipeline and activity current in CRM
* Coordinating with operations when a relationship turns into an active job, so the work reflects well on you

**Six to Twelve Months In, Here's What Winning Looks Like**

* A real referral network that produces opportunities without you chasing every one
* Consistent qualified meetings on your calendar every week
* Visible presence in the Atlanta property and contractor community
* A healthy, growing pipeline you can actually forecast from
* Repeat business from partners who called you the first time and kept calling
* **Income trending toward $100K+**

Staying busy is not the measure. Activity that turns into relationships that turn into revenue is.

**Who You'd Be Representing**

Leak Pros of Georgia & Mold-B-Gone is a growing restoration company in Norcross that was built around a real sales organization — not one bolted on as an afterthought.

That matters more than it sounds. It means the systems, the leadership, and the marketing are set up to help a salesperson produce consistently instead of improvising alone. When you spend six months earning a property manager's trust, there's an operation behind you capable of protecting it.

**If This Sounds Like You**

Apply. Tell us about a relationship you built that turned into real business, and what it took to get there.

Atlanta's territory is open. We'd rather hand it to someone who's been waiting for a job like this than keep looking for someone perfect.

 **Requirements**

**Who Fits This Role**

You'll do well here if you have:

* **2+ years of B2B outside sales experience**
* Comfort building a territory from zero rather than inheriting one
* Genuine networking and relationship-building ability — people remember you
* Real self-discipline and follow-through, because nobody is watching your calendar for you
* Coachability, without needing to be managed day to day

Existing relationships in property management, multifamily, construction, or insurance are a significant advantage. They are not a requirement — but if you have them, this is where they finally start paying you back.

If you're looking for inbound leads, a short transactional cycle, or a territory someone else already warmed up, this won't be a fit.

 **Benefits**

**What It Pays**

* **$60,000–$80,000 base salary**
* **Uncapped commission**
* **$100K+ income potential**
* Vehicle allowance, plus gas card / company credit card
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans available
* HSA / FSA available
* 401(k) with up to 4% company match
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Company laptop and phone, with technology support
* Career growth opportunity in a growing market

The base is real money on its own. The commission is where this role separates itself over time.

**Social Media Specialist**  
**Impressions Face & Body**

Region: Chicago, IL, USA – Midwest Region  
Salary: $70,000 USD Annual  
**Location:** On-site

Vos Collection is a network of North America’s premier medical aesthetics clinics, bringing together 32 distinct clinic brands under a unified vision of elevated patient care and premium brand experiences. We are building a category-defining aesthetic brand — one that combines the intimacy and expertise of individual clinic identities with the scale and ambition of an industry leading brand.

We believe that world-class patient experiences, high clinical standards, and modern marketing capabilities belong together. We are building the infrastructure, the brand, and the team to make that real.

**What we are about:**

Vos Collection is seeking a talented and driven Social Media Specialist to join our growing team on a full-time basis. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of premium medicine, cutting-edge dermatology, and the most innovative cosmetic and aesthetic treatments available. Our social content reflects the caliber and artistry of some of the most respected medical and luxury aesthetic practices in Chicago.

If you are a creative self-starter with a sharp eye for aesthetics, a passion for healthcare and the world of high-end cosmetic medicine, and a proven ability to grow and engage social media communities, we want to hear from you.

**What you are about:**

The Social Media Specialist will be the primary driver of social media presence for our portfolio of clinics in Chicago. Working closely with our Clinic Managers, you will bring our physicians, providers, and treatments to life through high-quality, platform-native content. Strategy will be developed in close partnership with the Regional Marketing Manager, who will define the overarching direction and priorities. Your role is to bring that strategy to life with creativity, consistency, and precision, staying in regular alignment to ensure content always ladders up to broader practice goals.

**Responsibilities:**

**Content Research & Strategy**

* Synthesize complex scientific findings into clear, engaging narratives for broad audiences.
* Write detailed video scripts that balance clinical accuracy with an accessible, conversational tone.
* Develop and maintain content calendars and strategic plans, including a monthly calendar with a consistent, on-brand publishing cadence.
* Ensure brand consistency and editorial voice across all platforms and formats.

**Before & After Photography and Patient Journey**

* Manage and publish content across all active social media accounts
* Coordinate collaboration posts and content featuring individual provider profiles
* Monitor platform performance metrics and provide regular reporting on key KPIs (i.e. followers, reach, engagement, conversions).
* Stay current on platform algorithm changes, trends, and best practices in medical and wellness social media.

**Video Production & Editing**

* MShoot and edit high-quality video for short-form (TikTok, Instagram Reels) and long-form (YouTube) formats, optimized for each platform.
* Handle lighting, audio, color grading, motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects.
* Plan, shoot, and edit photo and video content featuring physicians, providers, clinic spaces, and treatments across our Chicago clinics.
* Repurpose and optimize content across platforms to maximize reach and relevance.

**Copywriting & Captions**

* Write captions and hooks that capture attention and drive engagement.
* Create narrative copy that educates while maintaining a luxe, accessible brand voice.
* Tailor copy to each channel, from casual on TikTok to professional on LinkedIn, while maintaining accuracy and clinical credibility.

**Social Media Posting & Publishing**

* Post original, on-brand content to TikTok and Instagram daily.
* Publish one article weekly on The Social Skin Substack and cross-post to LinkedIn with appropriate formatting and commentary.

* Coordinate collaboration posts and content featuring individual provider profiles.
* Support thought leadership materials developed for and funneled to the broader Vos Collection channels.

**Live Streaming & Real-Time Engagement**

* Host and manage 1–2 live streams per week with Dr. Dayan, handling camera positioning, lighting, audio, platform connection, and backup systems.
* Monitor and respond to live comments, and facilitate interaction between Dr. Dayan and the audience.
* Capture, edit, and repurpose live content into clips, highlights, or full episodes.

**Community Management**

* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and mentions in a timely, professional, and warm manner, representing Dr. Dayan's brand and voice.
* Conduct daily engagement across profiles, including patient content, partner accounts, and industry conversations.
* Manage spam, negative comments, and inappropriate content per brand standards and platform policies.
* Identify and escalate patient-related inquiries or sensitive comments in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and practice policies.

**Leads, Analytics & Collaboration**

* Forward relevant leads and ad inquiries to Dr. Dayan's surgical coordinator promptly, and keep clear communication on lead status, consents, before-and-afters, and patient journey documentation.
* Track monthly performance (views, reach, engagement rate, click-through rate, follower growth, conversions), and report on trends, recommendations, and campaign results to Dr. Dayan.
* Stay current on algorithm changes, trends, and best practices in medical and wellness social media.
* Partner with the Regional Marketing Manager and Clinic Managers through regular check-ins, content reviews, and strategy

While relying on Operations Account Managers (OAMs) and execution teams for daily freight movement, the SAM remains fully accountable for program outcomes. This role bridges the gap between high-level account strategy and operational execution—partnering closely with LTL Procurement and mixed TL/LTL operations teams to drive cost savings, service excellence, and value delivery across the customer's network.

### **Core Responsibilities & Execution Pillars**

#### **1. LTL Program Management & Strategic Optimization**

* **Network & Strategy Alignment:** Drive overarching LTL strategy across procurement and operations, acting as the subject-matter expert to align daily execution with macro account goals.
* **Deep-Dive Analytics:** Perform deep-dive program analyses to identify cost, service, and efficiency insights; translate raw data into actionable strategic initiatives (e.g., mode conversions, lane optimization, pooling, and drop trailer strategies).
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify process gaps, evaluate broader market dynamics, and champion LTL best practices across the account team.

#### **2. Governance, Financial Oversight & Tech Management**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor & negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power-of-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.

* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking skills, consistently managing high-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision-making.

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
As a **Customer Success Engineer** at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

**Your Role and Impact:**

* **Onboarding Ownership:** Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.
* **Success Planning:** Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.
* **Value Articulation:** Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.
* **Proactive Engagement:** Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.
* **Technical Credibility:** Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

**This Role is a Fit for You If:**

* **Proven Post-Sales Experience:** You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.
* **Technical Credibility:** You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.
* **Stakeholder Range:** You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.
* **Structured and Proactive:** You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.
* **Commercial Awareness:** You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

**Bonus Points For:**

* Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure.
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.
* Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector - where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.
* Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.
* Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

**About vCluster Labs**
-----------------------

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs
