jobs.title: Sales Representative New Business Midwest US
jobs.description:
#### **About this Position**

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  
  
This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  
  
**Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.**  
  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Implement growth plans and pipeline management that are commensurate with the overall strategic directives of the business.
* Work to establish a complete target list, documenting growth potential by application and location. Including collaborating with distribution partners to help drive new opportunities
* Drive new Sales through all prospecting vehicles, including (but not limited to) lead generation lists, OEM leads, and distribution partners. Actively working with Henkel’s Inside Sales (Grow) team and Marketing insights.
* Able to coordinate efforts with Henkel’s Inside Sales (Protect) team to properly support your existing territory’s customers effectively.
* Have/Develop knowledge of the market and on the major applications & technologies that are typically found in the assigned market areas.
* Effectively communicates progress and needs to the management team.
* Become competent with and utilize Henkel’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools to manage the sales and customer management processes.
* Recognize competitive forces and prepare sales strategies to offset them

#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Four (4) year college degree
* Previous direct sales experience in the industrial market is desirable.
* This position will require the candidate to possess a hunter mentality. You will be primarily prospecting to obtain new business and bring on new customers.
* Computer literacy
* Time and territory management skills working from home
* Up to 60% travel requirement
* Most of the travel will be contained to the Midwest part of the United States. This will include travel throughout the territory of WI, MN, IL, ND, SD, NE and MO.
* Preference will be given to candidates that are living in Minneapolis or Chicago.
* This position is bonus eligible.

#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* **Health Insurance:** affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* **Work-Life Balance:** Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible & hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* **Financial:** 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* **Family Support:** 12-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption & surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* **Career Growth:** diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement

The salary range for this role is **$80,000.00 and $100,000.00**. This range represents the good‑faith minimum and maximum wages the Company reasonably expects to offer for this role at the time of posting. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for incentive pay or other forms of compensation, as applicable. The Company also offers a comprehensive benefits package as described above. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience, education, training, and work location. This posting is intended to comply with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws.  
  
Henkel does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered Henkel property and therefore, Henkel will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral.  
  
At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Henkel is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories.

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

  

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a driven Sales Development Representative to help **manage**Interdependence's growth engine. **This is a 100% inbound role. There is no cold calling or cold outreach. Prospective clients come to us, and** **you'll** **own a large, fast-moving pipeline of inbound leads from first response through a qualified, well-prepared meeting with our business development team.** You'll be the first touchpoint for prospective clients, **and we need someone who is highly organized, highly proactive, thoughtful, and strategic in every interaction.** **Above all, we're** **looking for a learning machine: someone who absorbs new industries, new businesses, and new challenges quickly and gets sharper with every conversation.**This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to learn the fundamentals of agency new business and grow into a closing or account leadership role over time.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Respond promptly and thoughtfully to every inbound lead generated through marketing campaigns, referrals, website inquiries, and events**

* Conduct discovery conversations to understand a prospect's communications challenges and determine fit for Interdependence's services
* Schedule qualified introductory meetings for senior business development leadership, **with a concise brief on each prospect's needs, context, and fit so leadership walks in prepared**
* Manage and maintain an organized, accurate pipeline in our CRM, tracking **every lead,** conversation, and next step **so nothing slips through the cracks**
* **Proactively follow up with and nurture leads that aren't ready yet, keeping momentum without being pushy**
* Meet or exceed monthly **response-time, qualification,** and meeting-booked targets
* Partner with marketing **to share feedback on lead quality, lead sources, and messaging so we can sharpen what attracts the right clients**
* **Be a learning machine:** stay current on strategic communications and marketing industry trends, **and build working knowledge of the industries our prospects come from,** so you can speak credibly to their challenges and opportunities
* Participate in weekly pipeline reviews, sharing insights on lead quality, objections, and conversion trends, **and bringing ideas, not just updates**
* Represent Interdependence professionally in every prospect interaction, serving as an extension of our brand and values

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years of experience in a sales development, business development, **inbound lead management, or client-facing** role (agency, SaaS, or professional services background a plus)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage a high volume of leads at once without dropping any**
* **Proactive and strategic: you anticipate next steps, spot patterns, and act before being asked**
* **Intensely curious and a fast learner, eager to understand new industries, business models, and how communications drives business outcomes**
* Self-motivated, with the ability to independently manage a busy pipeline
* Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) preferred
* A growth mindset and strong work ethic: someone who's coachable, competitive, and eager to develop

**PREFERRED**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field
* Familiarity with research tools (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar) **to quickly get smart on inbound prospects**
* **Understanding of public relations, strategic communications, or marketing is a bonus, though not required**
* Track record of exceeding **lead conversion,** **response-time,** or meeting-booked targets

  

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE**

**100% Remote, Forever -** Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

**Comprehensive Health Benefits -** Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build and scale our outbound motion into the mid-market segment at Steer, multi-location, full service auto repair groups operating 4 or more rooftops. This role is focused on uncovering and developing opportunities with growing repair groups, engaging multiple stakeholders across an organization, and guiding prospects through a longer, more consultative sales process than a typical single-shop deal.

This is not a passive, inbound role. You will be expected to create opportunities from scratch, navigate multi-location organizations with more than one decision-maker, and develop messaging that resonates with owners and operators managing growing, complex businesses. We are looking for someone who is no stranger to overcoming obstacles, comfortable with longer sales cycles, and strives to exceed expectations. *Compensation: 65k base + 25-35k variable* ***(90-100k OTE)***

**You Will**

* Consultative Selling: Employ a consultative approach to understand prospects' needs across a growing organization and tailor presentations to their specific pain points.
* Pipeline Management: Maintain meticulous records of sales activities and customer interactions in our CRM to ensure accurate forecasting across longer sales cycles.
* Partner for Success: Qualify opportunities and collaborate closely with the mid-market sales team on strategy and deal progression.

  

**You Have**

*Must Have:*

* BDR or SDR experience, ideally including outbound prospecting into organizations with more than one decision-maker.
* Proven Track Record: A history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and activity metrics.

* Presentation Skills: Experience performing product demonstrations and consultations.

*Nice to Have:*

* Industry Experience: Familiarity with the automotive industry, home services, or blue-collar sectors.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative Terminal Tractor

The **Sales Development Representative, Terminal Tractor** is responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence within an assigned territory. This position develops new business opportunities, builds and maintains strategic customer relationships, and serves as the primary sales representative for terminal tractor products and related solutions, including equipment sales, rentals, parts, service, and body shop support.

**Rush Truck Centers** opens the door to the world of opportunity. We are the largest network of commercial vehicle dealerships across the US representing truck and bus manufacturers. Our franchises include Peterbilt, International, Hino, Isuzu, Ford, IC Bus and Blue Bird. We offer a **rewarding career** as a leader in the transportation industry. **Grow with us** as we continue to expand our network of locations and services.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Develop and execute territory sales plans to generate new business opportunities, expand assigned account penetration, and increase terminal tractor market share.
* Identify, pursue, and secure sales opportunities through prospecting, customer engagement, relationship building, and strategic account management.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for terminal tractor solutions, including equipment sales, rentals, parts, service, maintenance, and body shop support.
* Drive aftermarket revenue growth by promoting parts, service, maintenance, and rental offerings that support customer retention and long-term account value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with transportation, distribution, warehousing, intermodal, manufacturing, and related industry customers.
* Collaborate with sales, service, parts, rental, and operations teams to coordinate customer solutions and support a consistent customer experience.

* Achieve or exceed established sales, revenue, profitability, customer growth, pipeline management, and activity reporting objectives.

* Must possess a current and valid driver's license with a driving record that meets the insurability guidelines set forth by the company’s insurance carrier.

* Strong relationship-building and consultative selling skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with General Managers, Truck Sales Managers, Aftermarket Sales Managers, and cross-functional sales teams to execute growth initiatives.
* Proficiency using CRM systems to manage customer accounts, sales pipelines, forecasting, and activity tracking; working knowledge of parts, service, rentals, aftermarket programs, or fleet maintenance operations preferred.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to identify customer needs and recommend comprehensive equipment and aftermarket solutions.
* Ability to analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer data to identify opportunities and support strategic sales decisions.
* Effective verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines in a dynamic sales environment.
* Ability to prepare and present sales forecasts, territory performance updates, and market intelligence reports to leadership.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented with the ability to work independently while achieving sales and growth objectives.

You'll essentially be an extra set of capable hands wherever they're needed.

No two events will look exactly the same. One weekend you may help transform a backyard for a private event. Another weekend you might assist our bartending, catering, children's entertainment, or activation teams at a client event.

We're looking for people who can take direction, move quickly, stay positive, and aren't afraid to jump in and help.

**What You'll Do**

Responsibilities may include:

* Assisting with event setup and breakdown
* Loading and unloading event equipment and supplies
* Setting up tables, chairs, décor, bars, signage, lighting, and event activations
* Helping prepare Miles Lawrence Company events and client events
* Restocking supplies throughout events
* Keeping event spaces organized and guest-ready
* Supporting bartending, catering, entertainment, and activation teams as needed
* Assisting with cleanup and packing equipment after events
* Running supplies or completing small event-related errands
* Helping solve unexpected problems during an event
* Working alongside event leads to ensure events run smoothly
* Representing the Miles Lawrence Company professionally around clients and guests

This is a **hands-on position**. You should be comfortable moving equipment, being on your feet, working both indoors and outdoors, and helping wherever the team needs you.

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Dependable and punctual
* Friendly and professional
* Comfortable taking direction
* Able to work independently after receiving instructions
* Detail-oriented
* Flexible when plans change
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment
* Willing to do both the fun and not-so-glamorous parts of event production
* Comfortable interacting with clients, vendors, guests, and other team members

We're more interested in finding people with a strong work ethic, good attitude, and willingness to learn.

**Schedule**

There are **no guaranteed weekly hours**. Team members will be offered available event shifts and may accept shifts based on their availability.

* Remain on their feet for extended periods

------------------

The Inside Account Management team is part of DoorDash's SMB account management engine.

From our hubs in Tempe and Chicago, our team ensures that our merchants understand how to maximize their visibility, optimize their operations, and thrive on DoorDash. We pride ourselves on being data-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to championing small business success.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Success Manager (MSM), you will play a critical role in supporting and growing DoorDash's SMB restaurant partners. You will manage a focused book of approximately 75 merchants, building long‑term relationships and helping restaurant owners improve their performance on the platform. Through consistent outbound calls, email outreach, and data‑driven conversations, you will guide merchants on how to increase visibility, optimize their listings, adopt DoorDash products, and ultimately grow their revenue.

You'll be accountable for hitting weekly and quarterly KPIs — including high‑volume outbound activity (dials, talk time), strategic merchant calls, QBR delivery, and results tied to revenue, operational metrics, ads/promo adoption, and fair pricing conversations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys fast‑paced, high‑volume merchant engagement, uses data to drive decisions, and feels energized by work that blends sales, account management, and portfolio‑level strategy.

We expect this role to be flexible in terms of time spent remote and in-office with the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through training, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Make high‑volume outbound dials to existing merchants in your book of business (approximately 75 SMB restaurants), using a clear prioritization framework to decide where to focus your time and energy
* Establish goals and key performance indicators for your restaurant partners, and regularly review performance against those targets.
* Advise business owners on pricing, promotions, and product adoption (e.g., DashPass, Ads, promos) to achieve their revenue and margin goals, clearly explaining trade‑offs.
* Communicate with merchants by phone and email on an ongoing basis to monitor performance, surface risks, and proactively support progress toward their goals.
* Deliver and present quarterly business reviews ("QBR") that review a brand's partnership with DoorDash, pinpointing success, highlighting areas for revenue optimizations, and planning for areas of opportunity and growth

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 4 years preferred peripheral vascular arterial sales or related medical device experience.
* Maintain all Certifications and Vendor Credentials.
* Demonstrate consistent quota attainment.
* Great communication skills
* Able to travel extensively, including overnight to client facilities by auto or aircraft 70- 80% of the time.

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. new_jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, SLED
new_jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the SLED (State, Local Government and Education) segment. RAM is a field sales position. This role will be responsible for working with CA State Agencies. RAM will execute a Go-To Market Strategy derived from prospecting and collaborating with SLED Focused Partners to build and maintain a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to continue your selling career. You will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall field sales career path at Fortinet and State experience would be a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory.
* Meet or exceed the required number of face-to-face meetings each month with customers and partners in the territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
* Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts, and recognition.
* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations, and quotes in Salesforce.com).
* Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner.
* Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects & customers.
* Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the Mid-Market segment.
* Follow up on inbound, web, and corporate event leads.
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentations and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING).
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported.
* Act as a liaison between partners, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members.
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth of our business.
Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Coachable and flexible.
* 1+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space, with a preference for experience selling to SLED accounts.
* Working knowledge of the businesses, procurement processes, and partners in the local territory, especially within the SLED sector.
* Ability to run productive customer-facing and partner-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow-up.
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets.
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally.
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota.
* Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high-volume workload.
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
* Be computer savvy.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills.
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner.
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction.
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience selling cybersecurity or technology solutions to State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts.
* Familiarity with government procurement processes, cooperative purchasing agreements, and budget cycles in the SLED sector.
* Public/private cloud experience is a plus.
* Experience with multi-tier distribution is a plus.
Experience in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud is a plus.  

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $130,000 - $160,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

new_jobs.title: Mission Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

The Mission Operations Specialist serves as the frontline technical representative supporting internal R&D, deployed systems and customer operations. This role is responsible for fielding and troubleshooting CHAOS Industries' software and hardware capabilities in operational environments. This role requires strong initiative: build trust, learn, drive, and deliver outcomes and flawless execution.

A Mission Operations Specialist works directly with front-line military, government, and commercial customers to ensure mission success. Successful candidates thrive in ambiguous environments, possess strong technical aptitude, and are comfortable operating independently in the field. The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional planning and coordination skills, an aptitude for flawless execution and an eagerness to apply them to the tactical deployment of CHAOS Industries systems. This role sits within the Operations & Training group on the Mission team.

**Responsibilities:**

* **System Deployment & Fielding**
  + You're excited to be where the customer needs us.
  + You are detail-oriented to ensure everything for a given deployment is at maximum readiness and gets where it needs to be, on time.
  + You will coordinate, plan, and setup for internal R&D testing, customer demonstrations, exercises and deliveries.
  + Support installation, configuration, integration, and fielding of company systems.
  + Cross-functionally coordinate with logistics, engineering, and program teams to ensure successful deployments.
  + Success in this role means you're the customer's most trusted tactical partner.
* **Know our products – know the mission**
  + This role requires you to have intimate product knowledge and willingness to be hands-on with hardware in the field with customers. Success requires a thorough understanding of our technology, capabilities, and resources squared with the mission and user requirements.
  + You will lead basic system troubleshooting with confidence and support CHAOS engineering teams in the diagnosis and resolution of hardware, software, networking, and system integration issues.
  + Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams while providing detailed reproduction steps and operational context.
  + Work full-time onsite at our Headquarters in Hawthorne, CA.
  + Regular CONUS/OCONUS travel required for product testing, customer demonstrations and customer delivery (50%).
  

**Minimum Requirements:**

* 3+ years of experience supporting military, government, or enterprise technology systems.
* A solution-oriented mentality; you know to go to obtain missing information, use creativity to problem solve, and relish the opportunity to take on a difficult problem. Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking environments.
* Experience with tactical communications, networking, sensors, UAS, C2 systems, or AI-enabled platforms.
* You enjoy getting your hands dirty, literally: CHAOS is an engineering-first company with a hardware component.
* Ability to seamlessly organize and navigate overseas engagements, operating in remote areas and able to plan for and mitigate risk to reputation, mission and personnel. We intend to go with our customers to where they need us most to deliver.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and communication software like Slack, Teams and Zoom.
* Active U.S. security clearance **or** ability to obtain one.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree desired (but not required) in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Military Science, or related field.
* Previous FSR, FAE, Systems Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Operations Engineer experience with a hardware component.
* Knowledge of radar, RF, sensor, weapons systems, defense technology and communications preferred.
* Military background or extensive experience working with militaries.

  

**Why CHAOS?**

* **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
* **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
* **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch, 'No meeting Fridays', unlimited PTO, casual dress code
* **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
* **Team Growth:** 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

***Hourly Rate: $35.00 - $58.00 per hour***

*The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.*

  

### **Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.**

  

*#LI-onsite*

Canine Operations Assistant / Owner's Right-Hand

**Pawsitive K9 Solutions**  
**Pay Range: $22–$27 per hour**

Position Overview

This is **not a traditional receptionist position**.

This person needs to be comfortable moving from one responsibility to another throughout the day. One moment you may be transporting a dog, the next you may be updating a client's record, helping a trainer, answering a client call, adjusting the schedule, videotaping a training session, or addressing an unexpected issue with a dog.

THE BIGGEST REQUIREMENT

**This person needs to take things off the business owner's plate.**

The owner makes the important decisions. The assistant makes sure the **details are handled, communication happens, schedules stay organized, problems are identified, and things actually get done.**

We are looking for someone who can eventually be trusted to say:

“I saw the problem, I handled what I could, and I brought the owner in only when necessary.”

* Identify scheduling conflicts before they become problems.
* Communicate schedule changes to the appropriate team members.
* Keep the day moving without the owner having to manage every individual detail.

4. Client Communication & Customer Service

* Answer calls and texts professionally when needed.
* Communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally with clients.
* Follow up on client communication and outstanding requests.
* Coordinate pickups, drop-offs, appointments, payments, and client information.
* Provide clients with appropriate updates regarding their dogs.
* Help resolve routine client questions and issues.
* Recognize situations that require escalation to the business owner.
* Maintain a professional representation of Pawsitive K9 Solutions in every client interaction.

5. Technology & Administration

The successful candidate must be comfortable learning and using technology.

* Become proficient with **Time To Pet, Google Workspace, scheduling systems, payment systems, and other company software**.
* Maintain accurate dog and client records.
* Track vaccination records and required paperwork.
* Keep client and dog information organized and current.
* Update schedules, records, notes, and other operational information accurately.
* Assist with administrative tasks that support the daily operation.
* Learn new software and systems quickly.
* Use technology as a tool to make the operation more efficient.

6. Video Documentation of Training Sessions

**Video documentation is a regular part of this position.**

The assistant will occasionally videotape dog training sessions for client report cards, progress updates, training documentation, and marketing or educational purposes when authorized.

The candidate must be **confident and comfortable entering an active training environment and capturing useful footage without disrupting the trainer or dogs.**

Responsibilities include:

* Videotape dog training sessions using a phone or camera.

* Organize and upload videos to the appropriate client or dog record.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
new_jobs.description:
About Resolve

Resolve is a digital marketing agency with a background in search engine marketing. We’re expanding our own social media presence and developing our social marketing offering, and we’re looking for a practical, creative marketer to help build it.

Initially, you’ll focus on marketing Resolve itself: planning content, creating static graphics, writing posts and developing a consistent presence across our chosen channels. As the client base grows, there may be opportunities to take on client campaigns and increase your hours by mutual agreement.

What you’ll do

* Develop a clear social media and content plan for Resolve
* Build and maintain a content calendar, taking posts from idea through approval and publishing
* Create polished static graphics and ad creatives using Canva, Adobe or similar tools
* Write engaging captions and content that explain our services clearly
* Recommend which channels and content formats deserve our attention
* Review performance and use the results to improve future content
* Keep creative files, tasks and deadlines organised
* Help develop Meta advertising campaigns as needed
* Gradually take on client communication and campaign responsibilities as the role develops

What we’re looking for

* Hands-on experience creating content and managing social media for a business or agency
* A portfolio showing strong static design and clear written communication
* Practical experience with Meta Ads Manager; Google Ads experience is an advantage
* Experience communicating directly with clients and explaining marketing work clearly
* Strong organisation, reliable follow-through and attention to detail
* The ability to turn a brief into finished work and ask useful questions when something needs clarification
* Confidence working independently in the office, with regular remote check-ins with the founder

The arrangement

This role starts at two days per week, approximately 16 hours, with the working days agreed together. The planned office is at the Pacific Design Center in West Hollywood, subject to the space being confirmed. You should be comfortable working on site while the founder is overseas.

As the business and workload grow, there may be scope to increase hours, potentially to full-time. This would depend on business needs and mutual agreement.

How to apply

Please send your résumé, a brief introduction and examples of social posts or static ad creatives you’ve personally produced. Tell us what you were responsible for and include any results you can share. Please remove confidential client information from your examples.

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 per week

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**Social Media Manager**

**Shape the Social Voice of Waterless Beauty with Oliveda**

Waterless Beauty is the fastest-growing sector in the beauty industry, and we are one of the fastest-growing waterless beauty brands disrupting the industry.

**About the Role**

As our **Social Media Manager,** you will be responsible for shaping and growing Oliveda's organic social presence across key platforms. You will bring the brand story to life through relevant, engaging content while building an active community around waterless beauty.

This role combines social strategy, content planning, community engagement, and performance analysis. You will have a strong understanding of platform culture and trends and know how to translate brand priorities into social-first content that builds awareness, engagement, and organic growth.

You will work closely with Creative, Graphic Design, Influencer Marketing, E-commerce, and Performance Marketing to ensure Oliveda's social presence is consistent, timely, and aligned with broader brand and campaign priorities.

**About Oliveda**

Oliveda is a global waterless beauty brand rooted in the power of the olive tree. Founded more than two decades ago, the company grew from a pioneering approach to holistic wellness into a global beauty movement centered around waterless skincare and beauty formulations.

Today, Oliveda is expanding rapidly in the U.S. and internationally, combining decades of olive tree expertise with an innovative approach to beauty that replaces conventional water-based formulations with antioxidant-rich olive tree elixirs.

**What You'll Do**

· Develop and execute Oliveda's organic social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, and emerging platforms

· Own and maintain the social content calendar in alignment with product launches, campaigns, promotions, and brand priorities

· Develop social-first content concepts, briefs, captions, and messaging that reflect Oliveda's brand voice

· Manage day-to-day community engagement and customer interaction across social channels

· Identify platform trends, cultural moments, and content opportunities relevant to beauty and wellness

· Partner with Creative and Graphic Design to develop compelling social assets and short-form content

· Support influencer and UGC initiatives by integrating appropriate content into Oliveda's owned social channels

· Track organic KPIs including reach, engagement, audience growth, content performance, and organic traffic

· Analyze platform and content performance and use insights to improve the social strategy

· Provide clear social-media reporting, insights, and recommendations

· Stay current on platform updates, emerging formats, trends, and social-media best practices

**What We're Looking For**

· 4+ years of social media management, social content, or related brand experience

· Demonstrated experience managing social channels for a consumer-facing brand

· Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms

· Excellent understanding of social-first storytelling, content development, and community engagement

· Strong copywriting skills and the ability to maintain a consistent brand voice

· Experience using social analytics to guide content and channel decisions

· Beauty, skincare, wellness, or lifestyle-brand experience is highly preferred

· Strong organizational and project-management skills

· Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

**Nice to Have**

· Experience with influencer or creator content

· Experience incorporating UGC into owned social channels

· Experience with social listening and community-management tools

· Basic short-form video editing or content-production skills

· Experience supporting product launches and integrated brand campaigns

· Familiarity with social commerce and TikTok Shop

· Experience working in founder-led or high-growth DTC brands

new_jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative (BDR)**

**Location:** Greater Los Angeles Area (primarily Orange County, CA)  
**Job Type:** Full-time | Hybrid / Field-Based  
**Base Salary:** USD $55,000-$60,000 annually  
**On-Target Earnings (OTE):** USD $80,000-$95,000 annually  
**Commission:** Uncapped  
**Travel:** Regular local travel required | Business mileage reimbursed

**About LogicLamp**

LogicLamp is a turn-key energy solutions partner helping organizations achieve lasting energy savings, operational excellence, and a cleaner future. Built on trust and powered by expertise, we work alongside our customers to design, deliver, and implement smart, sustainable, and cost-effective energy upgrades.

Our solutions include LED lighting upgrades, EV charging, smart thermostats, energy monitoring, electrical maintenance, and other energy-efficiency solutions

**Job Summary**

LogicLamp is looking for an experienced Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate new commercial and industrial business opportunities across the Greater Los Angeles Area, primarily Orange County.

This is a hands-on, field-focused B2B sales role for someone who is comfortable getting in front of prospective customers and creating opportunities from the ground up. You will engage businesses through in-person field and door-to-door prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and existing prospect databases.

Your primary objective will be to generate qualified commercial and industrial opportunities and book on-site energy assessments for LogicLamp's sales and technical teams. You will primarily prospect for LogicLamp's commercial lighting retrofit, EV charging, solar power, and other energy-efficiency solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-person B2B field and door-to-door prospecting throughout the Los Angeles and Orange County territory.
* Generate qualified opportunities and book on-site energy assessments for LogicLamp's sales and technical teams.
* Develop new business through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and existing prospect databases.
* Prospect for commercial lighting retrofit, EV charging, solar power, and other energy-efficiency solutions.
* Engage commercial and industrial organizations, including multifamily properties and property management companies.
* Identify and connect with relevant contacts and decision-makers within prospective organizations.
* Clearly and professionally communicate LogicLamp's solutions and value proposition to prospective customers.
* Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects to develop relationships and move opportunities toward qualified assessments.
* Maintain accurate prospecting activity, follow-ups, and opportunity information within the company's CRM.
* Collaborate with LogicLamp's sales and technical teams to ensure qualified opportunities are effectively handed off.
* Participate in networking opportunities, trade events, and other business development activities as required.
* Travel regularly throughout the assigned territory to support prospecting and business development.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional sales or business development experience, with demonstrated experience generating new business.
* Minimum 2+ years of door-to-door or in-person field prospecting experience required.
* Proven ability and willingness to proactively approach prospective customers in person.
* Experience using CRM systems to manage prospecting activities, follow-ups, and opportunities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with commercial decision-makers.
* Self-motivated, organized, resilient, and comfortable working independently in a field-based environment.
* Demonstrated coachability and a willingness to continuously improve your sales approach.
* Genuine interest in energy efficiency, sustainability, and commercial energy solutions.
* Valid driver's license and reliable access to a personal vehicle are required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B2B sales experience with commercial or industrial customers.
* Experience in energy efficiency, commercial lighting, solar, EV charging, electrical services, or a related industry.
* Experience working with property managers, multifamily properties, facility managers, building owners, or other commercial decision-makers.
* Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM platform.

**What We Offer**

* **USD $55,000-$60,000 base salary.**
* **USD $80,000-$95,000 OTE.**
* Uncapped commission, giving strong performers the opportunity to earn beyond target OTE.
* Reimbursement for approved business mileage.
* A hybrid, field-based work environment with significant independence in managing your territory.
* The opportunity to develop business across multiple energy solutions rather than representing a single product.
* An opportunity to contribute to projects that help businesses reduce energy consumption, improve their facilities, and achieve meaningful long-term energy savings.

**Territory & Work Arrangement**

This position is responsible for business development throughout Los Angeles and Orange County.

This is a hybrid, field-based role. The successful candidate should expect to spend significant time travelling throughout the assigned territory, prospecting businesses in person, and developing customer relationships.

LogicLamp's California office is located in Fullerton, California. The role requires in-office attendance every Friday, with additional office attendance as business needs require.

Pay: From $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

* Driver's License (Required

new_jobs.title: IT Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Come join our family at In-N-Out Burger!**

The In-N-Out Burger IT Project Management Office team has an excellent opportunity for an **IT Project Coordinator**, located in the Irvine, CA office\*.

The IT Project Coordinator will report directly to the IT PMO Manager and help to coordinate and support smaller, internal IT projects, or assist on larger projects by managing tasks, facilitating communication, tracking progress, and working closely with technical teams to ensure projects meet timelines and customer needs.

*\*This role is based full-time in office\**

**General Responsibilities**

* Coordinate, support and manage smaller IT projects from initiation through closeout, supporting scope, timelines, resources, and deliverables in accordance with IT PMO standards.
* Support Agile and Waterfall project activities, including sprint planning, scrum meetings, project schedules, and task tracking.
* Lead and facilitate project meetings, document key decisions and action items, and follow up with project teams to support timely completion.
* Partner with technical leads and cross-functional teams to track project risks, issues, dependencies, and scope changes, escalating when appropriate.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including Project Charters, Change Orders, RFI/RFP materials, rollout documentation, and training guides.
* Maintain project information and team coordination through tools such as Jira, Asana, and Confluence.
* Identify opportunities to improve PMO processes, tools, and project delivery practices.

**Work Schedule and Benefits**

* Full-time position, Non-exempt, Hourly
* Office Hours in Irvine, CA: Monday-Friday, 8:00 am-5:00 pm
* Department needs will call for occasional overtime
* Excellent Benefits, to include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, FSA’s, 401(k)/Profit Sharing Plan, Adoption Assistance, Education Reimbursement, Supplemental Health Plans and Pet Insurance
* Pay Range: $32.00 - $35.50/hour
* *The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your experience and other job-related factors.*

**Qualifications for In-N-Out Associates**

* 2+ years of In-N-Out Burger Store or Support experience required.
* Store leadership experience preferred, including experience as a Shift Manager, Store Trainer, All Star, or similar role.

**Qualifications**

* Previous or Current employment with In-N-Out Burger highly preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 1+ year of experience in project coordination, project support, or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of project lifecycle concepts, including scope, timelines, resources, risks, and deliverables.
* Familiarity with Agile and/or Waterfall project management practices.
* Experience with or exposure to project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, and Microsoft Teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, time-management, communication, and customer service skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively across teams, and adapt to changing project needs.
* Comfortable learning and working with new technology, systems, and processes.

**Work Location Details**

In-N-Out Burger plans to bring its west coast headquarters team back together under one roof by the end of 2029. After maintaining two Southern California office locations for many years, the company will permanently close its Irvine office in 2029 and once again headquarter the company’s western territory solely in Baldwin Park, California, where the company was founded in 1948.

Newly hired Associates in Irvine will be eligible to participate in the group move to Tennessee with relocation assistance or work from our western headquarters in Baldwin Park, CA, upon its opening in 2029. We are sharing this information early so candidates can make informed decisions while considering a career with In-N-Out Burger.

**About In-N-Out Burger**

In-N-Out Burger was founded in 1948 by Harry and Esther Snyder in Baldwin Park, California, and remains privately owned and operated. Under the direction of the Snyder family, the company has opened restaurants throughout California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Washington, and Tennessee. In-N-Out Burger’s menu has remained the same since 1948, and we have maintained a simple philosophy – serve only the highest quality product, prepare it in a clean and sparkling environment, and serve it in a warm and friendly manner. We have built a reputation for fresh, made-to-order foods prepared and served by friendly, well trained Associates.

In-N-Out Burger offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer by choice. Should there be a need, In-N-Out Burger will provide a reasonable accommodation to complete the interview process upon request.

new_jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**
=======================

**Date:** Oct 6, 2026

**Location:** San Jose, California, United States

**Company:** Super Micro Computer

**Job Req ID: 30216**
---------------------

**About Supermicro:**
---------------------

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

Supermicro is currently looking for a Project Coordinator to join our team.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------

* **Quality Management System Support:** Help maintain and improve the QMS so processes remain aligned with applicable ISO and quality standards, internal procedures, and customer or certification requirements.
* **Internal Auditing:** Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits to assess process effectiveness, measure performance, and identify gaps or nonconformities.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Track operational issues and nonconformities, support root-cause analysis, and work with process owners to implement and verify corrective and preventive actions.
* **External Audit Support:** Serve as a point of contact for certification bodies and other external auditors during compliance, surveillance, and recertification audits; help prepare evidence and follow up on findings.
* **Training and Awareness:** Support employee training and awareness on quality standards, documented processes, and continuous-improvement practices.
* **Document and Record Control:** Maintain controlled documents, records, and logs so quality documentation remains accurate, current, secure, and readily available for operations and audits.
* **Reporting and Follow-Up:** Prepare audit summaries, track open actions, and provide status updates to support management review and ongoing improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Quality Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 1+ years of experience in quality, compliance, auditing, document control, or ISO coordination preferred.
* Experience supporting ISO 9001 or another management system (e.g., ISO 13485) is a plus.
* Experience in technology, operations, logistics, or a service environment is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); familiarity with databases, document control systems, or audit/QMS software preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with people across departments.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work in a logical, systematic way and follow issues through to closure.
* Internal auditor training or certification is preferred but not required.

**Salary Range**
----------------

$28.00 - $30.00 /hr

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills,years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus andequity award programs.

**EEO Statement**
-----------------

Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

new_jobs.description:
* We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.
* Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 10x so far in 2026.
* We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.
* We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.
* Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.
* We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

As the Recruiting Coordinator you’ll ensure that everyone interviewing at Blacksmith has the best possible interview experience.  
You’ll own the logistics of the interview experience. Coordinating interview schedules, managing onsites and supporting executive interviews across all functions within the business.

**What you’ll do**

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

BOOTS ON THE GROUND. Check on listings for lights, lockboxes and signage. Meet vendors and inspectors on site. Pick up and make keys. Coordinate staging logistics. Handle broker tour catering and setup.

CLIENT-FACING MOMENTS. You may deal with clients by phone or in person. You will need to be warm, professional and comfortable representing the Marin Home Team.

VENDORS. Schedule inspectors, stagers, photographers and contractors. Manage quotes and project timelines. Maintain our vendor list.

**ADMIN**

EXPENSES. Add my expenses to the team tracker, pay invoices, keep the records straight.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TOOLS. Manage operational subscriptions such as the website, Dropbox and Zoom. Troubleshoot tech issues. Research new tools.

INDUSTRY. Attend Compass meetings and industry events as needed, take notes, keep me informed.

REPORTING. Enter new listings and buyer activity in our business tracker. Monitor Top Agent. Network for inventory and opportunities.

**THE FIRST SIX WEEKS**

My days are genuinely different from one another, and real estate does not run to a tidy schedule. So rather than pretend I know exactly which hours I will need you and get it wrong, the first six weeks are a working trial for both of us.

Part of your job in those six weeks is helping me work out what the rhythm actually is. Which days, which hours, what gets batched, what has to happen live. At the end of it we lock in a schedule that reflects reality, and you will know what you are agreeing to because you helped build it.

If it is not right for either of us at that point, we shake hands and part on good terms.

**WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:**

THE ESSENTIALS

* You are organized in a way other people notice and appreciate
* You are a problem solver who anticipates what is needed before being asked
* You are comfortable with technology and pick up new tools quickly
* You communicate clearly, professionally and warmly
* You can work independently and manage your own time
* You are based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley daily. This role needs you physically present here on a regular basis
* You have strong computer skills: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Claude, and a willingness to learn whatever else comes

NICE TO HAVE

* Previous experience in real estate operations, or somewhere similarly client-facing and
* detail-heavy
* Comfort with CRM systems. Compass experience is a bonus and not a requirement
* Marketing or design skills
* Social media experience
* Experience with DocuSign, Dropbox, Slack or other project manageme

new_jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the SLED (State, Local Government and Education) segment. RAM is a field sales position. This role will be responsible for working with CA State Agencies. RAM will execute a Go-To Market Strategy derived from prospecting and collaborating with SLED Focused Partners to build and maintain a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to continue your selling career. You will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall field sales career path at Fortinet and State experience would be a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory.
* Meet or exceed the required number of face-to-face meetings each month with customers and partners in the territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
* Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts, and recognition.
* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations, and quotes in Salesforce.com).
* Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner.
* Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects & customers.
* Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the Mid-Market segment.
* Follow up on inbound, web, and corporate event leads.
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentations and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING).
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported.
* Act as a liaison between partners, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members.
* Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth of our business.
Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Coachable and flexible.
* 1+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space, with a preference for experience selling to SLED accounts.
* Working knowledge of the businesses, procurement processes, and partners in the local territory, especially within the SLED sector.
* Ability to run productive customer-facing and partner-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow-up.
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets.
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally.
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota.
* Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high-volume workload.
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.
* Be computer savvy.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills.
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner.
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction.
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values.
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience selling cybersecurity or technology solutions to State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) accounts.
* Familiarity with government procurement processes, cooperative purchasing agreements, and budget cycles in the SLED sector.
* Public/private cloud experience is a plus.
* Experience with multi-tier distribution is a plus.
* Experience in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Organic & Conversion
new_jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

#### **Overview**

We're looking for someone exceptionally sharp who treats a funnel like a puzzle to solve. Ideal backgrounds include: Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Web Growth, or Growth Product roles, especially at high-growth consumer or prosumer companies where experimentation is a way of life. You could also be one of the first marketers at a startup, or come from an equivalent role like biz ops or growth analytics with experience building from 0 to 1. We care more about how you think and how much you own than about whether you've done this exact job before.

#### **About the Role**

At Verkada, we're known to push traditional boundaries, and our B2B growth efforts are no exception. We're reinventing Growth here. As a **Growth Marketing Manager, Organic & Conversion**, you'll be part of a high-performing team with backgrounds spanning investment banking, consulting, marketing, and high-growth startups. In this role, you'll own verkada.com as a revenue engine and the warm email programs that turn interest into pipeline. You'll build our organic and AI search engine from the ground up, run experiments on every page and form that matters, and make sure every lead gets the right next step. This is a highly visible, high-autonomy role that offers the opportunity to directly influence how Verkada converts demand into revenue.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week (with flexible hours).

#### **What You'll Do**

* **Organic & AI Search:** Own organic and AI-search pipeline. Build our SEO and AEO strategy, decide what is truly high-leverage, and partner with content, web, and engineering teams to ship it. Use AI tools to move faster than a traditional SEO team.
* **Website Conversion:** Own conversion rate across verkada.com, including organic, paid, webinar, and event pages. Run a disciplined experimentation program and know which tests are worth running and which are not.
* **Forms & Funnel:** Rethink form experiences and conversion paths from first visit to booked meeting. Remove friction wherever it costs us pipeline
* **Lifecycle Email:** Own warm email performance across nurture, webinar and event follow-up, and re-engagement programs. Measure success in meetings and pipeline, not opens.
* **Measurement & Signals:** Define the conversion events that matter and make sure tracking is clean.
* **Cross-Department Collaboration:** Work closely with data science, marketing operations, web and design, product marketing, marketing development representatives (MDRs), and sales. Share learnings across teams to drive continuous improvement.

#### **What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, growth product, biz ops, a startup or equivalent. Consumer or prosumer growth experience highly preferred.
* A track record of owning a number and moving it, with fast promotions or expanding scope to show for it.
* Strong experimentation judgment: you have run A/B tests yourself and can explain why you chose them.
* A working understanding of how SEO and AEO work, and real curiosity about where AI search is going. Deep specialist expertise is not required.
* Proficiency in data analysis and web analytics (GA4, Google Tag Manager). Knowledge of SQL and Excel preferred.
* A builder's mindset: high ownership, a bias to action, and a love of hard puzzles.

  

### 

**US Employee Benefits**

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
* Expanded mental health support

* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

* Wellness/fitness benefits
* Healthy lunches provided daily
* Commuter benefits

* You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative**

***Location:*** San Jose, CA  
***Job Type:*** Full-time, On-Site  
***Salary:*** $28-$38 per hour

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated, results-driven Inside Sales Representative to join our team. In this role, you will manage and grow a portfolio of established customer accounts while building strong, long-term relationships.

You will work closely with customers to understand their needs, identify opportunities for additional products and services, and provide solutions that support their business. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, customer-focused, and enjoys developing relationships while achieving sales goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the full inside sales cycle, including quoting and closing deals within NetSuite following our established procedures.

* Support AEs as needed with system-related questions, CRM tasks, and quote preparation

* Manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts and serve as a primary point of contact.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers through phone, email, and virtual meetings.

* Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through additional products and services.

* Understand customer needs, challenges, and business goals and recommend appropriate solutions.

* Develop account strategies focused on customer retention and revenue growth.

* Manage sales opportunities throughout the sales process and follow up consistently.

* Meet or exceed assigned sales goals and performance targets.

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer information, activities, and sales opportunities.

* Work closely with internal teams to provide a positive and responsive customer experience.

* Stay engaged with customers after the sale to support customer satisfaction, repeat business, and referrals.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3+ years of inside sales, account management, or similar experience, preferably in a B2B environment.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.

* Goal-oriented and motivated to achieve and exceed sales targets.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities.

* Experience using CRM or customer management systems.

* NetSuite experience preferred.

* Proactive, positive attitude, and ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

* Experience working in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience with consultative or solution-based selling.
