* Competitive base salary plus commission or bonus opportunities.

* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.

* Flexible work arrangements, where applicable.

* Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

* Collaborative and supportive team environment.

**Why Join Us?**

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building customer relationships and wants to take ownership of established accounts while helping grow the business. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your sales skills, work closely with customers, and contribute directly to the success of the team.

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Tech Partnership
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Claude is becoming the AI layer inside the platforms where enterprises already work. Our partnership with Salesforce — anchored by Claudeforce — is the first and largest example, and a growing roster of strategic technology partners is following the same path: making Claude the front door to their products for millions of users.

As Field Marketing Manager, Tech Partnerships, you will own the ongoing comarketing relationship with these strategic tech partners. You will be the single marketing point of contact for each partner’s marketing organization, build and run the joint marketing plan, manage shared marketing funds, and turn large partnership agreements into pipeline-generating field programs — exec summits at partner flagship events, joint workshops, enablement moments, and co-branded activations around the world.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the day-to-day comarketing relationship with strategic tech partners, starting with Salesforce: be the one consistent Anthropic marketing voice your partner counterparts plan with, and keep both sides working from a single joint plan
* Build joint marketing plans with each partner, with goals and success metrics agreed before any shared funds are committed
* Manage joint marketing development funds (MDF): allocation across programs, spend tracking, compliance with partnership terms, and reporting on what the investment returned
* Design and execute flagship joint moments — executive summits and sessions at partner events (e.g., Dreamforce, World Tours), joint customer workshops, partner sales kickoff enablement, and co-hosted executive dinners
* Extend partner programs through the broader ecosystem, including joint activations with shared systems-integrator and consulting partners
* Measure what matters: partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, program-level attribution, and a partnership marketing health scorecard built with Marketing Ops
* Protect the brand: apply comarketing guidelines, run messaging and asset approvals in both directions, and know when to say no to a partner ask
* Operate as connective tissue across Anthropic: Partner Marketing, Partnerships/Business Development, segment field marketers, Product Marketing, Events, and Comms all touch these relationships. You keep them coordinated and the partner experience coherent

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Ownership of a comarketing relationship with a large strategic partner: a hyperscaler, a major SaaS platform, or an equivalent, including joint planning and MDF management
* A track record of executive-level field programs: summits, flagship-event activations, C-level dinners, and roadshows, with the pipeline to show for them
* Strong relationship-building skills: able to earn trust with partner marketing leaders while holding Anthropic's line on brand, messaging, and spend
* Comfort building in ambiguity: the playbook for this motion is being written now, and you'll write much of it
* Rigor on measurement: fluent in pipeline attribution with sales and ops counterparts

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant time in field, partner, or alliance marketing at a technology company
* Experience on both sides of a platform partnership (at the platform and at the ISV/partner)
* Familiarity with the AI ecosystem and how enterprises adopt AI products
* Experience running programs at global scale across multiple regions and event series
* Experience working with or marketing through global systems integrators

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$255,000 - $320,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthr

new_jobs.title: Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
**Customer Success Manager**
============================

About This Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our team. This role is a unique opportunity to be a part of the early Rec team and help define the operations, business strategy, and culture of the organization. You will work closely with best-in-class operations, sales, product, and engineering leaders across the company.

You will primarily be responsible for managing everything it takes to make each city partnership a success. This includes developing deep relationships with city partners and acting as their voice internally, driving adoption of new AI-powered features, and building the processes needed to ensure existing city deployments thrive and grow into upsell opportunities.

This is a role for the client operations “athlete”, a voracious learner that wants exposure to all aspects of our B2B SaaS business and is relentlessly resourceful in achieving their goals. You should be client-obsessed and ready to build solutions to whatever challenge a city is facing. This is a strategic role and we will give you both the freedom and responsibility to become the domain expert trusted to make the right calls. However, this is also a hands-on early stage role where strategic insight comes from putting in the execution work yourself.

Who You Are:

* 5+ years working in Customer Success at a tech company or startup, at a top consulting firm or finance firm, or a combination of both.
* You have strong client-services experience. You’re cool under pressure in front of senior client stakeholders and know how to manage key relationships
* You are a strong communicator. You can crisply communicate actionable data-driven insights and pitch tailored solutions to solve customers’ problems
* You are a strategic problem solver. You can break down ambiguous problems and apply a first principles approach to solving them
* You have exceptional project management skills. You can juggle multiple complex projects in flight and can reprioritize quickly
* You have an entrepreneurial spirit and a high degree of drive, energy, and passion for creating and managing world-class operational processes
* You are scrappy and resourceful. When something needs to get done, you always find a way to make it happen.
* Available to work onsite in our office in San Francisco

You Will Own:

* **Retain and grow customer accounts.** You’ll manage relationships with existing partners and strengthen customers’ engagements with Rec through renewals and expansion.
* **Own the customer relationship.** You’ll own the customer relationship with cities, serving as a trusted advisor and partner to executive and senior leadership across various functions.
* **Build the customer success processes and playbook.** Set the standard for an excellent customer experience and build the playbooks and processes to support this experience for your customers.
* **Synthesize, prioritize, and share learnings cross-functionally to shape product and business decisions.** You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners, especially product and sales, to distill learnings from your experience with cities, clearly synthesize and prioritize those learnings, and work with internal stakeholders to translate them into targeted improvements. You’ll directly shape the product development and sales targeting processes.

Compensation Range: $120K - $200K

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x'd engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world's first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

THE TEAM

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We're backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

CORE PRINCIPLES

TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers' requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

ACTION: GET IT DONE.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

YOUR ROLE

As a Customer Success Manager at Rox, you'll own the post-go-live customer lifecycle: adoption, health, risk recovery, and expansion readiness. You'll work across Guided and lower-touch accounts so Growth Strategists and FDEs can stay focused on high-stakes managed launches and technical delivery.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You'll run a clear operating cadence with accounts, keep utilization and value evidence visible, and catch leading indicators before they become churn. You'll partner closely with AEs when accounts are ready for expansion, and with Product and Engineering when post-sales signal should change the roadmap.

If you believe retention is earned through product value rather than promises, and you want to help build Customer Success at an agentic revenue platform from the ground up, we'd love to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own a book of post-go-live accounts through Momentum, Growing, At-Risk, and Active Expansion stages with clear success criteria per account
* Drive adoption and proof of value in the first period after go-live: consumption ramping, value evidence captured, and adjacent-team introductions while goodwill is highest
* Run the steady-state rhythm for healthy accounts: QBRs with exec sponsors, live org maps, and a committed rate of qualified expansion opportunities passed to AEs
* Diagnose At-Risk accounts early, own a dated recovery plan, and pause expansion plays until the health bar is met
* Partner with Growth Strategists and FDEs on handoffs so customers always know who owns them and what "good" looks like next
* Establish a reliable internal and customer operating cadence: standups, office hours, metrics reviews, and crisp written updates
* Turn post-sales signal into roadmap and docs input with Product and Engineering
* Build the playbooks and reporting that make time-to-value and health management repeatable as the book scales

QUALIFICATIONS

* 3+ years in customer success or post-sales, with ownership of retention, utilization, or expansion outcomes
* Track record managing relationships with VP-level stakeholders or above
* Strong balance of strategic thinking and operational execution; comfortable moving from an exec QBR to a deployment debug in the same day
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable time-to-value and turn healthy usage into expansion pipeline
* Deep empathy for enterprise customers and a passion for helping them succeed
* Strong analytical mindset; fluent working with metrics, success criteria, and customer data
* Experience with technical or AI-native products; able to speak credibly to current trends and tools
* STEM degree or quantitative background preferred
* Previous experience in consulting, banking, or similar structured environments is a plus
* Be located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

BENEFITS

* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside
* Health Insurance

APPLY

To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
new_jobs.description:
As a **Customer Success Engineer** at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

**Your Role and Impact:**

* **Onboarding Ownership:** Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.
* **Success Planning:** Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.
* **Value Articulation:** Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.
* **Proactive Engagement:** Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.
* **Technical Credibility:** Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

**This Role is a Fit for You If:**

-----------------------

We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

**Company Description**

Veolia in North America is the top-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**

**Position Purpose:**

The Program Coordinator serves as administrative and operational support for assigned data center commissioning projects for a particular client. This role supports and coordinates various aspects of complex commissioning projects to ensure on-time/budget delivery and client satisfaction. This is NOT a technical field role, success requires strong project management, financial acumen, team relationship skills.

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Administrative tasks for assigned programs - Process administrative requests; maintain project records; support program coordination; ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Project financials and performance - Monitor, and reconcile project budgets; track costs and expenditures; identify budget variances and cost overruns; ensure accurate project profitability tracking; prepare financial reports for leadership and clients.
* Project schedules and milestones - Understand project schedules maintained by PM; monitor project progress against SoW and milestone schedule; maintain communication for project activities across technical teams and sub-consultants.
* Documentation and records - Support organization of project files and folders; ensure accurate project records; support project closeout and lessons learned documentation.
* Project status reports - Develop monthly project status reports; support development of reports for leadership and clients; track key performance indicators; identify trends and issues.
* Client meetings and program activities - Support client / team meetings and workshops - invites and minutes; prepare meeting agendas and materials; track meeting decisions and action items.
* Technical teams and sub-consultants - Work with technical Project Managers/Commissioning Managers on milestone / task assignments; communicate assignments and scheduled work.
* Change orders and contract modifications - Support change order proposals and workflow; track status of pending and approved change orders.
* Proposal development and pricing - Enter sales leads into Salesforce and support with proposal development; manage proposal process.
* Process improvement - Support standardized processes and deliverables; collaborate with other Program Managers on cross-program issues.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education/Experience/Background:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Project Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3+ years of project coordination, operations, or business coordination experience.
* 3+ years coordinating project budgets, schedules, and financial tracking.
* 2+ years in a fast-paced, technical environment (data center, commissioning, or similar).
* Experience with change order management and contract administration.
* Experience with client program management and stakeholder communication.
* Experience with proposal development and pricing.
* Working knowledge of the commissioning process (Pre-Design, Design, Commissioning, Post-Turnover).
* Experience in AI tools such as Gemini Notebook, chat agents, and/or agent builders.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Excellent project coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong financial acumen and budget management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with project management tools (Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar).
* Proficiency with financial tools (Excel, accounting software).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently and take initiative.
* Attention to detail and accuracy (especially financial).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Great PC and Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to navigate through a variety of computer applications.
* High level of professionalism and integrity,
* Excellent typing skills.

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Data center operations or commissioning program management.
* Smartsheet or similar collaborative project management tools.
* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).
* Consulting or professional services environment.
* Background in PMO (Project Management Office) or program coordination.
* Contract administration and legal document review.

  
**Additional Information**

**Pay Range:** $70000 to $80000 Per Hour.

**Research Coordinator**
========================

The Research Coordinator serves as the Core Imaging Laboratory (CIL) Manager for the Chronic Subdural Hematoma Treatment with Embolization Versus Surgery Study (CHESS), a multicenter clinical trial within the Department of Medicine at RWJBarnabas Health. The CIL Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of centralized imaging workflows and serves as a critical connection between participating study sites, the Central Imaging Laboratory, and the study team.

By coordinating the acquisition, verification, processing, secure storage, and quality control of clinical imaging data, the CIL Manager helps ensure the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance of imaging data used in clinical research. This role works closely with study investigators and participating sites to maintain protocol adherence, support blinded analysis, and ensure imaging workflows remain consistent, efficient, and audit-ready throughout the study.

**A Typical Day:**
------------------

As a Research Coordinator, a typical day might include the following:

* Coordinating the acquisition, transfer, verification, and secure storage of CT imaging data from participating clinical trial sites.
* Managing day-to-day imaging workflows within the centralized, independent Core Imaging Laboratory.
* Serving as the primary point of contact between participating study sites and the Central Imaging Laboratory regarding imaging submissions and study requirements.
* Reviewing incoming imaging data for completeness, accuracy, quality, and compliance with study protocols.
* Performing quality checks on submitted imaging studies and identifying missing, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
* Communicating with site personnel to resolve imaging discrepancies and ensure appropriate data submissions.
* Overseeing image processing workflows using imaging technologies and platforms such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* Monitoring adherence to imaging acquisition and submission protocols across participating study sites.
* Ensuring imaging workflows comply with study requirements, institutional policies, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation related to imaging submissions, quality checks, processing, and study activities.
* Ensuring compliance with blinded image analysis procedures and maintaining the confidentiality and security of clinical research data.
* Preparing and batching imaging datasets for independent analysis in accordance with study protocols.
* Supporting regulatory documentation, reporting requirements, and study deliverables in coordination with the research team.
* Assisting with training and onboarding participating site personnel on imaging submission procedures, requirements, and workflows.
* Maintaining secure imaging archives in accordance with institutional policies and applicable NIH and research standards.
* Monitoring the overall imaging workflow to identify operational issues and implement appropriate solutions in collaboration with the study team.
* Collaborating with the Clinical Review Committee (CRC) Manager to ensure continuity of Core Imaging Laboratory operations when the CIL Manager is unavailable.
* Supporting other clinical research activities, operational needs, and study-related assignments as directed.

**This Role Might Be For You If:**
----------------------------------

* You are passionate about clinical research and are interested in contributing to studies that improve the treatment and outcomes of patients with neurological conditions.
* You have a strong understanding of clinical research processes and the importance of accurate, reliable, and secure research data.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing complex imaging workflows involving multiple clinical trial sites.
* You understand the importance of following study protocols and maintaining consistent processes across a multicenter clinical trial.
* You have strong attention to detail and can identify discrepancies, missing information, and quality issues within clinical imaging data.
* You are comfortable communicating with physicians, research staff, imaging personnel, and participating study sites.
* You can work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and collaborate with investigators and members of the study team.
* You are comfortable working with medical imaging systems and technologies such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* You understand the importance of confidentiality, blinded analysis, data security, and regulatory compliance in clinical research.
* You are able to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet study timelines.
* You have strong analytical, organizational, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
* You are interested in neurosurgery, neurology, neuroradiology, neurovascular conditions, or related areas of clinical research.
* You are comfortable supporting training, troubleshooting, and workflow coordination across multiple participating research sites.
* You value collaboration and understand the importance of maintaining contin

In this role, you will also build strong relationships with team members and customers – working to uncover and create needs with Hologic’s unique value proposition. This role will win with a customer focus and the ability to identify and create needs at the account level.

**What to Expect:**

* Provide clinical expertise to drive growth and exceed company revenue goals across the BSH continuum of care.
* Develop, implement and drive selling strategies and business plans that achieve/exceed quota and maximize Hologic’s market share and margin in the territory.
* Align in driving the goals and objectives of the Account Executive and achieve defined sales goals and quota within assigned account list.
* Present and successfully sell Hologic value proposition to multiple stakeholders at all levels.
* Develop trusted advisor level relationships with key customer contacts and decision makers.
* Share and action market feedback relative to competitive landscape, customer trends and products.
* Develop and manage sales funnel to analyze, track activity, and provide accurate forecasts.
* Leverage internal resource team across Clinical, Sales, Service, Technology and National Accounts to optimize customer experience.
* Educate through case coverage, in-services and office calls to drive account independence.
* Attend all corporate training, sales meetings, conventions, and in-field development courses.
* Train Technologists and Radiologists how to effectively use our biopsy products to drive conversions and increase utilization of all available products.
* Build professional relationships with physicians and other medical personnel by attending Medication Education programs, Journal Clubs, Residency programs and other events
* Build a winning team around the customer – needs the customer has and needs we create
* Holds self-accountable and fulfills commitments.
* Other responsibilities as deemed appropriate by management and as business dynamics change

**What We Expect:**

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 1+ year of experience in clinical sales or working in a clinical environment required.
* 3+ years of experience in clinical radiology/imaging/mammography, medical sales, or a related clinical field preferred.
* Candidates with backgrounds such as Radiology Technologists, Mammography Technologists, Registered Nurses (RN), or other clinical professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.

**ABOUT PHASE 3 MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS:**  
  
Phase 3 Marketing and Communications is an integrated marketing services company providing solutions from ideation to execution. Our mission is to simplify life for marketers by delivering the most-needed marketing services in-house, under one roof.  
  
A certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Corporate Plus® member, Phase 3 has offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Nashville, and the New York City metropolitan area. Since its founding in 2001, Phase 3 has been recognized as a top company by *Inc. 5000,* *Printing Impressions,* *Atlanta Business Chronicle, and Nashville Business Journal*.

**Position Summary:**

  

The Media Coordinator supports the planning, execution, monitoring and reporting of paid media programs across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients. Working closely with the Senior Media Manager, Media Director and specialized media partners, this role helps ensure campaigns are launched accurately, monitored consistently and managed according to client objectives, budgets and timelines.

  

This is an early-career role for someone who is analytical, creative, highly organized, curious about the changing media landscape and interested in developing a career in media planning and buying. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data, managing details and deadlines, communicating with internal and external partners, and learning how different media channels work together to achieve client goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Campaign Support & Optimization**

* Provide day-to-day support for client media programs across paid social, search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out-of-home and other media channels.
* Assist with campaign setup, trafficking, launches and ongoing campaign management.
* Monitor campaign performance, pacing and delivery and identify issues requiring attention.
* Support ongoing campaign optimization in partnership with the Senior Media Manager and specialized media partners.

  

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Monitor and analyze paid media performance and assist with monthly client reporting.
* Compile campaign data and help identify trends, insights and opportunities for optimization.
* Support development and maintenance of client dashboards and recurring performance reports.

  

**Media Buying & Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with media vendors and partners regarding media availability, specifications, buying, campaign launches and issue resolution.
* Coordinate creative specifications, deadlines and asset delivery with internal teams and media partners.
* Track media buys and confirm campaigns are running according to approved schedules and placements.
* Build productive working relationships with media vendors, platform representatives and external specialists.

  

**Budget & Billing Support**

* Assist with management and tracking of client media budgets, including campaign pacing and planned versus actual spend.
* Maintain accurate media budget and buy documentation.
* Coordinate media buy submissions, invoices and processing with the accounting department.
* Identify budget discrepancies and work with the Senior Media Manager and accounting team to resolve issues.
* Support monthly billing reconciliation and other media financial processes.

  

**Research & Media Trends**

* Stay current on changes across social platforms, search, programmatic, streaming, retail media and other emerging channels.
* Develop knowledge across media channels while building deeper expertise in assigned platforms and client categories.

  

**Client & Team Support**

* Assist with preparation of media plans, client presentations, status reports and meeting materials.
* Participate in internal and client meetings as appropriate and help document decisions, action items and next steps.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with media team members, account teams, vendors and other internal partners.
* Manage multiple assignments and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Partner effectively across account management, creative, finance and other agency disciplines to support successful campaign execution.

  

**Qualifications - Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, media or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with data and spreadsheets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, web traffic metrics and social media best practices.
* Interest in paid media, advertising platforms, consumer behavior and emerging media trends.
* Ability and willingness to learn new platforms, technologies and analytical tools.

  

**Qualifications - Preferred**

* Previous internship or professional experience in advertising, media, marketing or a related field.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics or similar advertising and analytics tools.

  

***This is a full-time in-office position in Atlanta, Georgia.***

The **Strategic Account Manager (SAM) — LTL SME** owns the ultimate health, retention, strategic growth, and overall performance of assigned accounts, serving as the primary authority on Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) strategy and network optimization.

While relying on Operations Account Managers (OAMs) and execution teams for daily freight movement, the SAM remains fully accountable for program outcomes. This role bridges the gap between high-level account strategy and operational execution—partnering closely with LTL Procurement and mixed TL/LTL operations teams to drive cost savings, service excellence, and value delivery across the customer's network.

### **Core Responsibilities & Execution Pillars**

#### **1. LTL Program Management & Strategic Optimization**

* **Network & Strategy Alignment:** Drive overarching LTL strategy across procurement and operations, acting as the subject-matter expert to align daily execution with macro account goals.
* **Deep-Dive Analytics:** Perform deep-dive program analyses to identify cost, service, and efficiency insights; translate raw data into actionable strategic initiatives (e.g., mode conversions, lane optimization, pooling, and drop trailer strategies).
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify process gaps, evaluate broader market dynamics, and champion LTL best practices across the account team.

#### **2. Governance, Financial Oversight & Tech Management**

* **Financial & Margin Management:** Review margins, monitor DTO queues, and analyze accessorial trends to eliminate avoidable costs and drive profitability.
* **Network Health Governance:** Monitor systemic operational issues (e.g., chronic offender carriers or troubled lanes) to resolve root-cause delays and missed pickups.
* **Tech Management:** Direct tech escalations, manage user access requests, and oversee EDI/API integrations and UAT testing to ensure seamless platform operations.

#### **3. Executive Customer Engagement & Value Delivery**

* **Value Proposition Ownership:** Ensure program value propositions are consistently communicated, validated, and delivered across all customer touchpoints.
* **Business Reviews (MBR/QBR):** Build high-impact presentation materials and lead Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews to showcase performance, key wins, and forward-looking strategic initiatives.
* **Relationship Expansion:** Strengthen executive-level relationships, engage new stakeholders, and position the company as an indispensable strategic partner.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5-7+ years of experience driving LTL account strategy, mode conversions, and laneoptimization within an account management or related role.
* Prior experience working with enterprise accounts or accounts with Freight Spend of 20M +
* Experience Leading MBRs/QBRs, managing executive stakeholder relationships, and delivering customer value.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience analyzing operational and financial data to uncover cost savings and efficiency gains.
* Has managed account margins, tracking accessorials, and resolving systemic operational issues.
* Overseeing EDI/API integrations, UAT testing, and system escalations.
* Prior experience working directly for an LTL Carrier or related company.
* Proficient with MS Excel, Power BI, and Salesforce.

**Position Title:** Business Development Associate

**Reporting To:** Director of Business Development

**Location:** Chicago, IL

**Company:** Tyree & D'Angelo Partners

  

**Company Overview**

Tyree & D'Angelo Partners ("TDP") is a private equity investment firm that focuses on control investments in the lower middle market (companies with $1-5M of EBITDA). We look for investments where we can establish true collaborative partnerships with business owners and management teams that will lead to substantial value creation over a long-term investment horizon. TDP's track record of building high-growth and lower risk companies is driven by a buy & build investment strategy, that is based on tested methods of value creation and a true partnership approach with executives and business owners. TDP works in collaboration with executive leaders utilizing an investment thesis driven process designed to build companies with a differentiated customer value proposition. TDP invests in the healthcare, consumer, and business services sectors, focusing on high-quality founder owned businesses that we can grow with our high probability of success process. TDP companies have completed over 1,000 partnerships, have grown to over $4 billion of enterprise value, and TDP has over $1.4 billion of capital under management. For more information, please visit www.TDPfund.com

We are seeking a **Business Development Associate** to join our high-growth, fast-paced home service support and partnership organization. * Build deep pipeline of future acquisition opportunities
* Outbound prospect qualification and company research

* Assist in marketing campaigns

* Proven experience in sales, lead generation, or business development roles
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex ideas effectively

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
new_jobs.description:
As a **Customer Success Engineer** at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it.

You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them.

**Your Role and Impact:**

* **Onboarding Ownership:** Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one.
* **Success Planning:** Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder.
* **Value Articulation:** Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built.
* **Proactive Engagement:** Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates.
* **Technical Credibility:** Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote.

**This Role is a Fit for You If:**

* **Proven Post-Sales Experience:** You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers.
* **Technical Credibility:** You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources.
* **Stakeholder Range:** You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction.
* **Structured and Proactive:** You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it.
* **Commercial Awareness:** You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report.

**Bonus Points For:**

* Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure.
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale.
* Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector - where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions.
* Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem.
* Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up.

**About vCluster Labs**
-----------------------

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs

At Henkel, you’ll be part of an organization that’s shaping the future through innovation, sustainability and collaboration. With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow.
  
  
This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings.
  
  
**Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.**  
  

#### **What you´ll do**

* Implement growth plans and pipeline management that are commensurate with the overall strategic directives of the business.
* Work to establish a complete target list, documenting growth potential by application and location. Including collaborating with distribution partners to help drive new opportunities
* Drive new Sales through all prospecting vehicles, including (but not limited to) lead generation lists, OEM leads, and distribution partners. Actively working with Henkel’s Inside Sales (Grow) team and Marketing insights.
* Able to coordinate efforts with Henkel’s Inside Sales (Protect) team to properly support your existing territory’s customers effectively.
* Have/Develop knowledge of the market and on the major applications & technologies that are typically found in the assigned market areas.
* Effectively communicates progress and needs to the management team.
* Become competent with and utilize Henkel’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools to manage the sales and customer management processes.
* Recognize competitive forces and prepare sales strategies to offset them

#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Four (4) year college degree
* Previous direct sales experience in the industrial market is desirable.
* This position will require the candidate to possess a hunter mentality. You will be primarily prospecting to obtain new business and bring on new customers.
* Computer literacy
* Time and territory management skills working from home
* Up to 60% travel requirement
* Most of the travel will be contained to the Midwest part of the United States. This will include travel throughout the territory of WI, MN, IL, ND, SD, NE and MO.
* Preference will be given to candidates that are living in Minneapolis or Chicago.
* This position is bonus eligible.

#### **Some benefits of joining Henkel**

* **Health Insurance:** affordable plans for medical, dental, vision and wellbeing starting on day 1
* **Work-Life Balance:** Paid time off including sick, vacation, holiday and volunteer time, flexible & hybrid work policies (depending on role), and vacation buy / sell program
* **Financial:** 401k matching, employee share plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares, annual performance bonus, service awards and student loan reimbursement
* **Family Support:** 12-week gender neutral parental leave (up to 20 weeks for parents giving birth), fertility support, adoption & surrogacy reimbursement, discounted child and elderly care, and scholarships
* **Career Growth:** diverse national and international growth opportunities, access to thousands of skills development courses, and tuition reimbursement

The salary range for this role is **$80,000.00 and $100,000.00**.
